```
const API_CONFIG = {
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:8000/api",
  useMock: true,
  endpoints: {
    upload: "/files/upload",
    transcriptSample: "/transcript/sample",
    summarize: "/llm/summarize",
    chat: "/qa/ask",
  },
};

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function createUrl(path) {
  return `${API_CONFIG.baseUrl}${path}`;
}

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(createUrl(path), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(options.headers || {}),
    },
    ...options,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`请求失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export function setApiMode(useMock) {
  API_CONFIG.useMock = useMock;
}

export function getApiMode() {
  return API_CONFIG.useMock;
}

export async function uploadCourseFile(file) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(300);
    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      name: file.name,
      type: file.type || "application/octet-stream",
      size: file.size,
      previewUrl: file.type.includes("pdf") ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : "",
      extractedText: `Mock 文本索引已生成，可用于右侧问答。文件名: ${file.name}`,
    };
  }

  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append("file", file);

  const response = await fetch(createUrl(API_CONFIG.endpoints.upload), {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`文件上传失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function fetchTranscriptSample() {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(450);
    return {
      text: "老师现在讲到神经网络训练流程，重点强调损失函数下降和第十二页图示对应关系。",
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("zh-CN", {
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        second: "2-digit",
      }),
    };
  }

  return request(API_CONFIG.endpoints.transcriptSample, {
    method: "GET",
  });
}

export async function summarizeWordBox(payload) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(550);
    const preview = payload.tokens.slice(0, 6).join(" / ");
    return {
      summary: `老师刚刚主要围绕 ${preview} 展开，适合作为当前课件定位和后续问答的摘要线索。`,
      relatedPage: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.random() * 15)),
      createdAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("zh-CN", {
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
      }),
    };
  }

  return request(API_CONFIG.endpoints.summarize, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

export async function askFileQuestion(payload) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(650);
    return {
      answer: `根据当前文件和词 box 摘要，你的问题“${payload.question}”大概率与第 ${Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(Math.random() * 15),
      )} 页相关。接真接口后，这里可以返回精确页码、原文片段和解释。`,
      citations: ["当前文件文本索引", "最近一次自动总结"],
    };
  }

  return request(API_CONFIG.endpoints.chat, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

export const apiConfig = API_CONFIG;

  summarizeWordBox,
  uploadCourseFile,
} from "./api.js";

const WORD_BOX_LIMIT = 18;

const state = {
  files: [],
  currentFileId: "",
  transcripts: [],
  wordBox: [],
  summaries: [],
  chatMessages: [
    {
      role: "assistant",
      text: "前端原型已就绪。你后续只需要把右侧问答、上传和总结接口替换成真实后端地址即可。",
    },
  ],
};

const elements = {
  fileInput: document.querySelector("#file-input"),
  fileList: document.querySelector("#file-list"),
  fileCount: document.querySelector("#file-count"),
  previewStage: document.querySelector("#preview-stage"),
  currentFileLabel: document.querySelector("#current-file-label"),
  transcriptInput: document.querySelector("#transcript-input"),
  pushTranscriptBtn: document.querySelector("#push-transcript-btn"),
  fetchTranscriptBtn: document.querySelector("#fetch-transcript-btn"),
  transcriptStream: document.querySelector("#transcript-stream"),
  transcriptCount: document.querySelector("#transcript-count"),
  tokenBox: document.querySelector("#token-box"),
  wordBoxCount: document.querySelector("#word-box-count"),
  summaryList: document.querySelector("#summary-list"),
  summaryCount: document.querySelector("#summary-count"),
  chatMessages: document.querySelector("#chat-messages"),
  chatForm: document.querySelector("#chat-form"),
  chatInput: document.querySelector("#chat-input"),
  toggleModeBtn: document.querySelector("#toggle-mode-btn"),
  modeBadge: document.querySelector("#mode-badge"),
  transcriptionStatus: document.querySelector("#transcription-status"),
  summaryStatus: document.querySelector("#summary-status"),
  chatStatus: document.querySelector("#chat-status"),
};

function getCurrentFile() {
  return state.files.find((file) => file.id === state.currentFileId) || null;
}

function tokenizeTranscript(text) {
  const normalized = text
    .replace(/[，。！？；：,.!?;:]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();

  if (!normalized) {
    return [];
  }

  return normalized
    .split(" ")
    .flatMap((item) => {
      if (item.length <= 4) {
        return [item];
      }

      return item.match(/.{1,4}/g) || [item];
    })
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function renderFiles() {
  elements.fileCount.textContent = `${state.files.length} 个文件`;

  if (!state.files.length) {
    elements.fileList.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty-state">上传的 PDF 或 PPT 会显示在这里，左侧体验会接近 Codex 的文件栏。</div>';
    return;
  }

  elements.fileList.innerHTML = state.files
    .map((file) => {
      const isActive = file.id === state.currentFileId;
      return `
        <button class="file-item ${isActive ? "active" : ""}" data-file-id="${file.id}" type="button">
          <span class="file-name">${file.name}</span>
          <span class="file-type">${file.type || "未知类型"}</span>
        </button>
      `;
    })
    .join("");
}

function renderPreview() {
  const currentFile = getCurrentFile();

  if (!currentFile) {
    elements.currentFileLabel.textContent = "未选择文件";
    elements.previewStage.innerHTML = `
      <div class="empty-preview">
        <h3>等待上传课件</h3>
        <p>上传后，中间区域会切换成 PDF/PPT 的预览或信息卡片。</p>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }

  elements.currentFileLabel.textContent = currentFile.name;

  if (currentFile.type.includes("pdf") && currentFile.previewUrl) {
    elements.previewStage.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${currentFile.previewUrl}" title="${currentFile.name}"></iframe>`;
    return;
  }

  elements.previewStage.innerHTML = `
    <div class="ppt-preview">
      <div class="ppt-preview-card">
        <h3>${currentFile.name}</h3>
        <p>当前是 PPT/PPTX 文件。前端已经预留展示区，后续你可以接入后端返回的图片列表、转 PDF 结果或在线预览地址。</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderTranscripts() {
  elements.transcriptCount.textContent = `${state.transcripts.length} 条`;

  if (!state.transcripts.length) {
    elements.transcriptStream.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty-state">这里会展示老师的实时讲话文本流，后续可以改成 WebSocket/SSE 持续更新。</div>';
    return;
  }

  elements.transcriptStream.innerHTML = state.transcripts
    .slice()
    .reverse()
    .map(
      (item) => `
        <article class="transcript-item">
          <strong>${item.timestamp}</strong>
          <p>${item.text}</p>
        </article>
      `,
    )
    .join("");
}

function renderWordBox() {
  elements.wordBoxCount.textContent = `${state.wordBox.length} / ${WORD_BOX_LIMIT}`;

  if (!state.wordBox.length) {
    elements.tokenBox.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty-state">词 box 目前为空。转录流进入后会按词块填充到这里。</div>';
    return;
  }

  elements.tokenBox.innerHTML = state.wordBox
    .map((token) => `<span class="token">${token}</span>`)
    .join("");
}

function renderSummaries() {
  elements.summaryCount.textContent = `${state.summaries.length} 条`;

  if (!state.summaries.length) {
    elements.summaryList.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty-state">词 box 填满后会自动总结，并在这里沉淀每轮摘要与可能对应页数。</div>';
    return;
  }

  elements.summaryList.innerHTML = state.summaries
    .slice()
    .reverse()
    .map(
      (item) => `
        <article class="summary-card">
          <strong>${item.createdAt} · 建议关注第 ${item.relatedPage} 页</strong>
          <p>${item.summary}</p>
        </article>
      `,
    )
    .join("");
}

function renderChat() {
  elements.chatMessages.innerHTML = state.chatMessages
    .map(
      (message) => `
        <article class="message ${message.role}">
          <strong>${message.role === "assistant" ? "AI 助手" : "你"}</strong>
          <p>${message.text}</p>
        </article>
      `,
    )
    .join("");

  elements.chatMessages.scrollTop = elements.chatMessages.scrollHeight;
}

function renderMode() {
  const useMock = getApiMode();
  elements.modeBadge.textContent = useMock ? "Mock API" : "Live API";
  elements.toggleModeBtn.textContent = useMock ? "切换到真实接口" : "切换回 Mock";

  const statusText = useMock ? "Mock 已连接" : "等待真实接口";
  elements.transcriptionStatus.textContent = statusText;
  elements.summaryStatus.textContent = statusText;
  elements.chatStatus.textContent = statusText;
}

function renderAll() {
  renderFiles();
  renderPreview();
  renderTranscripts();
  renderWordBox();
  renderSummaries();
  renderChat();
  renderMode();
}

async function maybeSummarizeWordBox() {
  if (state.wordBox.length < WORD_BOX_LIMIT) {
    return;
  }

  const currentFile = getCurrentFile();
  const tokens = [...state.wordBox];
  state.wordBox = [];
  renderWordBox();

  try {
    const summary = await summarizeWordBox({
      tokens,
      currentFileName: currentFile?.name || "",
      recentTranscripts: state.transcripts.slice(-3),
    });

    state.summaries.push(summary);
    renderSummaries();
  } catch (error) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `自动总结失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
    renderChat();
  }
}

async function addTranscript(text, timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("zh-CN")) {
  const cleaned = text.trim();
  if (!cleaned) {
    return;
  }

  state.transcripts.push({ text: cleaned, timestamp });
  state.wordBox.push(...tokenizeTranscript(cleaned));
  state.wordBox = state.wordBox.slice(-WORD_BOX_LIMIT);
  renderTranscripts();
  renderWordBox();
  await maybeSummarizeWordBox();
}

async function handleFileUpload(event) {
  const [file] = event.target.files || [];
  if (!file) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
    state.files.unshift(uploaded);
    state.currentFileId = uploaded.id;
    renderFiles();
    renderPreview();
  } catch (error) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `文件上传失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
    renderChat();
  } finally {
    elements.fileInput.value = "";
  }
}

function handleFileSelection(event) {
  const button = event.target.closest("[data-file-id]");
  if (!button) {
    return;
  }

  state.currentFileId = button.dataset.fileId;
  renderFiles();
  renderPreview();
}

async function handlePushTranscript() {
  const text = elements.transcriptInput.value;
  elements.transcriptInput.value = "";
  await addTranscript(text);
}

async function handleFetchTranscript() {
  elements.fetchTranscriptBtn.disabled = true;
  elements.fetchTranscriptBtn.classList.add("loading");

  try {
    const sample = await fetchTranscriptSample();
    await addTranscript(sample.text, sample.timestamp);
  } catch (error) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `获取转录示例失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
    renderChat();
  } finally {
    elements.fetchTranscriptBtn.disabled = false;
    elements.fetchTranscriptBtn.classList.remove("loading");
  }
}

async function handleChatSubmit(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const question = elements.chatInput.value.trim();

  if (!question) {
    return;
  }

  state.chatMessages.push({ role: "user", text: question });
  renderChat();
  elements.chatInput.value = "";

  try {
    const currentFile = getCurrentFile();
    const response = await askFileQuestion({
      question,
      currentFileName: currentFile?.name || "",
      currentFileText: currentFile?.extractedText || "",
      summaries: state.summaries.slice(-3),
      transcripts: state.transcripts.slice(-5),
    });

    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: response.answer,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `问答接口调用失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
  }

  renderChat();
}

function handleToggleMode() {
  setApiMode(!getApiMode());
  renderMode();
}

function bindEvents() {
  elements.fileInput.addEventListener("change", handleFileUpload);
  elements.fileList.addEventListener("click", handleFileSelection);
  elements.pushTranscriptBtn.addEventListener("click", handlePushTranscript);
  elements.fetchTranscriptBtn.addEventListener("click", handleFetchTranscript);
  elements.chatForm.addEventListener("submit", handleChatSubmit);
  elements.toggleModeBtn.addEventListener("click", handleToggleMode);
}

bindEvents();
renderAll();

```

```
# 课堂 PDF/PPT 智能定位助手

这是一个前端优先的课堂助手原型，目标是把你负责的部分先跑通:

1. 左侧做成接近 Codex 风格的文件栏。
2. 中间支持上传并展示 PDF / PPT。
3. 中间上方保留实时转录流和词 box。
4. 当词 box 满载时，自动调用总结接口。
5. 右侧提供基于当前文件内容的 AI 问答区。

## 当前文件

- `index.html`: 页面结构
- `styles.css`: 视觉样式和响应式布局
- `app.js`: 页面交互逻辑
- `api.js`: 后续替换成真实后端的接口层

## 你后续怎么接朋友的后端

现在默认是 Mock 模式，方便你先做前端联调。后续只需要把 `api.js` 里的四个方法替换成真实后端:

- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF/PPT，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
- `fetchTranscriptSample()`: 这里现在只是模拟获取一段转录，你后续可以改成轮询、WebSocket 或 SSE
- `summarizeWordBox(payload)`: 当词 box 满载时自动调用
- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口

## 推荐后端返回字段

### 上传文件

```json
{
  "id": "file_001",
  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
  "type": "application/pdf",
  "previewUrl": "https://...",
  "extractedText": "整份文件抽取后的文本"
}
```

### 自动总结

```json
{
  "summary": "这一段主要讲了...",
  "relatedPage": 12,
  "createdAt": "14:30"
}
```

### 问答

```json
{
  "answer": "老师刚才提到的内容大约在第 12 页",
  "citations": ["第12页原文", "最近一次总结"]
}
```

## 适合你下一步继续做的事情

1. 把 `api.js` 的 `baseUrl` 改成你们后端地址。
2. 明确你朋友接口的请求体和返回字段。
3. 如果 PPT 也要像 PDF 一样预览，建议让后端转成图片数组或 PDF。

    51	function getCurrentFile() {

    55	function tokenizeTranscript(text) {
    56	  const normalized = text
    57	    .replace(/[，。！？；：,.!?;:]/g, " ")
    58	    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    59	    .trim();
    60	
    61	  if (!normalized) {
    62	    return [];
    63	  }
    64	
    65	  return normalized
    66	    .split(" ")
    67	    .flatMap((item) => {
    68	      if (item.length <= 4) {
    69	        return [item];
    70	      }
    71	
    72	      return item.match(/.{1,4}/g) || [item];
    73	    })
    74	    .filter(Boolean);
    75	}

   226	async function maybeSummarizeWordBox() {
   227	  while (state.wordBox.length >= WORD_BOX_LIMIT) {
   228	    const currentFile = getCurrentFile();
   229	    const tokens = state.wordBox.slice(0, WORD_BOX_LIMIT);
   230	    state.wordBox = state.wordBox.slice(WORD_BOX_LIMIT);
   231	    renderWordBox();
   232

   240	      state.summaries.push(summary);

   253	async function addTranscript(text, timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("zh-CN")) {

   255	  if (!cleaned) {

   260	  state.wordBox.push(...tokenizeTranscript(cleaned));

   262	  renderWordBox();
   263	  await maybeSummarizeWordBox();
   264	}

   310	  try {

   325	async function handleChatSubmit(event) {

     1	# 课堂 PDF/PPT 智能定位助手
     2	
     3	这是一个前端优先的课堂助手原型，目标是把你负责的部分先跑通:
     4	
     5	1. 左侧做成接近 Codex 风格的文件栏。
     6	2. 中间支持上传并展示 PDF / PPT。
     7	3. 中间上方保留实时转录流和词 box。
     8	4. 当词 box 满载时，自动调用总结接口。
     9	5. 右侧提供基于当前文件内容的 AI 问答区。
    10	
    11	## 当前文件
    12	
    13	- `index.html`: 页面结构
    14	- `styles.css`: 视觉样式和响应式布局
    15	- `app.js`: 页面交互逻辑
    16	- `api.js`: 后续替换成真实后端的接口层
    17	
    18	## 你后续怎么接朋友的后端
    19	
    20	现在默认是 Mock 模式，方便你先做前端联调。后续只需要把 `api.js` 里的四个方法替换成真实后端:
    21	
    22	- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF/PPT，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
    23	- `fetchTranscriptSample()`: 这里现在只是模拟获取一段转录，你后续可以改成轮询、WebSocket 或 SSE
    24	- `summarizeWordBox(payload)`: 当词 box 满载时自动调用
    25	- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口
    26	
    27	## 推荐后端返回字段
    28	
    29	### 上传文件
    30	
    31	```json
    32	{
    33	  "id": "file_001",
    34	  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
    35	  "type": "application/pdf",
    36	  "previewUrl": "https://...",
    37	  "extractedText": "整份文件抽取后的文本"
    38	}
    39	```
    40	
    41	### 自动总结
    42	
    43	```json
    44	{
    45	  "summary": "这一段主要讲了...",
    46	  "relatedPage": 12,
    47	  "createdAt": "14:30"
    48	}
    49	```
    50	
    51	### 问答
    52	
    53	```json
    54	{
    55	  "answer": "老师刚才提到的内容大约在第 12 页",
    56	  "citations": ["第12页原文", "最近一次总结"]
    57	}
    58	```
    59	
    60	## 适合你下一步继续做的事情
    61	
    62	1. 把 `api.js` 的 `baseUrl` 改成你们后端地址。
    63	2. 明确你朋友接口的请求体和返回字段。
    64	3. 如果 PPT 也要像 PDF 一样预览，建议让后端转成图片数组或 PDF。

  fileCount: document.querySelector("#file-count"),
  previewStage: document.querySelector("#preview-stage"),
  currentFileLabel: document.querySelector("#current-file-label"),
  chatMessages: document.querySelector("#chat-messages"),
  chatForm: document.querySelector("#chat-form"),
  chatInput: document.querySelector("#chat-input"),
};

function getCurrentFile() {
  return state.files.find((file) => file.id === state.currentFileId) || null;
}

function renderFiles() {
  elements.fileCount.textContent = `${state.files.length} 个文件`;

  if (!state.files.length) {
    elements.fileList.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty-state">这里显示已上传的 PDF 文件，点击后可以切换当前预览。</div>';
    return;
  }

  elements.fileList.innerHTML = state.files
    .map((file) => {
      const isActive = file.id === state.currentFileId;
      return `
        <button class="file-item ${isActive ? "active" : ""}" data-file-id="${file.id}" type="button">
          <span class="file-name">${file.name}</span>
          <span class="file-type">PDF 文档</span>
        </button>
      `;
    })
    .join("");
}

function renderPreview() {
  const currentFile = getCurrentFile();

  if (!currentFile) {
    elements.currentFileLabel.textContent = "未选择文件";
    elements.previewStage.innerHTML = `
      <div class="empty-preview">
        <h3>上传 PDF 开始预览</h3>
        <p>上传后，中间区域会直接显示该 PDF。</p>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }

  elements.currentFileLabel.textContent = currentFile.name;
  elements.previewStage.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${currentFile.previewUrl}" title="${currentFile.name}"></iframe>`;
}

function renderChat() {
  elements.chatMessages.innerHTML = state.chatMessages
    .map(
      (message) => `
        <article class="message ${message.role}">
          <strong>${message.role === "assistant" ? "AI 助手" : "你"}</strong>
          <p>${message.text}</p>
        </article>
      `,
    )
    .join("");

  elements.chatMessages.scrollTop = elements.chatMessages.scrollHeight;
}

function renderAll() {
  renderFiles();
  renderPreview();
  renderChat();
}

async function handleFileUpload(event) {
  const [file] = event.target.files || [];
  if (!file) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
    state.files.unshift(uploaded);
    state.currentFileId = uploaded.id;
    renderFiles();
    renderPreview();
  } catch (error) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `文件上传失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
    renderChat();
  } finally {
    elements.fileInput.value = "";
  }
}

function handleFileSelection(event) {
  const button = event.target.closest("[data-file-id]");
  if (!button) {
    return;
  }

  state.currentFileId = button.dataset.fileId;
  renderFiles();
  renderPreview();
}

async function handleChatSubmit(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const question = elements.chatInput.value.trim();

  if (!question) {
    return;
  }

  state.chatMessages.push({ role: "user", text: question });
  renderChat();
  elements.chatInput.value = "";

  try {
    const currentFile = getCurrentFile();
    const response = await askFileQuestion({
      question,
      currentFileName: currentFile?.name || "",
      currentFileText: currentFile?.extractedText || "",
    });

    const citationText =
      Array.isArray(response.citations) && response.citations.length
        ? `\n参考来源: ${response.citations.join(" · ")}`
        : "";

    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `${response.answer}${citationText}`,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `问答接口调用失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
  }

  renderChat();
}

function bindEvents() {
  elements.fileInput.addEventListener("change", handleFileUpload);
  elements.fileList.addEventListener("click", handleFileSelection);
  elements.chatForm.addEventListener("submit", handleChatSubmit);
}

bindEvents();
renderAll();

```

```
这是一个前端优先的课堂助手页面原型，当前只保留三个用户可见区域:

1. 左侧做成接近 Codex 风格的文件栏。
2. 中间支持上传并展示 PDF。
3. 右侧提供基于当前文件内容的 AI 问答区。
- `app.js`: 上传、文件切换、PDF 预览、问答交互
- `api.js`: 后续替换成真实后端的接口层
现在默认是 Mock 模式，方便你先做前端联调。后续只需要把 `api.js` 里的两个方法替换成真实后端:

- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口
### 问答
## 适合你下一步继续做的事情

1. 把 `api.js` 的 `baseUrl` 改成你们后端地址。
2. 明确你朋友接口的请求体和返回字段。
3. 如果后面要显示页码或原文片段，可以把它们放进 `askFileQuestion` 的返回结果里。
```

.app-shell {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(0, 1fr) 360px;
  gap: 20px;
  min-height: 100vh;
.sidebar,
.chat-shell,
.panel,

  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}
.brand-card,
.panel,
.chat-shell,
.preview-shell {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.brand-card h1,
.panel h2,
.preview-shell h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.brand-copy,
.hint,
.empty-preview p,
.upload-copy,
.panel-meta,
.message p {
  color: var(--muted);
}
.main-column {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.preview-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius-xl) + 8px);
  padding: 24px;
}

.preview-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
}

textarea {
  width: 100%;
.message {
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 14px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  border: 1px solid rgba(41, 31, 27, 0.08);
}

.message strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.preview-stage {
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1;
  border-radius: 24px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(41, 31, 27, 0.08);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84), rgba(255, 249, 242, 0.96));
  overflow: hidden;
}

.preview-stage iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 110px);
  border: none;
}

.empty-preview {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 110px);
  padding: 28px;
}

.empty-preview h3 {
  margin: 0;
}
@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .chat-shell {
    min-height: 440px;
  }

  .preview-toolbar {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

     3	这是一个前端优先的课堂助手页面原型，当前只保留三个用户可见区域:
     4	
     5	1. 左侧做成接近 Codex 风格的文件栏。
     6	2. 中间支持上传并展示 PDF。
     7	3. 右侧提供基于当前文件内容的 AI 问答区。
     8	
     9	## 当前文件
    10	
    11	- `index.html`: 页面结构
    12	- `styles.css`: 视觉样式和响应式布局
    13	- `app.js`: 上传、文件切换、PDF 预览、问答交互
    14	- `api.js`: 后续替换成真实后端的接口层
    15	
    16	## 你后续怎么接朋友的后端
    17	
    18	现在默认是 Mock 模式，方便你先做前端联调。后续只需要把 `api.js` 里的两个方法替换成真实后端:
    19	
    20	- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
    21	- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口
    22	
    23	## 推荐后端返回字段
    24	
    25	### 上传文件
    26	
    27	```json
    28	{

    30	  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
    31	  "type": "application/pdf",

async function handleChatSubmit(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const question = elements.chatInput.value.trim();
  state.chatMessages.push({ role: "user", text: question });
  renderChat();
  elements.chatInput.value = "";

  const currentFile = getCurrentFile();
  if (!currentFile) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: "请先在左侧上传一份 PDF，再开始提问。",
    });
    renderChat();
    return;
  }

  try {
    const response = await askFileQuestion({
      question,
      currentFileName: currentFile.name,
      currentFileText: currentFile.extractedText || "",
    });

```
export async function uploadCourseFile(file) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(300);
    const isPdf =
      (file.type && file.type.includes("pdf")) || file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");

    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      name: file.name,
      type: file.type || "application/octet-stream",
      size: file.size,
      previewUrl: isPdf ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : "",
      extractedText: `Mock 文本索引已生成，可用于右侧问答。文件名: ${file.name}`,
    };
  }
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(650);
    return {
      answer: `根据当前 PDF 内容，你的问题“${payload.question}”大概率与第 ${Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(Math.random() * 15),
      )} 页相关。接真接口后，这里可以返回精确页码、原文片段和解释。`,
      citations: ["当前文件文本索引"],
    };
  }
```

## User

web前端可以封装到 app里面吗

## Assistant

可以。

更准确地说，不是“把 web 变成 app”，而是把现有前端放进一个 `WebView` 容器里运行。常见做法有两类:

1. 桌面端 `App`
   用 `Electron` 或 `Tauri`。
   你的左侧文件栏、中间 PDF 预览、右侧问答这种界面，很适合这条路。
   前端代码基本可以直接复用，主要新增的是壳层、打包和本地文件权限处理。

2. 手机端 `App`
   用 `Capacitor` 或类似方案。
   本质也是把网页前端包进移动端容器里，再补相机、文件选择、通知这类原生能力。

对你这个项目，实际建议是：

- 先把前端按标准 `web` 做完整
- 接好你朋友的后端 API
- 最后再决定要不要封装成 `app`

原因很简单：
- 比赛项目先把核心流程跑通更重要
- web 调试快
- 后面封装成 app 的改动相对小
- API 层基本不用重写

如果你们目标是电脑端，优先考虑：
- `Tauri`：更轻，包体小
- `Electron`：生态成熟，但更重

如果你愿意，我下一步可以直接告诉你：
- 你这个项目更适合 `Electron` 还是 `Tauri`
- 或者我直接把当前前端结构按“后续可封装成 app”的方式整理出来

import { askFileQuestion, uploadCourseFile } from "./api.js";

const CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = "folder-current";

const state = {
  folders: [
    {
      id: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID,
      name: "当前课堂资料",
      expanded: true,
    },
    {
      id: "folder-ml",
      name: "机器学习导论",
      expanded: false,
    },
    {
      id: "folder-network",
      name: "计算机网络",
      expanded: false,
    },
    {
      id: "folder-math",
      name: "高等数学复习",
      expanded: false,
    },
  ],
  files: [
    {
      id: "demo-ml",
      folderId: "folder-ml",
      name: "chapter-03.pdf",
      previewUrl: "",
      extractedText: "示例文件，用于展示文件夹展开效果。",
    },
    {
      id: "demo-network",
      folderId: "folder-network",
      name: "tcp-notes.pdf",
      previewUrl: "",
      extractedText: "示例文件，用于展示文件夹展开效果。",
    },
  ],
  currentFileId: "",
  chatMessages: [
    {
      role: "assistant",
      text: "上传一份 PDF 之后，就可以在右侧直接针对这份文件提问。",
    },
  ],
};

const elements = {
  folderTree: document.querySelector("#folder-tree"),
  folderCount: document.querySelector("#folder-count"),
  fileInput: document.querySelector("#file-input"),
  previewStage: document.querySelector("#preview-stage"),
  currentFileLabel: document.querySelector("#current-file-label"),
  chatMessages: document.querySelector("#chat-messages"),
  chatForm: document.querySelector("#chat-form"),
  chatInput: document.querySelector("#chat-input"),
};

function getCurrentFile() {
  return state.files.find((file) => file.id === state.currentFileId) || null;
}

function getFilesByFolder(folderId) {
  return state.files.filter((file) => file.folderId === folderId);
}

function renderFolderTree() {
  elements.folderCount.textContent = `${state.folders.length} 个文件夹`;

  elements.folderTree.innerHTML = state.folders
    .map((folder) => {
      const files = getFilesByFolder(folder.id);
      const fileItems = folder.expanded
        ? files.length
          ? files
              .map((file) => {
                const active = file.id === state.currentFileId;
                return `
                  <button class="tree-file ${active ? "active" : ""}" data-file-id="${file.id}" type="button">
                    <span class="tree-file-name">${file.name}</span>
                  </button>
                `;
              })
              .join("")
          : '<div class="tree-empty">这个文件夹里还没有文件</div>'
        : "";

      return `
        <article class="folder-item">
          <button class="folder-toggle ${folder.expanded ? "active" : ""}" data-folder-id="${folder.id}" type="button">
            <span class="folder-chevron">${folder.expanded ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
            <span class="folder-name">${folder.name}</span>
            <span class="folder-meta">${files.length}</span>
          </button>
          ${folder.expanded ? `<div class="folder-children">${fileItems}</div>` : ""}
        </article>
      `;
    })
    .join("");
}

function renderPreview() {
  const currentFile = getCurrentFile();

  if (!currentFile || !currentFile.previewUrl) {
    elements.currentFileLabel.textContent = currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件";
    elements.previewStage.innerHTML = `
      <div class="empty-preview">
        <h3>上传 PDF 开始预览</h3>
        <p>左侧点击文件夹会展开文件，中间上传后的 PDF 会直接在这里预览。</p>
        <label class="upload-card upload-card-large" for="file-input">
          <span class="upload-title">从这里上传 PDF</span>
          <span class="upload-copy">上传后的文件会进入左侧“当前课堂资料”文件夹</span>
        </label>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }

  elements.currentFileLabel.textContent = currentFile.name;
  elements.previewStage.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${currentFile.previewUrl}" title="${currentFile.name}"></iframe>`;
}

function renderChat() {
  elements.chatMessages.innerHTML = state.chatMessages
    .map(
      (message) => `
        <article class="message ${message.role}">
          <strong>${message.role === "assistant" ? "AI 助手" : "你"}</strong>
          <p>${message.text}</p>
        </article>
      `,
    )
    .join("");

  elements.chatMessages.scrollTop = elements.chatMessages.scrollHeight;
}

function renderAll() {
  renderFolderTree();
  renderPreview();
  renderChat();
}

function expandCurrentFolder() {
  state.folders = state.folders.map((folder) =>
    folder.id === CURRENT_FOLDER_ID ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,
  );
}

async function handleFileUpload(event) {
  const [file] = event.target.files || [];
  if (!file) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
    state.files.unshift({
      ...uploaded,
      folderId: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID,
    });
    state.currentFileId = uploaded.id;
    expandCurrentFolder();
    renderAll();
  } catch (error) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `文件上传失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
    renderChat();
  } finally {
    elements.fileInput.value = "";
  }
}

function handleFolderTreeClick(event) {
  const folderButton = event.target.closest("[data-folder-id]");
  if (folderButton) {
    const folderId = folderButton.dataset.folderId;
    state.folders = state.folders.map((folder) =>
      folder.id === folderId ? { ...folder, expanded: !folder.expanded } : folder,
    );
    renderFolderTree();
    return;
  }

  const fileButton = event.target.closest("[data-file-id]");
  if (!fileButton) {
    return;
  }

  state.currentFileId = fileButton.dataset.fileId;
  renderFolderTree();
  renderPreview();
}

async function handleChatSubmit(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const question = elements.chatInput.value.trim();

  if (!question) {
    return;
  }

  state.chatMessages.push({ role: "user", text: question });
  renderChat();
  elements.chatInput.value = "";

  const currentFile = getCurrentFile();
  if (!currentFile || !currentFile.previewUrl) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: "请先上传一份可预览的 PDF，再开始提问。",
    });
    renderChat();
    return;
  }

  try {
    const response = await askFileQuestion({
      question,
      currentFileName: currentFile.name,
      currentFileText: currentFile.extractedText || "",
    });

    const citationText =
      Array.isArray(response.citations) && response.citations.length
        ? `\n参考来源: ${response.citations.join(" · ")}`
        : "";

    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `${response.answer}${citationText}`,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    state.chatMessages.push({
      role: "assistant",
      text: `问答接口调用失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
  }

  renderChat();
}

function bindEvents() {
  elements.fileInput.addEventListener("change", handleFileUpload);
  elements.folderTree.addEventListener("click", handleFolderTreeClick);
  elements.chatForm.addEventListener("submit", handleChatSubmit);
}

bindEvents();
renderAll();

```

     1	# 课堂 PDF 智能定位助手
     2	
     3	这是一个前端优先的课堂助手页面原型，当前只保留三个用户可见区域:
     4	
     5	1. 左侧做成接近 Codex 风格的历史工作区和文件栏。
     6	2. 中间提供真正的 PDF 上传入口，并在上传后切换成预览。
     7	3. 右侧提供基于当前文件内容的 AI 问答区。
     8	
     9	## 当前文件
    10	
    11	- `index.html`: 页面结构
    12	- `styles.css`: 视觉样式和响应式布局
    13	- `app.js`: 工作区列表、文件切换、PDF 预览、问答交互
    14	- `api.js`: 后续替换成真实后端的接口层
    15	
    16	## 你后续怎么接朋友的后端
    17	
    18	现在默认是 Mock 模式，方便你先做前端联调。后续只需要把 `api.js` 里的两个方法替换成真实后端:
    19	
    20	- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
    21	- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口
    22	
    23	## 推荐后端返回字段
    24	
    25	### 上传文件
    26	
    27	```json
    28	{
    29	  "id": "file_001",
    30	  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
    31	  "type": "application/pdf",
    32	  "previewUrl": "https://...",
    33	  "extractedText": "整份文件抽取后的文本"
    34	}
    35	```
    36	
    37	### 问答
    38	
    39	```json
    40	{
    41	  "answer": "老师刚才提到的内容大约在第 12 页",
    42	  "citations": ["第12页原文", "当前文件文本索引"]
    43	}
    44	```
    45	
    46	## 适合你下一步继续做的事情
    47	
    48	1. 把 `api.js` 的 `baseUrl` 改成你们后端地址。
    49	2. 明确你朋友接口的请求体和返回字段。
    50	3. 如果后面要显示页码或原文片段，可以把它们放进 `askFileQuestion` 的返回结果里。

:root {
  --font-ui:
    "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Noto Sans SC", "Helvetica Neue",
    sans-serif;
  --radius-xl: 18px;
  --radius-lg: 14px;
  --radius-md: 10px;
  --shell-gap: 14px;
  --shell-padding: 16px;
  --panel-padding: 16px;
  --panel-padding-lg: 18px;
  --line-width: 1px;
  color-scheme: light;
}

:root,
:root[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg-top: #f4f4f1;
  --bg-bottom: #ecebe7;
  --bg-tint: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48);
  --surface: rgba(250, 250, 248, 0.78);
  --surface-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
  --surface-muted: rgba(243, 243, 240, 0.82);
  --border: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.08);
  --border-strong: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.14);
  --border-focus: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.2);
  --focus-ring: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.05);
  --text-primary: #171717;
  --text-secondary: #5f5f5f;
  --text-tertiary: #8b8b8b;
  --marker: #818181;
  --selection: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.045);
  --button-bg: #181818;
  --button-hover: #0f0f0f;
  --button-text: #f5f5f2;
  --shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.04);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-top: #090a0c;
  --bg-bottom: #111318;
  --bg-tint: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  --surface: rgba(18, 19, 23, 0.88);
  --surface-strong: rgba(24, 26, 31, 0.96);
  --surface-muted: rgba(31, 33, 38, 0.78);
  --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --border-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --border-focus: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  --focus-ring: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  --text-primary: #c8ccd2;
  --text-secondary: #98a0a9;
  --text-tertiary: #707783;
  --marker: #8a919a;
  --selection: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
  --button-bg: #d1d5db;
  --button-hover: #e0e4e9;
  --button-text: #111318;
  --shadow: 0 22px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
  color-scheme: dark;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--bg-tint), transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-top) 0%, var(--bg-bottom) 100%);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

button,
textarea,
input {
  font: inherit;
}

.app-shell {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(0, 1fr) 360px;
  gap: var(--shell-gap);
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: var(--shell-padding);
  align-items: stretch;
}

.sidebar,
.main-column,
.chat-column {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
}

.panel,
.preview-shell,
.chat-shell {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

.panel,
.chat-shell {
  padding: var(--panel-padding);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
}

.file-tree-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: calc(100vh - (var(--shell-padding) * 2));
}

.preview-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: var(--panel-padding-lg);
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius-xl) + 2px);
}

.chat-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  min-height: calc(100vh - (var(--shell-padding) * 2));
}

.panel-header,
.preview-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.panel-header {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.panel h2,
.preview-shell h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 520;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.eyebrow {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
}

.panel-meta,
.panel-badge,
.upload-copy,
.empty-preview p,
.message strong,
.tree-empty {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.panel-meta {
  font-size: 12px;
}

.panel-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 28px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 450;
}

.preview-toolbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.theme-switch {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 3px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.theme-option {
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.theme-option.active {
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
}

.folder-tree,
.chat-messages {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 0;
}

.folder-tree {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.folder-item {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.folder-toggle,
.tree-file {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid transparent;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}

.folder-toggle.active,
.folder-toggle:hover,
.tree-file:hover,
.tree-file.active {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.folder-chevron {
  width: 12px;
  flex: 0 0 12px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.folder-name {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.folder-meta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
}

.folder-children {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding-left: 18px;
}

.tree-file {
  padding-left: 16px;
}

.tree-file::before {
  content: "";
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--marker);
  flex: 0 0 6px;
}

.tree-file-name {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.tree-file.active .tree-file-name {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.tree-empty {
  padding: 2px 12px 8px 14px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.preview-stage {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.preview-stage iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 84px);
  border: none;
  background: #ffffff;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .preview-stage iframe {
  background: #1a1c20;
}

.empty-preview {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 84px);
  padding: 32px 24px;
}

.empty-preview h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.upload-card {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 18px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: var(--line-width) dashed var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.upload-card-large {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 360px;
}

.upload-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.upload-copy {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 96px;
  resize: vertical;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
}

textarea:focus,
input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--border-focus);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring);
}

.chat-messages {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.message {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.message.user {
  background: var(--selection);
}

.message.assistant {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.message strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.message p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  white-space: pre-line;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.chat-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.primary-button {
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 11px 14px;
  background: var(--button-bg);
  color: var(--button-text);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.primary-button:hover {
  background: var(--button-hover);
}

.empty-state {
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: var(--line-width) dashed var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 260px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .chat-column {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .chat-shell,
  .file-tree-panel {
    min-height: auto;
  }
}

import { askFileQuestion, uploadCourseFile } from "./api.js";

const CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = "folder-current";
const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = "course-pdf-theme";
const elements = {
  folderTree: document.querySelector("#folder-tree"),
  folderCount: document.querySelector("#folder-count"),
  fileInput: document.querySelector("#file-input"),
  themeSwitch: document.querySelector("#theme-switch"),
  themeOptions: document.querySelectorAll("[data-theme-option]"),
  previewStage: document.querySelector("#preview-stage"),
  currentFileLabel: document.querySelector("#current-file-label"),
  chatMessages: document.querySelector("#chat-messages"),
function getCurrentFile() {
  return state.files.find((file) => file.id === state.currentFileId) || null;
}

function normalizeTheme(theme) {
  return theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
}

function applyTheme(theme) {
  const nextTheme = normalizeTheme(theme);
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextTheme;

  elements.themeOptions.forEach((button) => {
    button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.themeOption === nextTheme);
  });

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, nextTheme);
  } catch (error) {
    // Ignore storage failures and keep the in-memory theme.
  }
}

function getInitialTheme() {
  try {
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (savedTheme === "light" || savedTheme === "dark") {
      return savedTheme;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // Ignore storage failures and fall back to the default theme.
  }

  return "light";
}

function getFilesByFolder(folderId) {
  return state.files.filter((file) => file.folderId === folderId);
}
function handleFolderTreeClick(event) {
  renderPreview();
}

function handleThemeSwitchClick(event) {
  const button = event.target.closest("[data-theme-option]");
  if (!button) {
    return;
  }

  applyTheme(button.dataset.themeOption);
}

async function handleChatSubmit(event) {
function bindEvents() {
  elements.fileInput.addEventListener("change", handleFileUpload);
  elements.folderTree.addEventListener("click", handleFolderTreeClick);
  if (elements.themeSwitch) {
    elements.themeSwitch.addEventListener("click", handleThemeSwitchClick);
  }
  elements.chatForm.addEventListener("submit", handleChatSubmit);
}

applyTheme(getInitialTheme());
window.setAppTheme = applyTheme;
bindEvents();
renderAll();
```

## Assistant

原因大概率不是按钮本身，而是 `JS 根本没跑起来`。

你现在的页面是模块化脚本：
- `index.html` 用了 `type="module"` 去加载 `app.js`【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/index.html†L83-L83】
- `app.js` 第一行又继续 `import "./api.js"`【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/app.js†L1-L1】

如果你是直接双击 `index.html`，浏览器通常会用 `file://` 打开。这种情况下，很多浏览器会拦截 ES Module 的加载，所以结果就是：
- 页面静态 HTML 能显示
- 但 `app.js` 没执行
- 文件夹展开、主题切换、上传、问答这些事件都不会绑定
- 看起来就像“按钮没反应”

我已经检查过 `app.js` 语法本身是正常的，不是脚本写坏了。

解决方式很直接：不要直接双击 `index.html`，而是用本地静态服务器打开。

在项目目录 `/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端` 里运行：
```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080
```

然后浏览器访问：
```text
http://localhost:8080
```

如果你打开浏览器控制台，大概率还能看到类似这类报错：
```text
Failed to load module script
Access to script at ... from origin 'null' has been blocked
```

如果你希望“直接双击 html 也能用”，那就得把现在这套 `module import` 改成单文件脚本模式，或者上一个正式前端工程工具（比如 Vite）。  
更合理的做法还是本地起服务。

如果你要，我下一步可以直接帮你：
1. 做一个最简启动方式，保证你本地一条命令就能跑
2. 或者把它改成真正的 `Vite` 项目结构，后面开发更稳

  response.end(body);
}

function resolveFilePath(requestUrl) {
  const requestPath = decodeURIComponent(new URL(requestUrl, `http://${HOST}:${PORT}`).pathname);
  const safePath = path.normalize(requestPath).replace(/^(\.\.[/\\])+/, "");
  const targetPath = safePath === "/" ? "/index.html" : safePath;
  return path.join(ROOT_DIR, targetPath);
}

const server = http.createServer((request, response) => {
  const filePath = resolveFilePath(request.url || "/");

  if (!filePath.startsWith(ROOT_DIR)) {
    sendResponse(response, 403, "Forbidden", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
    return;
  }

  fs.readFile(filePath, (error, content) => {
    if (error) {
      if (error.code === "ENOENT") {
        sendResponse(response, 404, "Not Found", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
        return;
      }

      sendResponse(response, 500, "Internal Server Error", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
      return;
    }

    const extension = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
    const contentType = MIME_TYPES[extension] || "application/octet-stream";
    sendResponse(response, 200, content, contentType);
  });
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
  console.log(`Server running at http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
});

   221	    state.folders = state.folders.map((folder) =>

   289	    });
   290	  }

# 课堂 PDF 智能定位助手

这个项目已经按你当前的页面架构重建为 `React + Vite`：

1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
2. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域。
3. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
4. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。

## 项目结构

- `index.html`: Vite 入口
- `vite.config.js`: Vite 配置
- `src/main.jsx`: React 挂载入口
- `src/App.jsx`: 主界面与交互逻辑
- `src/api.js`: 上传和问答接口层
- `src/styles.css`: 主题与布局样式

## 启动方式

先安装依赖：

```bash
npm install
```

开发模式运行：

```bash
npm run dev
```

默认会输出本地访问地址，通常是：

```text
http://localhost:5173
```

## 后端接口对接

当前 `src/api.js` 默认使用 Mock 模式。后续只需要替换两个方法：

- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口

推荐返回字段：

```json
{
  "id": "file_001",
  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
  "type": "application/pdf",
  "previewUrl": "https://...",
  "extractedText": "整份文件抽取后的文本"
}
```

```json
{
  "answer": "老师刚才提到的内容大约在第 12 页",
  "citations": ["第12页原文", "当前文件文本索引"]
}
```

```
const API_CONFIG = {
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:8000/api",
  useMock: true,
  endpoints: {
    upload: "/files/upload",
    chat: "/qa/ask",
  },
};

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function createUrl(path) {
  return `${API_CONFIG.baseUrl}${path}`;
}

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(createUrl(path), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(options.headers || {}),
    },
    ...options,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`请求失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function uploadCourseFile(file) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(300);
    const isPdf =
      (file.type && file.type.includes("pdf")) || file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");

    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      name: file.name,
      type: file.type || "application/octet-stream",
      size: file.size,
      previewUrl: isPdf ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : "",
      extractedText: `Mock 文本索引已生成，可用于右侧问答。文件名: ${file.name}`,
    };
  }

  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append("file", file);

  const response = await fetch(createUrl(API_CONFIG.endpoints.upload), {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`文件上传失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function askFileQuestion(payload) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(650);
    return {
      answer: `根据当前 PDF 内容，你的问题“${payload.question}”大概率与第 ${Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(Math.random() * 15),
      )} 页相关。接真接口后，这里可以返回精确页码、原文片段和解释。`,
      citations: ["当前文件文本索引"],
    };
  }

  return request(API_CONFIG.endpoints.chat, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

export const apiConfig = API_CONFIG;

```
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { askFileQuestion, uploadCourseFile } from "./api.js";

const CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = "folder-current";
const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = "course-pdf-theme";

const INITIAL_FOLDERS = [
  { id: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID, name: "当前课堂资料", expanded: true },
  { id: "folder-ml", name: "机器学习导论", expanded: false },
  { id: "folder-network", name: "计算机网络", expanded: false },
  { id: "folder-math", name: "高等数学复习", expanded: false },
];

const INITIAL_FILES = [
  {
    id: "demo-ml",
    folderId: "folder-ml",
    name: "chapter-03.pdf",
    previewUrl: "",
    extractedText: "示例文件，用于展示文件夹展开效果。",
  },
  {
    id: "demo-network",
    folderId: "folder-network",
    name: "tcp-notes.pdf",
    previewUrl: "",
    extractedText: "示例文件，用于展示文件夹展开效果。",
  },
];

const INITIAL_MESSAGES = [
  {
    role: "assistant",
    text: "上传一份 PDF 之后，就可以在右侧直接针对这份文件提问。",
  },
];

function normalizeTheme(theme) {
  return theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
}

function getInitialTheme() {
  try {
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (savedTheme === "light" || savedTheme === "dark") {
      return savedTheme;
    }
  } catch {
    return "light";
  }

  return "light";
}

function App() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(getInitialTheme);
  const [folders, setFolders] = useState(INITIAL_FOLDERS);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState(INITIAL_FILES);
  const [currentFileId, setCurrentFileId] = useState("");
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState(INITIAL_MESSAGES);
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState("");
  const [isAsking, setIsAsking] = useState(false);
  const chatMessagesRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const nextTheme = normalizeTheme(theme);
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextTheme;

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, nextTheme);
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage failures.
    }

    window.setAppTheme = setTheme;

    return () => {
      delete window.setAppTheme;
    };
  }, [theme]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = chatMessagesRef.current;
    if (container) {
      container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [chatMessages]);

  const currentFile = files.find((file) => file.id === currentFileId) || null;

  function getFilesByFolder(folderId) {
    return files.filter((file) => file.folderId === folderId);
  }

  function handleToggleFolder(folderId) {
    setFolders((currentFolders) =>
      currentFolders.map((folder) =>
        folder.id === folderId ? { ...folder, expanded: !folder.expanded } : folder,
      ),
    );
  }

  async function handleUploadFile(event) {
    const [file] = event.target.files || [];
    if (!file) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);

      setFiles((currentFiles) => [
        {
          ...uploaded,
          folderId: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID,
        },
        ...currentFiles,
      ]);

      setFolders((currentFolders) =>
        currentFolders.map((folder) =>
          folder.id === CURRENT_FOLDER_ID ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,
        ),
      );

      setCurrentFileId(uploaded.id);
    } catch (error) {
      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
        ...currentMessages,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          text: `文件上传失败: ${error.message}`,
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      event.target.value = "";
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = chatInput.trim();
    if (!question) {
      return;
    }

    setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
      ...currentMessages,
      { role: "user", text: question },
    ]);
    setChatInput("");

    if (!currentFile || !currentFile.previewUrl) {
      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
        ...currentMessages,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          text: "请先上传一份可预览的 PDF，再开始提问。",
        },
      ]);
      return;
    }

    setIsAsking(true);

    try {
      const response = await askFileQuestion({
        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
        currentFileText: currentFile.extractedText || "",
      });

      const citationText =
        Array.isArray(response.citations) && response.citations.length
          ? `\n参考来源: ${response.citations.join(" · ")}`
          : "";

      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
        ...currentMessages,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          text: `${response.answer}${citationText}`,
        },
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
        ...currentMessages,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          text: `问答接口调用失败: ${error.message}`,
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsAsking(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-shell">
      <aside className="sidebar">
        <section className="panel file-tree-panel">
          <div className="panel-header">
            <h2>文件栏</h2>
            <span className="panel-meta">{folders.length} 个文件夹</span>
          </div>
          <div className="folder-tree">
            {folders.map((folder) => {
              const folderFiles = getFilesByFolder(folder.id);

              return (
                <article className="folder-item" key={folder.id}>
                  <button
                    className={`folder-toggle ${folder.expanded ? "active" : ""}`}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleToggleFolder(folder.id)}
                  >
                    <span className="folder-chevron">{folder.expanded ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
                    <span className="folder-name">{folder.name}</span>
                    <span className="folder-meta">{folderFiles.length}</span>
                  </button>

                  {folder.expanded ? (
                    <div className="folder-children">
                      {folderFiles.length ? (
                        folderFiles.map((file) => (
                          <button
                            className={`tree-file ${file.id === currentFileId ? "active" : ""}`}
                            key={file.id}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setCurrentFileId(file.id)}
                          >
                            <span className="tree-file-name">{file.name}</span>
                          </button>
                        ))
                      ) : (
                        <div className="tree-empty">这个文件夹里还没有文件</div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
      </aside>

      <main className="main-column">
        <section className="preview-shell">
          <div className="preview-toolbar">
            <div>
              <p className="eyebrow">Document View</p>
              <h2>PDF 导入与预览</h2>
            </div>
            <div className="preview-toolbar-actions">
              <div className="theme-switch">
                <button
                  className={`theme-option ${theme === "light" ? "active" : ""}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTheme("light")}
                >
                  浅色
                </button>
                <button
                  className={`theme-option ${theme === "dark" ? "active" : ""}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTheme("dark")}
                >
                  深色
                </button>
              </div>
              <span className="panel-badge">{currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}</span>
              <input
                id="file-input"
                type="file"
                accept=".pdf"
                hidden
                onChange={handleUploadFile}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="preview-stage">
            {currentFile && currentFile.previewUrl ? (
              <iframe src={currentFile.previewUrl} title={currentFile.name} />
            ) : (
              <div className="empty-preview">
                <h3>上传 PDF 开始预览</h3>
                <p>左侧点击文件夹会展开文件，中间上传后的 PDF 会直接在这里预览。</p>
                <label className="upload-card upload-card-large" htmlFor="file-input">
                  <span className="upload-title">从这里上传 PDF</span>
                  <span className="upload-copy">
                    上传后的文件会进入左侧“当前课堂资料”文件夹
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      <aside className="chat-column">
        <section className="chat-shell">
          <div className="panel-header">
            <div>
              <p className="eyebrow">AI Assistant</p>
              <h2>课件问答</h2>
            </div>
            <span className="panel-badge">当前 PDF</span>
          </div>

          <div className="chat-messages" ref={chatMessagesRef}>
            {chatMessages.map((message, index) => (
              <article className={`message ${message.role}`} key={`${message.role}-${index}`}>
                <strong>{message.role === "assistant" ? "AI 助手" : "你"}</strong>
                <p>{message.text}</p>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>

          <form className="chat-form" onSubmit={handleSubmitQuestion}>
            <textarea
              value={chatInput}
              placeholder="例如：老师刚才讲到哪一页？这份 PDF 的重点内容是什么？"
              onChange={(event) => setChatInput(event.target.value)}
            />
            <button className="primary-button" type="submit" disabled={isAsking}>
              {isAsking ? "发送中" : "发送问题"}
            </button>
          </form>
        </section>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

```

.message strong,
.tree-empty {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.panel-meta {
  font-size: 12px;
}

.panel-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 28px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.preview-toolbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.theme-switch {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 3px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.theme-option {
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.theme-option.active {
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
}

.folder-tree,
.chat-messages {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 0;
}

.folder-tree {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.folder-item {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.folder-toggle,
.tree-file {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid transparent;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}

.folder-toggle.active,
.folder-toggle:hover,
.tree-file:hover,
.tree-file.active {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.folder-chevron {
  width: 12px;
  flex: 0 0 12px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.folder-name {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.folder-meta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
}

.folder-children {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding-left: 18px;
}

.tree-file {
  padding-left: 16px;
}

.tree-file::before {
  content: "";
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--marker);
  flex: 0 0 6px;
}

.tree-file-name {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.tree-file.active .tree-file-name {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.tree-empty {
  padding: 2px 12px 8px 14px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.preview-stage {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.preview-stage iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 84px);
  border: none;
  background: #ffffff;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .preview-stage iframe {
  background: #1a1c20;
}

.empty-preview {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 84px);
  padding: 32px 24px;
}

.empty-preview h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.upload-card {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 18px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: var(--line-width) dashed var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.upload-card-large {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 360px;
}

.upload-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.upload-copy {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 96px;
  resize: vertical;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
}

textarea:focus,
input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--border-focus);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring);
}

.chat-messages {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.message {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.message.user {
  background: var(--selection);
}

.message.assistant {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.message strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.message p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  white-space: pre-line;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.chat-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.primary-button {
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 11px 14px;
  background: var(--button-bg);
  color: var(--button-text);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.primary-button:hover {
  background: var(--button-hover);
}

@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 260px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .chat-column {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .chat-shell,
  .file-tree-panel {
    min-height: auto;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .preview-toolbar {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .preview-toolbar-actions {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .preview-stage iframe,
  .empty-preview {
    min-height: 480px;
  }

  .chat-shell,
  .file-tree-panel {
    min-height: auto;
  }
}

```

```
.panel-header {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.file-tree-actions {
  position: relative;
}

.icon-button,
.folder-menu-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.icon-button {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1;
}

.icon-button.active,
.icon-button:hover,
.folder-menu-button.active,
.folder-menu-button:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--surface-strong);
}

.panel h2,
.preview-shell h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
.theme-option.active {
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
}

.action-menu {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  right: 0;
  z-index: 20;
  width: 220px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.create-menu {
  width: 240px;
}

.menu-label,
.menu-field-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
}

.menu-name {
  padding: 2px 0 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.menu-separator {
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--border);
  margin: 4px 0;
}

.menu-option {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid transparent;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 13px;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.menu-option:hover {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.menu-option.danger {
  color: #c15454;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .menu-option.danger {
  color: #dc8787;
}

.menu-inline-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.menu-input {
  width: 100%;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.menu-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.menu-button-primary,
.menu-button-secondary {
  flex: 1;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.menu-button-primary {
  border: none;
  background: var(--button-bg);
  color: var(--button-text);
}

.menu-button-secondary {
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.folder-tree,
.chat-messages {
  display: flex;
.folder-item {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.folder-row {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: start;
}

.folder-toggle,
.tree-file {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
.folder-toggle.active,
.folder-toggle:hover,
.tree-file:hover,
.tree-file.active {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.folder-toggle.selected {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.folder-children {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding-left: 18px;
}

.folder-menu-wrapper {
  position: relative;
}

.folder-menu-button {
  min-width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.tree-file {
  padding-left: 16px;
}

```
这个项目已经按你当前的页面架构重建为 `React + Vite`：

1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
3. 每个文件夹右侧有三点菜单，可修改名称、删除、查看“在文件管理器中显示”入口。
2. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域。
3. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
4. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。
```

1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
3. 每个文件夹右侧有三点菜单，可修改名称、删除、查看“在文件管理器中显示”入口。
4. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域，上传文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹。
5. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
6. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。

说明：
Web 版浏览器不能真正拉起系统文件管理器，所以“在文件管理器中显示”目前是占位交互。封装成桌面 App 后可以接原生能力。
```

```
1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
3. 每个文件夹右侧有三点菜单，可修改名称、删除、查看“在文件管理器中显示”入口。
4. 如果没有选择已有文件夹，新建工作区会默认归到 `~/Documents` 下对应名称的目录。
5. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域，上传文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹。
6. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
7. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。

说明：
Web 版浏览器不能真正拉起系统文件管理器，所以“在文件管理器中显示”目前是占位交互。封装成桌面 App 后可以接原生能力。

## Assistant

有，而且对你这个项目来说，不建议继续依赖浏览器自带那套。

常见替代方案有 4 类：

1. `PDF.js`
适合你现在这个 React 项目。它是 Mozilla 的开源 PDF 渲染方案，能自己控制页码、缩放、搜索、高亮和后续“讲到哪一页”的联动逻辑。  
官方资料：[`PDF.js Getting Started`](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/getting_started/) 、[`pdfjs-dist / setup`](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/wiki/Setup-pdf.js-in-a-website)

2. `Adobe PDF Embed API`
接入比较快，渲染质量稳定，支持多种嵌入模式。缺点是更偏平台服务方案，要走 Adobe 的接入方式。  
官方资料：[`Adobe PDF Embed API`](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/pdf-embed) 、[`Overview`](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-embed-api/)

3. 商业 SDK，比如 `Apryse WebViewer`
功能最全，除了 PDF，还能支持 Office、标注、编辑、搜索等，适合做完整文档平台。缺点是更重，也通常涉及商业授权。  
官方资料：[`Apryse WebViewer overview`](https://docs.apryse.com/web/guides/overview/) 、[`Viewing sample`](https://docs.apryse.com/web/samples/viewing/) 、[`Deployment options`](https://docs.apryse.com/web/guides/deployment-options)

4. 后端把 PDF 转成图片，前端按图片预览
这不是 SDK，而是一种架构方案。优点是样式最可控，兼容性也高；缺点是文字层、搜索、选中文本、精确定位会麻烦很多。  
这是工程建议，不是来自某个单一官方 SDK 文档。

对你这个项目，我的建议很明确：

- 如果你要“可控、适合 React、后面还要做页码定位和文本联动”，选 `PDF.js`
- 如果你要“最快接进去，少自己造轮子”，可以看 `Adobe PDF Embed API`
- 如果你要“产品级文档能力很多”，再考虑 `Apryse`

你现在这个项目最合适的默认选型是 `PDF.js`。  
因为你后面不仅是“看 PDF”，还要把老师讲的内容和页码、文本层关联起来，浏览器自带预览器不适合做这种深度控制。

如果你要，我下一步可以直接把你现在这个 React 项目的中间预览区改成 `PDF.js` 版本。

  function handleDeleteFolder(folderId) {
    if (folders.length <= 1) {
      window.alert("至少保留一个工作区文件夹。");
      return;
    }

    const folder = folders.find((item) => item.id === folderId);
    if (!folder) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = window.confirm(`删除工作区文件夹“${folder.name}”以及其中的文件？`);
    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    const remainingFolders = folders.filter((item) => item.id !== folderId);
    const removedFileIds = new Set(
      files.filter((file) => file.folderId === folderId).map((file) => file.id),
    );

    setFolders(remainingFolders);
    setFiles((currentFiles) => currentFiles.filter((file) => file.folderId !== folderId));

    if (selectedFolderId === folderId) {
      setSelectedFolderId(remainingFolders[0]?.id || "");
    }

    if (removedFileIds.has(currentFileId)) {
      setCurrentFileId("");
    }

    setOpenFolderMenuId(null);
    setRenameFolderId(null);
    setRenameValue("");
  }

  function handleRevealFolder(folder) {
    if (folder.sourceType === "documents") {
      window.alert(`当前工作区默认指向文稿目录：${folder.folderPath}`);
      return;
    }

    if (folder.sourceType === "system") {
      window.alert(
        `当前工作区对应已选择的文件夹：${folder.folderPath}\n浏览器环境不能直接在文件管理器中显示它，封装成桌面 App 后可接原生能力。`,
      );
      return;
    }

    window.alert("浏览器环境不能直接在文件管理器中显示文件夹。封装成桌面 App 后可接这个能力。");
  }

  async function handleUploadFile(event) {
    const [file] = event.target.files || [];
    if (!file) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
      const targetFolderId = selectedFolder?.id || CURRENT_FOLDER_ID;

      setFiles((currentFiles) => [
        {
          ...uploaded,
          folderId: targetFolderId,
        },
        ...currentFiles,
      ]);

      setFolders((currentFolders) =>
        currentFolders.map((folder) =>
          folder.id === targetFolderId ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,
        ),
      );

      setSelectedFolderId(targetFolderId);
      setCurrentFileId(uploaded.id);
    } catch (error) {
      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
        ...currentMessages,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          text: `文件上传失败: ${error.message}`,
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      event.target.value = "";
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = chatInput.trim();
    if (!question) {
      return;
    }

    setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
      ...currentMessages,
      { role: "user", text: question },

    if (!currentFile || !currentFile.previewUrl) {

      ]);

    setIsAsking(true);

        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
        currentFileText: currentFile.extractedText || "",
      });

      const citationText =
        Array.isArray(response.citations) && response.citations.length
          ? `\n参考来源: ${response.citations.join(" · ")}`
          : "";

      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
        ...currentMessages,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          text: `${response.answer}${citationText}`,
        },
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
        ...currentMessages,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          text: `问答接口调用失败: ${error.message}`,
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsAsking(false);
    }
  }

  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
}

.tree-file {
  padding-left: 16px;
}

.tree-file::before {
  content: "";
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--marker);
  flex: 0 0 6px;
}

.tree-file-name {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.tree-file.active .tree-file-name {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.tree-empty {
  padding: 2px 12px 8px 14px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.preview-stage {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.preview-stage iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 84px);
  border: none;
  background: #ffffff;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .preview-stage iframe {
  background: #1a1c20;
}

.empty-preview {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: calc(100vh - 84px);
  padding: 32px 24px;
}

.empty-preview h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.upload-card {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 18px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: var(--line-width) dashed var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.upload-card-large {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 360px;
}

.upload-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.upload-copy {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 96px;
  resize: vertical;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
}

textarea:focus,
input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--border-focus);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring);
}

.chat-messages {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.message {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.message.user {
  background: var(--selection);
}

.message.assistant {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.message strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.message p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  white-space: pre-line;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.chat-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.primary-button {
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 11px 14px;
  background: var(--button-bg);
  color: var(--button-text);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.primary-button:hover {
  background: var(--button-hover);
}

@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 260px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .chat-column {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .chat-shell,
  .file-tree-panel,
  .sidebar,
  .main-column,
  .chat-column {
    min-height: auto;
    height: auto;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .preview-toolbar {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .preview-toolbar-actions {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .preview-stage iframe,
  .empty-preview {
    min-height: 480px;
  }

  .chat-shell,
  .file-tree-panel,
  .sidebar,
  .main-column,
  .chat-column {
    min-height: auto;
    height: auto;
  }
}

const API_CONFIG = {
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:8000/api",
  useMock: true,
  endpoints: {
    upload: "/files/upload",
    chat: "/qa/ask",
  },
};

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function createUrl(path) {
  return `${API_CONFIG.baseUrl}${path}`;
}

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(createUrl(path), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(options.headers || {}),
    },
    ...options,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`请求失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function uploadCourseFile(file) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(300);
    const isPdf =
      (file.type && file.type.includes("pdf")) || file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");

    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      name: file.name,
      type: file.type || "application/octet-stream",
      size: file.size,
      previewUrl: isPdf ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : "",
      extractedText: `Mock 文本索引已生成，可用于右侧问答。文件名: ${file.name}`,
    };
  }

  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append("file", file);

  const response = await fetch(createUrl(API_CONFIG.endpoints.upload), {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`文件上传失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function askFileQuestion(payload) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(650);
    return {
      answer: `根据当前 PDF 内容，你的问题“${payload.question}”大概率与第 ${Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(Math.random() * 15),
      )} 页相关。接真接口后，这里可以返回精确页码、原文片段和解释。`,
      citations: ["当前文件文本索引"],
    };
  }

  return request(API_CONFIG.endpoints.chat, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

export const apiConfig = API_CONFIG;
