# 课堂 PDF 智能定位助手

这个项目已经按你当前的页面架构重建为 `React + Vite`：

1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
3. 每个文件夹右侧有三点菜单，可修改名称、删除、查看“在文件管理器中显示”入口。
4. 如果没有选择已有文件夹，新建工作区会默认归到 `~/Documents` 下对应名称的目录。
5. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域，上传文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹。
6. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
7. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。

说明：
Web 版浏览器不能真正拉起系统文件管理器，所以“在文件管理器中显示”目前是占位交互。封装成桌面 App 后可以接原生能力。

## 项目结构

- `index.html`: Vite 入口
- `vite.config.js`: Vite 配置
- `src/main.jsx`: React 挂载入口
- `src/App.jsx`: 主界面与交互逻辑
- `src/api.js`: 上传和问答接口层
- `src/styles.css`: 主题与布局样式

## 启动方式

先安装依赖：

```bash
npm install
```

开发模式运行：

```bash
npm run dev
```

默认会输出本地访问地址，通常是：

```text
http://localhost:5173
```

## 后端接口对接

当前 `src/api.js` 默认使用 Mock 模式。后续只需要替换两个方法：

- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口

推荐返回字段：

```json
{
  "id": "file_001",
  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
  "type": "application/pdf",
  "previewUrl": "https://...",
  "extractedText": "整份文件抽取后的文本"
}
```

{
  "answer": "老师刚才提到的内容大约在第 12 页",
  "citations": ["第12页原文", "当前文件文本索引"]
}
```

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { GlobalWorkerOptions, getDocument } from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.mjs";
import workerSource from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url";

const DEFAULT_SCALE = 1.1;
const MIN_SCALE = 0.8;
const MAX_SCALE = 2;
const SCALE_STEP = 0.15;

GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerSource;

function formatScale(scale) {
  return `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
}

function getErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error?.name === "InvalidPDFException") {
    return "这个文件不是有效的 PDF。";
  }

  if (error?.name === "MissingPDFException") {
    return "没有找到可加载的 PDF 文件。";
  }

  return "PDF 加载失败，请检查文件内容或预览地址。";
}

export default function PdfPreview({ file }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const renderTaskRef = useRef(null);
  const [pdfDocument, setPdfDocument] = useState(null);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [pageNumber, setPageNumber] = useState(1);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(DEFAULT_SCALE);
  const [isLoadingDocument, setIsLoadingDocument] = useState(false);
  const [isRenderingPage, setIsRenderingPage] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setPdfDocument(null);
    setPageCount(0);
    setPageNumber(1);
    setScale(DEFAULT_SCALE);
    setErrorMessage("");
    renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();

    if (!file?.previewUrl) {
      setIsLoadingDocument(false);
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;
    const loadingTask = getDocument({
      url: file.previewUrl,
      isEvalSupported: false,
    });

    setIsLoadingDocument(true);

    loadingTask.promise
      .then((nextDocument) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          nextDocument.destroy().catch(() => {});
          return;
        }

        setPdfDocument(nextDocument);
        setPageCount(nextDocument.numPages);
        setPageNumber(1);
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          return;
        }

        setErrorMessage(getErrorMessage(error));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsLoadingDocument(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
      loadingTask.destroy();
    };
  }, [file?.id, file?.previewUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument) {
      return;
    }

    return () => {
      pdfDocument.destroy().catch(() => {});
    };
  }, [pdfDocument]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument || !canvasRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;

    async function renderPage() {
      setIsRenderingPage(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      try {
        const page = await pdfDocument.getPage(pageNumber);
        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;

        if (!canvas) {
          return;
        }

        const context = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false });

        if (!context) {
          setErrorMessage("当前浏览器无法初始化 PDF 画布。");
          return;
        }

        const outputScale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * outputScale);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * outputScale);
        canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(viewport.width)}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(viewport.height)}px`;
        context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
        const renderTask = page.render({
          canvasContext: context,
          viewport,
          transform: outputScale === 1 ? null : [outputScale, 0, 0, outputScale, 0, 0],
        });

        renderTaskRef.current = renderTask;
        await renderTask.promise;

        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsRenderingPage(false);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (isCancelled || error?.name === "RenderingCancelledException") {
          return;
        }

        setIsRenderingPage(false);
        setErrorMessage("PDF 页面渲染失败。");
      }
    }

    renderPage();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
    };
  }, [pageNumber, pdfDocument, scale]);

  function handlePreviousPage() {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.max(1, currentPage - 1));
  }

  function handleNextPage() {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.min(pageCount, currentPage + 1));
  }

  function handleZoomOut() {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.max(MIN_SCALE, Number((currentScale - SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  function handleZoomIn() {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Number((currentScale + SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="pdf-viewer">
      <div className="pdf-viewer-toolbar">
        <div className="pdf-viewer-status">
          {pageCount ? `第 ${pageNumber} / ${pageCount} 页` : "正在准备页面"}
        </div>
        <div className="pdf-viewer-controls">
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePreviousPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber <= 1}
          >
            上一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNextPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber >= pageCount}
          >
            下一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomOut}
            disabled={scale <= MIN_SCALE}
          >
            缩小
          </button>
          <span className="viewer-scale">{formatScale(scale)}</span>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomIn}
            disabled={scale >= MAX_SCALE}
          >
            放大
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="pdf-canvas-wrap">
        {errorMessage ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>预览不可用</strong>
            <p>{errorMessage}</p>
          </div>
        ) : isLoadingDocument ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>正在加载 PDF</strong>
            <p>文件已经导入，正在用 PDF.js 生成预览。</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {isRenderingPage ? <div className="pdf-rendering-badge">渲染中</div> : null}
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="pdf-canvas" />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

import { GlobalWorkerOptions, getDocument } from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.mjs";
import workerSource from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url";

const DEFAULT_SCALE = 1.1;
const MIN_SCALE = 0.8;
const MAX_SCALE = 2;
const SCALE_STEP = 0.15;

GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerSource;

function formatScale(scale) {
  return `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
}

function getErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error?.name === "InvalidPDFException") {
    return "这个文件不是有效的 PDF。";
  }

  if (error?.name === "MissingPDFException") {
    return "没有找到可加载的 PDF 文件。";
  }

  return "PDF 加载失败，请检查文件内容或预览地址。";
}

export default function PdfPreview({ file }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const renderTaskRef = useRef(null);
  const [pdfDocument, setPdfDocument] = useState(null);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [pageNumber, setPageNumber] = useState(1);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(DEFAULT_SCALE);
  const [isLoadingDocument, setIsLoadingDocument] = useState(false);
  const [isRenderingPage, setIsRenderingPage] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setPdfDocument(null);
    setPageCount(0);
    setPageNumber(1);
    setScale(DEFAULT_SCALE);
    setErrorMessage("");
    renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();

    if (!file?.previewUrl) {
      setIsLoadingDocument(false);
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;
    const loadingTask = getDocument({
      url: file.previewUrl,
      isEvalSupported: false,
    });

    setIsLoadingDocument(true);

    loadingTask.promise
      .then((nextDocument) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          nextDocument.destroy().catch(() => {});
          return;
        }

        setPdfDocument(nextDocument);
        setPageCount(nextDocument.numPages);
        setPageNumber(1);
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          return;
        }

        setErrorMessage(getErrorMessage(error));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsLoadingDocument(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
      loadingTask.destroy();
    };
  }, [file?.id, file?.previewUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument) {
      return;
    }

    return () => {
      pdfDocument.destroy().catch(() => {});
    };
  }, [pdfDocument]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument || !canvasRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;

    async function renderPage() {
      setIsRenderingPage(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      try {
        const page = await pdfDocument.getPage(pageNumber);
        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;

        if (!canvas) {
          return;
        }

        const context = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false });

        if (!context) {
          setErrorMessage("当前浏览器无法初始化 PDF 画布。");
          return;
        }

        const outputScale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * outputScale);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * outputScale);
        canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(viewport.width)}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(viewport.height)}px`;
        context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
        const renderTask = page.render({
          canvasContext: context,
          viewport,
          transform: outputScale === 1 ? null : [outputScale, 0, 0, outputScale, 0, 0],
        });

        renderTaskRef.current = renderTask;
        await renderTask.promise;

        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsRenderingPage(false);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (isCancelled || error?.name === "RenderingCancelledException") {
          return;
        }

        setIsRenderingPage(false);
        setErrorMessage("PDF 页面渲染失败。");
      }
    }

    renderPage();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
    };
  }, [pageNumber, pdfDocument, scale]);

  function handlePreviousPage() {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.max(1, currentPage - 1));
  }

  function handleNextPage() {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.min(pageCount, currentPage + 1));
  }

  function handleZoomOut() {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.max(MIN_SCALE, Number((currentScale - SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  function handleZoomIn() {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Number((currentScale + SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="pdf-viewer">
      <div className="pdf-viewer-toolbar">
        <div className="pdf-viewer-status">
          {pageCount ? `第 ${pageNumber} / ${pageCount} 页` : "正在准备页面"}
        </div>
        <div className="pdf-viewer-controls">
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePreviousPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber <= 1}
          >
            上一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNextPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber >= pageCount}
          >
            下一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomOut}
            disabled={scale <= MIN_SCALE}
          >
            缩小
          </button>
          <span className="viewer-scale">{formatScale(scale)}</span>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomIn}
            disabled={scale >= MAX_SCALE}
          >
            放大
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="pdf-canvas-wrap">
        {errorMessage ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>预览不可用</strong>
            <p>{errorMessage}</p>
          </div>
        ) : isLoadingDocument ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>正在加载 PDF</strong>
            <p>文件已经导入，正在用 PDF.js 生成预览。</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {isRenderingPage ? <div className="pdf-rendering-badge">渲染中</div> : null}
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="pdf-canvas" />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

   697	            <button className="primary-button" type="submit" disabled={isAsking}>

   699	            </button>

   707	export default App;

     1	# 课堂 PDF 智能定位助手
     2	
     3	这个项目已经按你当前的页面架构重建为 `React + Vite`：
     4	
     5	1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
     6	2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
     7	3. 每个文件夹右侧有三点菜单，可修改名称、删除、查看“在文件管理器中显示”入口。
     8	4. 如果没有选择已有文件夹，新建工作区会默认归到 `~/Documents` 下对应名称的目录。
     9	5. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域，上传文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹，并由 `PDF.js` 渲染预览。
    10	6. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
    11	7. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。
    12	
    13	说明：
    14	Web 版浏览器不能真正拉起系统文件管理器，所以“在文件管理器中显示”目前是占位交互。封装成桌面 App 后可以接原生能力。
    15	
    16	## 项目结构
    17	
    18	- `index.html`: Vite 入口
    19	- `vite.config.js`: Vite 配置
    20	- `src/main.jsx`: React 挂载入口
    21	- `src/App.jsx`: 主界面与交互逻辑
    22	- `src/PdfPreview.jsx`: 基于 `PDF.js` 的预览组件
    23	- `src/api.js`: 上传和问答接口层
    24	- `src/styles.css`: 主题与布局样式
    25	
    26	## 启动方式
    27	
    28	先安装依赖：
    29	
    30	```bash
    31	npm install
    32	```
    33	
    34	开发模式运行：
    35	
    36	```bash
    37	npm run dev
    38	```
    39	
    40	默认会输出本地访问地址，通常是：
    41	
    42	```text
    43	http://localhost:5173
    44	```
    45	
    46	## 后端接口对接
    47	
    48	当前 `src/api.js` 默认使用 Mock 模式。后续只需要替换两个方法：
    49	
    50	- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
    51	- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口
    52	
    53	推荐返回字段：
    54	
    55	```json
    56	{
    57	  "id": "file_001",
    58	  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
    59	  "type": "application/pdf",
    60	  "previewUrl": "https://...",
    61	  "extractedText": "整份文件抽取后的文本"
    62	}
    63	```
    64	
    65	```json
    66	{
    67	  "answer": "老师刚才提到的内容大约在第 12 页",
    68	  "citations": ["第12页原文", "当前文件文本索引"]
    69	}
    70	```

## Assistant

因为它现在就是占位实现，不是真正的“打开文件管理器”。你点这个菜单时，代码直接执行的是 `window.alert(...)`，所以只会弹窗，不会拉起 Finder 或资源管理器。【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/App.jsx†L320-L334】

原因有两层：

- 现在这是纯浏览器版 Web 应用，浏览器本身没有权限直接命令系统“打开某个文件夹”。README 里也已经写了这点：Web 版不能真正拉起系统文件管理器。【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/README.md†L13-L14】
- 你现在的两类工作区里，`documents` 类型其实只是前端按 `~/Documents/名称` 生成的逻辑路径，还没有真的在系统里创建文件夹；`system` 类型虽然能通过 `showDirectoryPicker()` 选到已有文件夹，但浏览器也只能拿到访问句柄，不能直接“在文件管理器中显示”。【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/App.jsx†L200-L206】【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/App.jsx†L221-L230】【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/App.jsx†L320-L334】

如果你要这个功能真的可用，只有两条路：

1. 保持 Web 版  
把这个菜单改成“查看路径”或“复制路径”，不要叫“在文件管理器中显示”。

2. 做成桌面 App  
用 `Electron` 或 `Tauri`，然后接系统 API 去真正打开文件夹。这个才是正确实现。

如果你要，我下一步可以直接把这个菜单先改成更准确的 Web 版文案，或者继续帮你把它按 `Electron/Tauri` 的方式预留接口。

import { app, BrowserWindow, dialog, ipcMain, shell } from "electron";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const devServerUrl = process.env.VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL;

function getDocumentsDisplayPath(folderName) {
  return `~/Documents/${folderName}`;
}

function getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName) {
  return path.join(app.getPath("documents"), folderName);
}

async function ensureDirectory(folderPath) {
  await fs.mkdir(folderPath, { recursive: true });
}

async function createMainWindow() {
  const mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1480,
    height: 940,
    minWidth: 1180,
    minHeight: 760,
    backgroundColor: "#0f1115",
    autoHideMenuBar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      preload: path.join(__dirname, "preload.js"),
    },
  });

  if (devServerUrl) {
    await mainWindow.loadURL(devServerUrl);
    return;
  }

  await mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(projectRoot, "dist", "index.html"));
}

ipcMain.handle("workspace:create-documents-folder", async (_, folderName) => {
  const nextName = String(folderName || "").trim();
  if (!nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);
  await ensureDirectory(folderPath);

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:rename-documents-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const currentName = String(payload?.currentName || "").trim();
  const nextName = String(payload?.nextName || "").trim();

  if (!currentName || !nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const currentPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(currentName);
  const nextPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);

  if (currentPath !== nextPath) {
    try {
      await fs.rename(currentPath, nextPath);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error?.code === "ENOENT") {
        await ensureDirectory(nextPath);
      } else {
        return { ok: false, message: "重命名工作区文件夹失败。" };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath: nextPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:pick-existing-folder", async () => {
  const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog({
    title: "选择已有工作区文件夹",
    properties: ["openDirectory"],
  });

  if (result.canceled || !result.filePaths.length) {
    return null;
  }

  const folderPath = result.filePaths[0];

  return {
    name: path.basename(folderPath),
    folderPath,
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:reveal-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const sourceType = payload?.sourceType;
  const folderName = String(payload?.folderName || "").trim();
  let folderPath = String(payload?.folderPath || "").trim();

  if (sourceType === "documents") {
    if (!folderName) {
      return { ok: false, message: "缺少工作区名称。" };
    }

    folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName);
    await ensureDirectory(folderPath);
  }

  if (!folderPath) {
    return { ok: false, message: "没有可显示的文件夹路径。" };
  }

  const openError = await shell.openPath(folderPath);
  if (openError) {
    return { ok: false, message: openError };
  }

  return { ok: true };
});

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  await createMainWindow();

  app.on("activate", async () => {
    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) {
      await createMainWindow();
    }
  });
});

app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
  if (process.platform !== "darwin") {
    app.quit();
  }
});

```

import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } from "electron";

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld("desktopBridge", {
  isDesktop: true,
  createDocumentsWorkspace(folderName) {
    return ipcRenderer.invoke("workspace:create-documents-folder", folderName);
  },
  renameDocumentsWorkspace(payload) {
    return ipcRenderer.invoke("workspace:rename-documents-folder", payload);
  },
  pickExistingFolder() {
    return ipcRenderer.invoke("workspace:pick-existing-folder");
  },
  revealWorkspaceFolder(payload) {
    return ipcRenderer.invoke("workspace:reveal-folder", payload);
  },
});

const DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH = "~/Documents";
function buildDefaultFolderPath(folderName) {
  return `${DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH}/${folderName}`;
}

function getDesktopBridge() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  return window.desktopBridge || null;
}
  async function handleCreateFolder(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const folderName = newFolderName.trim();
    if (!folderName) {
      return;
    }

    const desktopBridge = getDesktopBridge();
    let nextFolder = {
      id: createFolderId(),
      name: folderName,
      expanded: true,
      sourceType: "documents",
      folderPath: buildDefaultFolderPath(folderName),
      nativePath: "",
    };

    if (desktopBridge?.createDocumentsWorkspace) {
      const created = await desktopBridge.createDocumentsWorkspace(folderName);
      if (!created?.ok) {
        window.alert(created?.message || "创建工作区文件夹失败。");
        return;
      }

      nextFolder = {
        ...nextFolder,
        folderPath: created.displayPath || buildDefaultFolderPath(folderName),
        nativePath: created.folderPath || "",
      };
    }

    setFolders((currentFolders) => [nextFolder, ...currentFolders]);
    setSelectedFolderId(nextFolder.id);
    setIsCreateMenuOpen(false);
  async function handlePickExistingFolder() {
    const desktopBridge = getDesktopBridge();
    if (desktopBridge?.pickExistingFolder) {
      const selected = await desktopBridge.pickExistingFolder();
      if (!selected?.folderPath) {
        return;
      }

      const nextFolder = {
        id: createFolderId(),
        name: selected.name,
        expanded: true,
        sourceType: "system",
        folderPath: selected.folderPath,
        nativePath: selected.folderPath,
      };

      setFolders((currentFolders) => [nextFolder, ...currentFolders]);
      setSelectedFolderId(nextFolder.id);
      setIsCreateMenuOpen(false);
      setCreateMode(null);
      setNewFolderName("");
      return;
    }

    if (typeof window.showDirectoryPicker !== "function") {
      window.alert("当前浏览器不支持选择本地文件夹。这个入口在桌面 App 里可以接成真实能力。");

        id: createFolderId(),
        name: handle.name,
        expanded: true,
        sourceType: "system",
        systemHandle: handle,
        folderPath: handle.name,
        nativePath: "",
      };

      return;

      return;
    }

    let nextFolderPath = targetFolder.folderPath;
    let nextNativePath = targetFolder.nativePath || "";

    if (targetFolder.sourceType === "documents") {
      if (desktopBridge?.renameDocumentsWorkspace) {
        const renamed = await desktopBridge.renameDocumentsWorkspace({
          currentName: targetFolder.name,
          nextName,
        });

        if (!renamed?.ok) {
          window.alert(renamed?.message || "修改工作区名称失败。");
          return;
        }

        nextFolderPath = renamed.displayPath || buildDefaultFolderPath(nextName);
        nextNativePath = renamed.folderPath || "";
      } else {
        nextFolderPath = buildDefaultFolderPath(nextName);
      }
    }

    setFolders((currentFolders) =>
      currentFolders.map((folder) =>
        folder.id === folderId

              name: nextName,
              folderPath: nextFolderPath,
              nativePath: nextNativePath || folder.nativePath || "",
            }
          : folder,
      ),

Diff: /Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/README.md
```
说明：
Web 版浏览器不能真正拉起系统文件管理器，所以“在文件管理器中显示”在浏览器里仍然是占位交互。
Electron 桌面版会真正调用系统文件管理器打开对应工作区文件夹。
- `src/main.jsx`: React 挂载入口
- `src/App.jsx`: 主界面与交互逻辑
- `src/PdfPreview.jsx`: 基于 `PDF.js` 的预览组件
- `src/api.js`: 上传和问答接口层
- `src/styles.css`: 主题与布局样式
- `electron/main.js`: Electron 主进程
- `electron/preload.js`: 桌面能力桥接层
开发模式运行：
npm run dev
```

默认会输出本地访问地址，通常是：
http://localhost:5173
```

桌面版开发运行：

```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```

如果已经构建过前端，也可以直接启动桌面壳：

```bash
npm run build
npm run start:desktop
```
```

  const nextName = String(payload?.nextName || "").trim();

  if (!currentName || !nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const currentPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(currentName);
  const nextPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);

  if (currentPath !== nextPath) {
    try {
      await fs.rename(currentPath, nextPath);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error?.code === "ENOENT") {
        await ensureDirectory(nextPath);
      } else {
        return { ok: false, message: "重命名工作区文件夹失败。" };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath: nextPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:pick-existing-folder", async () => {
  const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog({
    title: "选择已有工作区文件夹",
    properties: ["openDirectory"],
  });

  if (result.canceled || !result.filePaths.length) {
    return null;
  }

  const folderPath = result.filePaths[0];

  return {
    name: path.basename(folderPath),
    folderPath,
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:reveal-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const sourceType = payload?.sourceType;
  const folderName = String(payload?.folderName || "").trim();
  let folderPath = String(payload?.folderPath || "").trim();

  if (sourceType === "documents") {
    if (!folderName) {
      return { ok: false, message: "缺少工作区名称。" };
    }

    folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName);
    await ensureDirectory(folderPath);
  }

  if (!folderPath) {
    return { ok: false, message: "没有可显示的文件夹路径。" };
  }

  const openError = await shell.openPath(folderPath);
  if (openError) {
    return { ok: false, message: openError };
  }

  return { ok: true };
});

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  await createMainWindow();

  app.on("activate", async () => {
    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) {
      await createMainWindow();
    }
  });
});

app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
  if (process.platform !== "darwin") {
    app.quit();
  }
});

     1	# 课堂 PDF 智能定位助手
     2	
     3	这个项目已经按你当前的页面架构重建为 `React + Vite`：
     4	
     5	1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
     6	2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
     7	3. 每个文件夹右侧有三点菜单，可修改名称、删除、查看“在文件管理器中显示”入口。
     8	4. 如果没有选择已有文件夹，新建工作区会默认归到 `~/Documents` 下对应名称的目录。
     9	5. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域，上传文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹，并由 `PDF.js` 渲染预览。
    10	6. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
    11	7. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。
    12	
    13	说明：
    14	Web 版浏览器不能真正拉起系统文件管理器，所以“在文件管理器中显示”在浏览器里仍然是占位交互。
    15	Electron 桌面版会真正调用系统文件管理器打开对应工作区文件夹。
    16	
    17	## 项目结构
    18	
    19	- `index.html`: Vite 入口
    20	- `vite.config.js`: Vite 配置
    21	- `src/main.jsx`: React 挂载入口
    22	- `src/App.jsx`: 主界面与交互逻辑
    23	- `src/PdfPreview.jsx`: 基于 `PDF.js` 的预览组件
    24	- `src/api.js`: 上传和问答接口层
    25	- `src/styles.css`: 主题与布局样式
    26	- `electron/main.js`: Electron 主进程
    27	- `electron/preload.js`: 桌面能力桥接层
    28	
    29	## 启动方式
    30	
    31	先安装依赖：
    32	
    33	```bash
    34	npm install
    35	```
    36	
    37	开发模式运行：
    38	
    39	```bash
    40	npm run dev
    41	```
    42	
    43	默认会输出本地访问地址，通常是：
    44	
    45	```text
    46	http://localhost:5173
    47	```
    48	
    49	桌面版开发运行：
    50	
    51	```bash
    52	npm run dev:desktop
    53	```
    54	
    55	如果已经构建过前端，也可以直接启动桌面壳：
    56	
    57	```bash
    58	npm run build
    59	npm run start:desktop
    60	```
    61	
    62	## 后端接口对接
    63	
    64	当前 `src/api.js` 默认使用 Mock 模式。后续只需要替换两个方法：
    65	
    66	- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
    67	- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口

#!/usr/bin/env node

const { downloadArtifact } = require('@electron/get');

const extract = require('extract-zip');

const childProcess = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

const { version } = require('./package');

if (process.env.ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD) {
  process.exit(0);
}

const platformPath = getPlatformPath();

if (isInstalled()) {
  process.exit(0);
}

const platform = process.env.npm_config_platform || process.platform;
let arch = process.env.npm_config_arch || process.arch;

if (platform === 'darwin' && process.platform === 'darwin' && arch === 'x64' &&
    process.env.npm_config_arch === undefined) {
  // When downloading for macOS ON macOS and we think we need x64 we should
  // check if we're running under rosetta and download the arm64 version if appropriate
  try {
    const output = childProcess.execSync('sysctl -in sysctl.proc_translated');
    if (output.toString().trim() === '1') {
      arch = 'arm64';
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore failure
  }
}

// downloads if not cached
downloadArtifact({
  version,
  artifactName: 'electron',
  force: process.env.force_no_cache === 'true',
  cacheRoot: process.env.electron_config_cache,
  checksums: process.env.electron_use_remote_checksums ?? process.env.npm_config_electron_use_remote_checksums ? undefined : require('./checksums.json'),
  platform,
  arch
}).then(extractFile).catch(err => {
  console.error(err.stack);
  process.exit(1);
});

function isInstalled () {
  try {
    if (fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'dist', 'version'), 'utf-8').replace(/^v/, '') !== version) {
      return false;
    }

    if (fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'path.txt'), 'utf-8') !== platformPath) {
      return false;
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }

  const electronPath = process.env.ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH || path.join(__dirname, 'dist', platformPath);

  return fs.existsSync(electronPath);
}

// unzips and makes path.txt point at the correct executable
function extractFile (zipPath) {
  const distPath = process.env.ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH || path.join(__dirname, 'dist');

  return extract(zipPath, { dir: path.join(__dirname, 'dist') }).then(() => {
    // If the zip contains an "electron.d.ts" file,
    // move that up
    const srcTypeDefPath = path.join(distPath, 'electron.d.ts');
    const targetTypeDefPath = path.join(__dirname, 'electron.d.ts');
    const hasTypeDefinitions = fs.existsSync(srcTypeDefPath);

    if (hasTypeDefinitions) {
      fs.renameSync(srcTypeDefPath, targetTypeDefPath);
    }

    // Write a "path.txt" file.
    return fs.promises.writeFile(path.join(__dirname, 'path.txt'), platformPath);
  });
}

function getPlatformPath () {
  const platform = process.env.npm_config_platform || os.platform();

  switch (platform) {
    case 'mas':
    case 'darwin':
      return 'Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron';
    case 'freebsd':
    case 'openbsd':
    case 'linux':
      return 'electron';
    case 'win32':
      return 'electron.exe';
    default:
      throw new Error('Electron builds are not available on platform: ' + platform);
  }
}

View these docs in other languages on our [Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/electron) project.

The Electron framework lets you write cross-platform desktop applications
using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. It is based on [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) and
[Chromium](https://www.chromium.org) and is used by the
[Visual Studio Code](https://github.com/Microsoft/vscode/) and many other [apps](https://electronjs.org/apps).

Follow [@electronjs](https://twitter.com/electronjs) on Twitter for important
announcements.

This project adheres to the Contributor Covenant
[code of conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/tree/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
By participating, you are expected to uphold this code. Please report unacceptable
behavior to [coc@electronjs.org](mailto:coc@electronjs.org).

## Installation

To install prebuilt Electron binaries, use [`npm`](https://docs.npmjs.com/).
The preferred method is to install Electron as a development dependency in your
app:

```sh
npm install electron --save-dev
```

For more installation options and troubleshooting tips, see
[installation](docs/tutorial/installation.md). For info on how to manage Electron versions in your apps, see
[Electron versioning](docs/tutorial/electron-versioning.md).

## Platform support

Each Electron release provides binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

* macOS (Big Sur and up): Electron provides 64-bit Intel and Apple Silicon / ARM binaries for macOS.
* Windows (Windows 10 and up): Electron provides `ia32` (`x86`), `x64` (`amd64`), and `arm64` binaries for Windows. Windows on ARM support was added in Electron 5.0.8. Support for Windows 7, 8 and 8.1 was [removed in Electron 23, in line with Chromium's Windows deprecation policy](https://www.electronjs.org/blog/windows-7-to-8-1-deprecation-notice).
* Linux: The prebuilt binaries of Electron are built on Ubuntu 20.04. They have also been verified to work on:
  * Ubuntu 18.04 and newer
  * Fedora 32 and newer
  * Debian 10 and newer

## Quick start & Electron Fiddle

Use [`Electron Fiddle`](https://github.com/electron/fiddle)
to build, run, and package small Electron experiments, to see code examples for all of Electron's APIs, and
to try out different versions of Electron. It's designed to make the start of your journey with
Electron easier.

Alternatively, clone and run the
[electron/electron-quick-start](https://github.com/electron/electron-quick-start)
repository to see a minimal Electron app in action:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/electron/electron-quick-start
cd electron-quick-start
npm install
npm start
```

## Resources for learning Electron

* [electronjs.org/docs](https://electronjs.org/docs) - All of Electron's documentation
* [electron/fiddle](https://github.com/electron/fiddle) - A tool to build, run, and package small Electron experiments
* [electron/electron-quick-start](https://github.com/electron/electron-quick-start) - A very basic starter Electron app
* [electronjs.org/community#boilerplates](https://electronjs.org/community#boilerplates) - Sample starter apps created by the community

## Programmatic usage

Most people use Electron from the command line, but if you require `electron` inside
your **Node app** (not your Electron app) it will return the file path to the
binary. Use this to spawn Electron from Node scripts:

```javascript
const electron = require('electron')
const proc = require('node:child_process')

// will print something similar to /Users/maf/.../Electron
console.log(electron)

// spawn Electron
const child = proc.spawn(electron)
```

### Mirrors

* [China](https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/)

See the [Advanced Installation Instructions](https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/installation#mirror) to learn how to use a custom mirror.

## Documentation translations

We crowdsource translations for our documentation via [Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/electron).
We currently accept translations for Chinese (Simplified), French, German, Japanese, Portuguese,
Russian, and Spanish.

## Contributing

If you are interested in reporting/fixing issues and contributing directly to the code base, please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for more information on what we're looking for and how to get started.

## Community

Info on reporting bugs, getting help, finding third-party tools and sample apps,
and more can be found on the [Community page](https://www.electronjs.org/community).

import { app, BrowserWindow, dialog, ipcMain, shell } from "electron";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const devServerUrl = process.env.VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL;

function getDocumentsDisplayPath(folderName) {
  return `~/Documents/${folderName}`;
}

function getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName) {
  return path.join(app.getPath("documents"), folderName);
}

async function ensureDirectory(folderPath) {
  await fs.mkdir(folderPath, { recursive: true });
}

async function createMainWindow() {
  const mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1480,
    height: 940,
    minWidth: 1180,
    minHeight: 760,
    backgroundColor: "#0f1115",
    autoHideMenuBar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      preload: path.join(__dirname, "preload.cjs"),
    },
  });

  if (devServerUrl) {
    await mainWindow.loadURL(devServerUrl);
    return;
  }

  await mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(projectRoot, "dist", "index.html"));
}

ipcMain.handle("workspace:create-documents-folder", async (_, folderName) => {
  const nextName = String(folderName || "").trim();
  if (!nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);
  await ensureDirectory(folderPath);

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:rename-documents-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const currentName = String(payload?.currentName || "").trim();
  const nextName = String(payload?.nextName || "").trim();

  if (!currentName || !nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const currentPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(currentName);
  const nextPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);

  if (currentPath !== nextPath) {
    try {
      await fs.rename(currentPath, nextPath);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error?.code === "ENOENT") {
        await ensureDirectory(nextPath);
      } else {
        return { ok: false, message: "重命名工作区文件夹失败。" };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath: nextPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:pick-existing-folder", async () => {
  const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog({
    title: "选择已有工作区文件夹",
    properties: ["openDirectory"],
  });

  if (result.canceled || !result.filePaths.length) {
    return null;
  }

  const folderPath = result.filePaths[0];

  return {
    name: path.basename(folderPath),
    folderPath,
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:reveal-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const sourceType = payload?.sourceType;
  const folderName = String(payload?.folderName || "").trim();
  let folderPath = String(payload?.folderPath || "").trim();

  if (sourceType === "documents") {
    if (!folderName) {
      return { ok: false, message: "缺少工作区名称。" };
    }

    folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName);
    await ensureDirectory(folderPath);
  }

  if (!folderPath) {
    return { ok: false, message: "没有可显示的文件夹路径。" };
  }

  const openError = await shell.openPath(folderPath);
  if (openError) {
    return { ok: false, message: openError };
  }

  return { ok: true };
});

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  await createMainWindow();

  app.on("activate", async () => {
    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) {
      await createMainWindow();
    }
  });
});

app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
  if (process.platform !== "darwin") {
    app.quit();
  }
});

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(event) {

    if (!question) {
      return;
    }

    setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
      ...currentMessages,
      { role: "user", text: question },
    ]);
    setChatInput("");

    if (!currentFile || !currentFile.previewUrl) {
      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [

    setIsAsking(true);

        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
        currentFileText: currentFile.extractedText || "",
      });

        Array.isArray(response.citations) && response.citations.length
          ? `\n参考来源: ${response.citations.join(" · ")}`
          : "";

      setChatMessages((currentMessages) => [
        ...currentMessages,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          text: `${response.answer}${citationText}`,
        },
      ]);

                className={`icon-button ${isCreateMenuOpen ? "active" : ""}`}
                type="button"
                aria-label="创建文件夹"
                onClick={handleToggleCreateMenu}
              >
                +
              </button>

              {isCreateMenuOpen ? (
                <div className="action-menu create-menu">
                  <div className="menu-label">工作区文件夹</div>
                  {createMode === "new" ? (
                    <form className="menu-inline-form" onSubmit={handleCreateFolder}>
                      <label className="menu-field-label" htmlFor="new-folder-name">
                        名称
                      </label>
                      <input
                        id="new-folder-name"
                        className="menu-input"
                        type="text"
                        value={newFolderName}
                        placeholder="输入新文件夹名称"
                        onChange={(event) => setNewFolderName(event.target.value)}
                      />
                      <div className="menu-actions">
                        <button className="menu-button-primary" type="submit">
                          创建
                        </button>
                        <button
                          className="menu-button-secondary"
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setCreateMode(null);
                            setNewFolderName("");
                          }}
                        >
                          取消
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </form>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <button className="menu-option" type="button" onClick={handleStartCreateFolder}>
                        新建文件夹
                      </button>
                      <button className="menu-option" type="button" onClick={handlePickExistingFolder}>
                        选择已有文件夹
                      </button>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="folder-tree">
            {folders.map((folder) => {
              const folderFiles = getFilesByFolder(folder.id);

              return (
                <article className="folder-item" key={folder.id}>
                  <div
                    className={`folder-row ${folder.expanded ? "active" : ""} ${
                      selectedFolderId === folder.id ? "selected" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    <button
                      className="folder-toggle"
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleToggleFolder(folder.id)}
                    >
                      <span className="folder-chevron">{folder.expanded ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
                      <span className="folder-name">{folder.name}</span>
                      <span className="folder-meta">{folderFiles.length}</span>
                    </button>

                    <div className="folder-menu-wrapper" data-folder-menu-root="">
                      <button
                        className={`folder-menu-button ${openFolderMenuId === folder.id ? "active" : ""}`}
                        type="button"
                        aria-label={`${folder.name} 设置`}
                        onClick={() => handleToggleFolderMenu(folder.id)}
                      >
                        ...
                      </button>

                      {openFolderMenuId === folder.id ? (
                        <div className="action-menu folder-menu">
                          <div className="menu-label">名称</div>
                          {renameFolderId === folder.id ? (
                            <form
                              className="menu-inline-form"
                              onSubmit={(event) => handleRenameFolder(event, folder.id)}
                            >
                              <input
                                className="menu-input"
                                type="text"
                                value={renameValue}
                                onChange={(event) => setRenameValue(event.target.value)}
                              />
                              <div className="menu-actions">
                                <button className="menu-button-primary" type="submit">
                                  保存
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  className="menu-button-secondary"
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    setRenameFolderId(null);
                                    setRenameValue("");
                                  }}
                                >
                                  取消
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </form>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <div className="menu-name">{folder.name}</div>
                              <div className="menu-path">{folder.folderPath}</div>
                            </>
                          )}

                          <div className="menu-separator" />
                          <button
                            className="menu-option"
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleStartRenameFolder(folder)}
                          >
                            修改名称
                          </button>
                          <button
                            className="menu-option"
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleRevealFolder(folder)}
                          >
                            在文件管理器中显示
                          </button>
                          <button
                            className="menu-option danger"
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteFolder(folder.id)}
                          >
                            删除
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {folder.expanded ? (
                    <div className="folder-children">
                      {folderFiles.length ? (
                        folderFiles.map((file) => (
                          <button
                            className={`tree-file ${file.id === currentFileId ? "active" : ""}`}
                            key={file.id}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setCurrentFileId(file.id);
                              setSelectedFolderId(file.folderId);
                            }}
                          >
                            <span className="tree-file-name">{file.name}</span>
                          </button>
                        ))
                      ) : (
                        <div className="tree-empty">这个文件夹里还没有文件</div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
        </aside>

        <main className="main-column">
        <section className="preview-shell">
          <div className="preview-toolbar">
            <div>
              <h2 className="section-title">PDF 导入与预览</h2>
            </div>
            <div className="preview-toolbar-actions">
              <div className="theme-switch">
                <button
                  className={`theme-option ${theme === "light" ? "active" : ""}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTheme("light")}
                >
                  浅色
                </button>
                <button
                  className={`theme-option ${theme === "dark" ? "active" : ""}`}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTheme("dark")}
                >
                  深色
                </button>
              </div>
              <span className="panel-badge">{currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}</span>
              <input
                id="file-input"
                type="file"
                accept=".pdf"
                hidden
                onChange={handleUploadFile}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="preview-stage">
            {currentFile && currentFile.previewUrl ? (
              <PdfPreview file={currentFile} />
            ) : (
              <div className="empty-preview">
                <h3>上传 PDF 开始预览</h3>
                <p>左侧点击文件夹会展开文件，中间上传后的 PDF 会直接在这里预览。</p>
                <label className="upload-card upload-card-large" htmlFor="file-input">
                  <span className="upload-title">从这里上传 PDF</span>
                  <span className="upload-copy">
                    上传后的文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹
                    {selectedFolder ? `：${selectedFolder.name}` : ""}
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
        </main>

        <aside className="chat-column">
        <section className="chat-shell">
          <div className="panel-header">
            <div>
              <h2 className="section-title">课件问答</h2>
            </div>
            <span className="panel-badge">当前 PDF</span>
          </div>

          <div className="chat-messages" ref={chatMessagesRef}>
            {chatMessages.map((message, index) => (
              <article className={`message ${message.role}`} key={`${message.role}-${index}`}>
                <strong>{message.role === "assistant" ? "AI 助手" : "你"}</strong>
                <p>{message.text}</p>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>

          <form className="chat-form" onSubmit={handleSubmitQuestion}>
            <textarea
              value={chatInput}
              placeholder="例如：老师刚才讲到哪一页？这份 PDF 的重点内容是什么？"
              onChange={(event) => setChatInput(event.target.value)}
            />
            <button className="primary-button" type="submit" disabled={isAsking}>
              {isAsking ? "发送中" : "发送问题"}
            </button>
          </form>
        </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

## Assistant

已经做成第一版融合了。现在桌面窗口在 macOS 下会用 `hiddenInset` 隐藏原生标题栏，只保留系统红绿灯，并把它嵌进页面顶部这一层；前端也加了一条很薄的拖拽顶栏，和三栏界面放在同一个视觉系统里，不再是“系统标题栏一层 + 页面一层”的分离状态。【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/electron/main.js†L23-L40】【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/electron/preload.cjs†L1-L18】【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/App.jsx†L101-L104】【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/App.jsx†L527-L538】【F:/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/styles.css†L100-L162】

我已经跑过一次 `npm run build`，编译是通过的。你现在需要做的只有一件事：把 Electron 窗口彻底关掉，再重新执行：
```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```

如果你看完觉得方向对，但还想再收紧，我下一步可以继续做两种细化：

:root {
  --shell-gap: 14px;
  --shell-padding: 16px;

  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: var(--shell-padding);
}

.app-shell {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(0, 1fr) 360px;
  gap: var(--shell-gap);
  min-height: calc(100vh - (var(--shell-padding) * 2));
  height: calc(100vh - (var(--shell-padding) * 2));
  align-items: stretch;
}

.app-shell.has-topbar {
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.app-topbar {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: var(--window-toolbar-height);
  padding: 0 var(--window-toolbar-inset);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  app-region: drag;
  -webkit-app-region: drag;
}

.app-topbar-leading {
  width: 12px;
  min-width: 12px;
}

.app-shell.is-mac-desktop .app-topbar-leading {
  width: var(--mac-traffic-light-space);
  min-width: var(--mac-traffic-light-space);
}

.app-topbar-title,
.app-topbar-meta {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.app-topbar-title {
  justify-self: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.app-topbar-meta {
  justify-self: end;
  max-width: 280px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.app-shell.has-topbar > .sidebar,
.app-shell.has-topbar > .main-column,
.app-shell.has-topbar > .chat-column {
  grid-row: 2;
}

.sidebar,
.main-column,
.chat-column {
@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 260px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .app-topbar {
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  }

  .app-topbar-meta {
    display: none;
  }
}
  .app-topbar {
    padding: 0 14px;
  }

  .app-topbar-leading {
    width: 12px;
    min-width: 12px;
  }
}

                      <div className="folder-menu-wrapper" data-folder-menu-root="">
                        <button
                          className={`folder-menu-button ${openFolderMenuId === folder.id ? "active" : ""}`}
                          type="button"
                          aria-label={`${folder.name} 设置`}
                          onClick={() => handleToggleFolderMenu(folder.id)}
                        >
                          ...
                        </button>

                        {openFolderMenuId === folder.id ? (
                          <div className="action-menu folder-menu">
                            <div className="menu-label">名称</div>
                            {renameFolderId === folder.id ? (
                              <form
                                className="menu-inline-form"
                                onSubmit={(event) => handleRenameFolder(event, folder.id)}
                              >
                                <input
                                  className="menu-input"
                                  type="text"
                                  value={renameValue}
                                  onChange={(event) => setRenameValue(event.target.value)}
                                />
                                <div className="menu-actions">
                                  <button className="menu-button-primary" type="submit">
                                    保存
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    className="menu-button-secondary"
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      setRenameFolderId(null);
                                      setRenameValue("");
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    取消
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                              </form>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                <div className="menu-name">{folder.name}</div>
                                <div className="menu-path">{folder.folderPath}</div>
                              </>
                            )}

                            <div className="menu-separator" />
                            <button
                              className="menu-option"
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleStartRenameFolder(folder)}
                            >
                              修改名称
                            </button>
                            <button
                              className="menu-option"
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleRevealFolder(folder)}
                            >
                              在文件管理器中显示
                            </button>
                            <button
                              className="menu-option danger"
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleDeleteFolder(folder.id)}
                            >
                              删除
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {folder.expanded ? (
                      <div className="folder-children">
                        {folderFiles.length ? (
                          folderFiles.map((file) => (
                            <button
                              className={`tree-file ${file.id === currentFileId ? "active" : ""}`}
                              key={file.id}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setCurrentFileId(file.id);
                                setSelectedFolderId(file.folderId);
                              }}
                            >
                              <span className="tree-file-name">{file.name}</span>
                            </button>
                          ))
                        ) : (
                          <div className="tree-empty">这个文件夹里还没有文件</div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ) : null}
                  </article>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        </aside>

        <main className="main-column">
          <section className="preview-shell">
            <div className="preview-toolbar">
              <div>
                <h2 className="section-title">PDF 导入与预览</h2>
              </div>
              <div className="preview-toolbar-actions">
                <div className="theme-switch">
                  <button
                    className={`theme-option ${theme === "light" ? "active" : ""}`}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setTheme("light")}
                  >
                    浅色
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className={`theme-option ${theme === "dark" ? "active" : ""}`}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setTheme("dark")}
                  >
                    深色
                  </button>
                </div>
                <span className="panel-badge">{currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}</span>
                <input
                  id="file-input"
                  type="file"
                  accept=".pdf"
                  hidden
                  onChange={handleUploadFile}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="preview-stage">
              {currentFile && currentFile.previewUrl ? (
                <PdfPreview file={currentFile} />
              ) : (
                <div className="empty-preview">
                  <h3>上传 PDF 开始预览</h3>
                  <p>左侧点击文件夹会展开文件，中间上传后的 PDF 会直接在这里预览。</p>
                  <label className="upload-card upload-card-large" htmlFor="file-input">
                    <span className="upload-title">从这里上传 PDF</span>
                    <span className="upload-copy">
                      上传后的文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹
                      {selectedFolder ? `：${selectedFolder.name}` : ""}
                    </span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>
        </main>

        <aside className="chat-column">
          <section className="chat-shell">
            <div className="panel-header">
              <div>
                <h2 className="section-title">课件问答</h2>
              </div>
              <span className="panel-badge">当前 PDF</span>
            </div>

            <div className="chat-messages" ref={chatMessagesRef}>
              {chatMessages.map((message, index) => (
                <article className={`message ${message.role}`} key={`${message.role}-${index}`}>
                  <strong>{message.role === "assistant" ? "AI 助手" : "你"}</strong>
                  <p>{message.text}</p>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>

            <form className="chat-form" onSubmit={handleSubmitQuestion}>
              <textarea
                value={chatInput}
                placeholder="例如：老师刚才讲到哪一页？这份 PDF 的重点内容是什么？"
                onChange={(event) => setChatInput(event.target.value)}
              />
              <button className="primary-button" type="submit" disabled={isAsking}>
                {isAsking ? "发送中" : "发送问题"}
              </button>
            </form>
          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

                    className={`theme-option ${theme === "dark" ? "active" : ""}`}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setTheme("dark")}
                  >
                    深色
                  </button>
                </div>
                <span className="panel-badge">{currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}</span>
                <input
                  id="file-input"
                  type="file"
                  accept=".pdf"
                  hidden
                  onChange={handleUploadFile}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="preview-stage">
              {currentFile && currentFile.previewUrl ? (
                <PdfPreview file={currentFile} />
              ) : (
                <div className="empty-preview">
                  <h3>上传 PDF 开始预览</h3>
                  <p>左侧点击文件夹会展开文件，中间上传后的 PDF 会直接在这里预览。</p>
                  <label className="upload-card upload-card-large" htmlFor="file-input">
                    <span className="upload-title">从这里上传 PDF</span>
                    <span className="upload-copy">
                      上传后的文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹
                      {selectedFolder ? `：${selectedFolder.name}` : ""}
                    </span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>
        </main>

        <aside className="chat-column">
          <section className="chat-shell">
            <div className="panel-header">
              <div>
                <h2 className="section-title">课件问答</h2>
              </div>
              <span className="panel-badge">当前 PDF</span>
            </div>

            <div className="chat-messages" ref={chatMessagesRef}>
              {chatMessages.map((message, index) => (
                <article className={`message ${message.role}`} key={`${message.role}-${index}`}>
                  <strong>{message.role === "assistant" ? "AI 助手" : "你"}</strong>
                  <p>{message.text}</p>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>

            <form className="chat-form" onSubmit={handleSubmitQuestion}>
              <textarea
                value={chatInput}
                placeholder="例如：老师刚才讲到哪一页？这份 PDF 的重点内容是什么？"
                onChange={(event) => setChatInput(event.target.value)}
              />
              <button className="primary-button" type="submit" disabled={isAsking}>
                {isAsking ? "发送中" : "发送问题"}
              </button>
            </form>
          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

:root,
:root[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg-top: #f4f4f1;
  --bg-bottom: #ecebe7;

:root[data-theme="dark"] {

  --bg-bottom: #111318;

import { app, BrowserWindow, dialog, ipcMain, shell } from "electron";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const devServerUrl = process.env.VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL;

function getDocumentsDisplayPath(folderName) {
  return `~/Documents/${folderName}`;
}

function getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName) {
  return path.join(app.getPath("documents"), folderName);
}

async function ensureDirectory(folderPath) {
  await fs.mkdir(folderPath, { recursive: true });
}

async function createMainWindow() {
  const mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1480,
    height: 940,
    minWidth: 1180,
    minHeight: 760,
    backgroundColor: "#0f1115",
    autoHideMenuBar: true,
    ...(process.platform === "darwin"
      ? {
          titleBarStyle: "hiddenInset",
        }
      : {}),
    webPreferences: {
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      preload: path.join(__dirname, "preload.cjs"),
    },
  });

  if (devServerUrl) {
    await mainWindow.loadURL(devServerUrl);
    return;
  }

  await mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(projectRoot, "dist", "index.html"));
}

ipcMain.handle("workspace:create-documents-folder", async (_, folderName) => {
  const nextName = String(folderName || "").trim();
  if (!nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);
  await ensureDirectory(folderPath);

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:rename-documents-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const currentName = String(payload?.currentName || "").trim();
  const nextName = String(payload?.nextName || "").trim();

  if (!currentName || !nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const currentPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(currentName);
  const nextPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);

  if (currentPath !== nextPath) {
    try {
      await fs.rename(currentPath, nextPath);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error?.code === "ENOENT") {
        await ensureDirectory(nextPath);
      } else {
        return { ok: false, message: "重命名工作区文件夹失败。" };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath: nextPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:pick-existing-folder", async () => {
  const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog({
    title: "选择已有工作区文件夹",
    properties: ["openDirectory"],
  });

  if (result.canceled || !result.filePaths.length) {
    return null;
  }

  const folderPath = result.filePaths[0];

  return {
    name: path.basename(folderPath),
    folderPath,
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:reveal-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const sourceType = payload?.sourceType;
  const folderName = String(payload?.folderName || "").trim();
  let folderPath = String(payload?.folderPath || "").trim();

  if (sourceType === "documents") {
    if (!folderName) {
      return { ok: false, message: "缺少工作区名称。" };
    }

    folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName);
    await ensureDirectory(folderPath);
  }

  if (!folderPath) {
    return { ok: false, message: "没有可显示的文件夹路径。" };
  }

  const openError = await shell.openPath(folderPath);
  if (openError) {
    return { ok: false, message: openError };
  }

  return { ok: true };
});

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  await createMainWindow();

  app.on("activate", async () => {
    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) {
      await createMainWindow();
    }
  });
});

app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
  if (process.platform !== "darwin") {
    app.quit();
  }
});

:root,
:root[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg-top: #f4f4f1;
  --bg-bottom: #ecebe7;
  --bg-tint: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48);
  --button-bg: #181818;
  --button-hover: #0f0f0f;
  --button-text: #f5f5f2;
  --shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.04);
  --workspace-surface: rgba(248, 248, 245, 0.92);
  --workspace-sidebar: rgba(240, 240, 236, 0.96);
  --workspace-main: rgba(248, 248, 245, 0.8);
  --workspace-divider: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.08);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-top: #090a0c;
  --bg-bottom: #111318;
  --button-bg: #d1d5db;
  --button-hover: #e0e4e9;
  --button-text: #111318;
  --shadow: 0 22px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
  --workspace-surface: rgba(18, 19, 22, 0.96);
  --workspace-sidebar: rgba(26, 28, 32, 0.98);
  --workspace-main: rgba(18, 19, 22, 0.86);
  --workspace-divider: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  color-scheme: dark;
}
.app-shell {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 360px;
  gap: var(--shell-gap);
  min-height: calc(100vh - (var(--shell-padding) * 2));
  height: calc(100vh - (var(--shell-padding) * 2));
  align-items: stretch;
}

.workspace-shell {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 284px minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius-xl) + 2px);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--workspace-surface);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--workspace-divider);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

.sidebar,
.main-column,
.chat-column {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
}

.chat-shell {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

.chat-shell {
  padding: var(--panel-padding);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
}

.file-tree-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 18px 14px 16px;
  background: var(--workspace-sidebar);
  border-right: var(--line-width) solid var(--workspace-divider);
}

.preview-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 18px 18px 16px;
  background: var(--workspace-main);
}
.panel-header {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.file-tree-panel .panel-header,
.preview-toolbar {
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: var(--line-width) solid var(--workspace-divider);
}
.icon-button,
.folder-menu-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
.folder-tree {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}
.preview-stage {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--workspace-divider);
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  overflow: hidden;
}
@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .workspace-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 260px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .chat-column {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .chat-shell,
  .file-tree-panel,
  .workspace-shell,
  .sidebar,
  .main-column,
  .chat-column {
    min-height: auto;
    height: auto;
@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .app-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .workspace-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .file-tree-panel {
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: var(--line-width) solid var(--workspace-divider);
  }

  .preview-toolbar {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .chat-shell,
  .file-tree-panel,
  .workspace-shell,
  .sidebar,
  .main-column,
  .chat-column {
    min-height: auto;
    height: auto;

   749	                    <h3>上传 PDF 开始预览</h3>

   753	                      <span className="upload-copy">

   755	                        {selectedFolder ? `：${selectedFolder.name}` : ""}
   756	                      </span>
   757	                    </label>
   758	                  </div>
   759	                )}

   766	          <section className="chat-shell">

## Assistant

我查了 Apple 官方文档，结论很明确: 我们现在做偏了。

Apple 官方把这个效果叫 `macOS 26` 的 `Liquid Glass`。它不是“整页都做毛玻璃”，而是一个单独的功能层，主要给 `sidebar`、`toolbar`、按钮这类导航和控制元素用；内容层本身应该用更稳定的标准材质。官方还明确说，不要把 `Liquid Glass` 用在内容层里，否则层级会乱、可读性会变差。  
来源: [Materials](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/materials), [Liquid Glass](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/TechnologyOverviews/liquid-glass), [Adopting Liquid Glass](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/TechnologyOverviews/adopting-liquid-glass), [Sidebars](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/sidebars?changes=_9), [What’s new in macOS 26](https://developer.apple.com/macos/whats-new/)

按官方思路，应该这样做:

1. 左栏可以做玻璃层，但中间 PDF 区不该继续做成同等级玻璃。
2. 玻璃层要“浮”在内容上面，内容要从它下面延伸过去，而不是三整块都同样发白发糊。
3. 玻璃效果要少用，重点放在左侧栏、顶部控制区、按钮、菜单，不要铺满所有卡片。
4. 背景必须有层次和颜色变化，不然玻璃没有“折射/透色”的依据，看起来只会像普通半透明灰块。
5. 深色主题不能只加 blur，文字、边框、选中态都要一起提高对比度。

对我们这个 `Web + Electron` 项目，能做的是“近似官方观感”，不能 1:1 复制系统材质。原因是 Apple 原生材质会随系统背景、窗口内容、交互实时变化，Web 只能用 `backdrop-filter + 半透明渐变 + 高光边缘 + 更强对比` 去模拟。这部分是我根据官方设计原则做的实现推断。

所以正确改法不是继续给整页加玻璃，而是重做分层:
- 左栏: `Liquid Glass` 风格
- 中间 PDF: 标准 material，偏实一点
- 右栏: 保持现在结构，但材质统一
- 背景: 加更丰富的光斑/渐变，让玻璃有东西可“透”

如果你同意，我下一步直接按这套官方思路重做样式，不再继续在“整页玻璃”这条路上修。

## Assistant

我按 Apple 官方的分层逻辑重做了，不再是“整页都做毛玻璃”。

现在的方向是：
- 左栏改成浮起的玻璃导航层，带更强的 `blur + saturate`、圆角、高光边缘和阴影。[src/styles.css](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/styles.css:175)
- 中间 PDF 区改回更稳定的内容材质，不再和左栏用同一种玻璃层。[src/styles.css](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/styles.css:192) [src/styles.css](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/styles.css:596)
- 深色主题的对比度整体抬高了，文字、边框、按钮和内容层都比之前更清楚。[src/styles.css](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/styles.css:50)
- 背景改成更像系统材质的整窗渐变和光斑，给玻璃层提供透色基础。[src/styles.css](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/styles.css:94)

我参考的是 Apple 官方这些说明：
- [Materials](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/materials)
- [Liquid Glass](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/technologyoverviews/liquid-glass)
- [Adopting Liquid Glass](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/technologyoverviews/adopting-liquid-glass)
- [Sidebars](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/sidebars?changes=_9)

`npm run build` 已通过。你现在重启 `npm run dev:desktop` 看效果。  
如果这版方向对，但还差一点，我下一步只会继续调两件事：左栏玻璃透明度，和深色主题的高光强度。
