    id: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID,
    name: "当前课堂资料",
    expanded: true,
    sourceType: "documents",
    folderPath: `${DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH}/当前课堂资料`,
    nativePath: "",
  },
  {
    id: "folder-ml",
    name: "机器学习导论",
    expanded: false,
    sourceType: "documents",
    folderPath: `${DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH}/机器学习导论`,
    nativePath: "",
  },
  {
    id: "folder-network",
    name: "计算机网络",
    expanded: false,
    sourceType: "documents",
    folderPath: `${DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH}/计算机网络`,
    nativePath: "",
  },
];

const INITIAL_FILES = [
  { id: "demo-1", folderId: "folder-ml", name: "机器学习课件-01.pdf" },
  { id: "demo-2", folderId: "folder-network", name: "TCP协议详解.pdf" },
];

const INITIAL_MESSAGES = [
  {
    role: "assistant",
    text: "上传一份 PDF 之后，就可以在右侧直接针对这份文件提问。",
  },
];

function App() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) || "light",
  );
  const [isLeftOpen, setIsLeftOpen] = useState(true);
  const [isRightOpen, setIsRightOpen] = useState(true);
  const [leftWidth] = useState(284);
  const [rightWidth] = useState(360);
  const [folders, setFolders] = useState(INITIAL_FOLDERS);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState(INITIAL_FILES);
  const [selectedFolderId, setSelectedFolderId] = useState(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID);
  const [currentFileId, setCurrentFileId] = useState("");
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState(INITIAL_MESSAGES);
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState("");
  const [isAsking, setIsAsking] = useState(false);
  const [isSettingsOpen, setIsSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const chatMessagesRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme);
  }, [theme]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatMessagesRef.current) {
      chatMessagesRef.current.scrollTop = chatMessagesRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [chatMessages]);

  const currentFile = files.find((file) => file.id === currentFileId) || null;

  function handleToggleFolder(folderId) {
    setFolders((prev) =>
      prev.map((f) =>
        f.id === folderId ? { ...f, expanded: !f.expanded } : f,
      ),
    );
  }

  async function handleUploadFile(event) {
    const [file] = event.target.files || [];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
      const targetId = selectedFolderId || CURRENT_FOLDER_ID;
      setFiles((prev) => [{ ...uploaded, folderId: targetId }, ...prev]);
      setCurrentFileId(uploaded.id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("上传失败", err);
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!chatInput.trim() || isAsking) return;

    const question = chatInput;
    setChatInput("");
    setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: "user", text: question }]);

    if (!currentFile) return;

    setIsAsking(true);
    try {
      const res = await askFileQuestion({
        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
      });
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: res.answer },
      ]);
    } catch (err) {
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: "问答出错，请稍后再试。" },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsAsking(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-frame">
      {/* 侧边栏遮罩层 - 只有开启且是覆盖模式时有用 */}
      <div
        className={`sidebar-overlay ${isLeftOpen ? "active" : ""}`}
        onClick={() => setIsLeftOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* 全局固定切换按钮 - Z-INDEX 9999 保证绝对可见和可点击 */}
      <div className="sidebar-toggle-fixed">
        <button
          className="icon-button"
          onClick={() => setIsLeftOpen(!isLeftOpen)}
          title={isLeftOpen ? "收起侧边栏" : "展开侧边栏"}
        >
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"
            width="20"
            height="20"
            fill="currentColor"
            style={{
              transform: isLeftOpen ? "none" : "scaleX(-1)",
              transition: "transform 0.3s ease",
            }}
          >
            <path d="M824.888889 170.666667H199.111111a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889 56.888889v568.888888a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889 56.888889h625.777778a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889-56.888889V227.555556a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889-56.888889z m0 597.333333a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445 28.444444H227.555556a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445-28.444444V256a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445-28.444444h568.888888a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445 28.444444z" />
            <path d="M256 256m28.444444 0l227.555556 0q28.444444 0 28.444444 28.444444l0 455.111112q0 28.444444-28.444444 28.444444l-227.555556 0q-28.444444 0-28.444444-28.444444l0-455.111112q0-28.444444 28.444444-28.444444Z" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        className={`app-shell ${!isRightOpen ? "right-closed" : ""}`}
        style={{ "--right-panel-width": `${rightWidth}px` }}
      >
        <div className={`workspace-shell ${!isLeftOpen ? "left-closed" : ""}`}>
          {/* 覆盖式侧边栏 */}
          <aside className="sidebar" style={{ width: `${leftWidth}px` }}>
            <div className="file-tree-panel">
              <div className="panel-header">
                <div className="window-controls-slot" />
              </div>
              <div className="folder-tree">
                {folders.map((folder) => (
                  <div key={folder.id} className="folder-item">
                    <div
                      className="folder-row"
                      onClick={() => handleToggleFolder(folder.id)}
                    >
                      <span style={{ marginRight: "8px" }}>
                        {folder.expanded ? "▾" : "▸"}
                      </span>
                      {folder.name}
                    </div>
                    {folder.expanded && (
                      <div className="folder-children">
                        {files
                          .filter((f) => f.folderId === folder.id)
                          .map((file) => (
                            <div
                              key={file.id}
                              className={`tree-file ${file.id === currentFileId ? "active" : ""}`}
                              onClick={() => {
                                setCurrentFileId(file.id);
                                setSelectedFolderId(folder.id);
                              }}
                            >
                              {file.name}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </aside>

          {/* 全屏主内容区 */}
          <main className="main-column">
            <section className="preview-shell">
              <div className="preview-toolbar">
                <div className="window-controls-slot" />
                <div className="preview-toolbar-actions">
                  <span className="panel-badge">
                    {currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    className="icon-button"
                    onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
                  >
                    ⚙
                  </button>
                  {!isRightOpen && (
                    <button
                      className="icon-button"
                      onClick={() => setIsRightOpen(true)}
                    >
                      <svg
                        viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"
                        width="20"
                        height="20"
                        fill="currentColor"
                      >
                        <path d="M824.888889 170.666667H199.111111a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889 56.888889v568.888888a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889 56.888889h625.777778a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889-56.888889V227.555556a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889-56.888889z m0 597.333333a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445 28.444444H227.555556a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445-28.444444V256a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445-28.444444h568.888888a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445 28.444444z" />
                        <path d="M512 256m28.444444 0l227.555556 0q28.444444 0 28.444444 28.444444l0 455.111112q0 28.444444-28.444444 28.444444l-227.555556 0q-28.444444 0-28.444444-28.444444l0-455.111112q0-28.444444 28.444444-28.444444Z" />
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <input
                    id="file-input"
                    type="file"
                    accept=".pdf"
                    hidden
                    onChange={handleUploadFile}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="preview-stage">
                {currentFile ? (
                  <PdfPreview file={currentFile} />
                ) : (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: "grid",
                      placeItems: "center",

                      placeItems: "center",
                      height: "100%",
                      color: "var(--text-secondary)",
                    }}
                  >
                    <label
                      htmlFor="file-input"
                      style={{ cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "center" }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ fontSize: "24px", marginBottom: "8px" }}>
                        📄
                      </div>
                      点击上传 PDF 开始预览
                    </label>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </section>
          </main>
        </div>

        {/* 右侧聊天栏 */}
        <aside className="chat-column">
          <div className="panel-header">
            <h2 style={{ fontSize: "15px", margin: 0, fontWeight: 500 }}>
              课件问答
            </h2>
            <button
              className="icon-button"
              onClick={() => setIsRightOpen(false)}
            >
              <svg
                viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"
                width="20"
                height="20"
                fill="currentColor"
                style={{ transform: "scaleX(-1)" }}
              >
                <path d="M824.888889 170.666667H199.111111a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889 56.888889v568.888888a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889 56.888889h625.777778a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889-56.888889V227.555556a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889-56.888889z m0 597.333333a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445 28.444444H227.555556a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445-28.444444V256a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445-28.444444h568.888888a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445 28.444444z" />
                <path d="M512 256m28.444444 0l227.555556 0q28.444444 0 28.444444 28.444444l0 455.111112q0 28.444444-28.444444 28.444444l-227.555556 0q-28.444444 0-28.444444-28.444444l0-455.111112q0-28.444444 28.444444-28.444444Z" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="chat-shell">
            <div className="chat-messages" ref={chatMessagesRef}>
              {chatMessages.map((m, i) => (
                <div key={i} className={`message ${m.role}`}>
                  {m.text}
                </div>
              ))}
              {isAsking && (
                <div className="message assistant">AI 正在思考中...</div>
              )}
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmitQuestion}>
              <textarea
                value={chatInput}
                onChange={(e) => setChatInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="针对这份 PDF 提问..."
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleSubmitQuestion(e);
                  }
                }}
              />
            </form>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>

      {isSettingsOpen && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3
                className="modal-title"
                style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "16px" }}
              >
                设置
              </h3>
              <button
                className="icon-button"
                onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="settings-row">
                <span style={{ fontSize: "14px" }}>主题模式</span>
                <select
                  value={theme}
                  onChange={(e) => setTheme(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    padding: "4px 8px",
                    borderRadius: "6px",
                    border: "1px solid var(--border)",
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="light">浅色</option>
                  <option value="dark">深色</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="settings-row">
                <span style={{ fontSize: "14px" }}>清除数据</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    localStorage.clear();
                    window.location.reload();
                  }}
                  style={{
                    padding: "4px 12px",
                    borderRadius: "6px",
                    border: "none",
                    background: "#ff4d4f",
                    color: "white",
                    cursor: "pointer",
                  }}
                >
                  重置应用
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;


## Assistant

问题已经定位到代码层了，不只是样式。现在左栏是“覆盖式侧边栏 + 全局固定收缩按钮”，这会直接导致按钮重叠和上传时误触发。 ես先把这套覆盖逻辑拆掉，改回稳定的内嵌侧栏。

    border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: var(--surface-strong);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    resize: none;
    font-size: 13px;
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
}
textarea:focus {
    border-color: var(--marker);
}

/* Modal */
.modal-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    z-index: 10000;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
}
.modal-content {
    background: var(--surface-strong);
    width: 400px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    overflow: hidden;
}
.modal-header {
    padding: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
}
.modal-body {
    padding: 20px;
}
.settings-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

```
:root {
    --font-ui:
        "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Noto Sans SC", "Helvetica Neue",
        sans-serif;
    --radius-xl: 22px;
    --radius-lg: 18px;
    --radius-md: 10px;
body {
    margin: 0;
    min-height: 100vh;
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    background: var(--bg-top);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.app-frame {
    height: 100vh;
    width: 100vw;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
}
.workspace-shell {
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: var(--left-panel-width, 284px) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: stretch;
    background: var(--workspace-main);
    transition: grid-template-columns 0.28s ease;
}
.workspace-shell.left-closed {
    grid-template-columns: 0px minmax(0, 1fr);
}

.sidebar {
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--workspace-sidebar);
    backdrop-filter: blur(25px) saturate(180%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(25px) saturate(180%);
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.28s ease;
}
.left-closed .sidebar {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateX(-12px);
}

.main-column {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    z-index: 10;
    min-width: 0;
}

.panel-header,
.preview-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
.window-controls-slot {
    width: 76px;
    height: 100%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sidebar-header-actions,
.preview-toolbar-leading {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
}

.icon-button {
    display: inline-flex;
.preview-shell {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--content-layer);
}

.preview-stage {
    flex: 1;
    margin: 0 16px 16px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--content-layer-strong);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.chat-column {
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--content-layer);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    z-index: 1500;
}
.file-tree-panel {
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0 16px 16px 0;
}
.folder-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 8px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
.modal-header {
    padding: 16px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
}
```

                      onClick={() => handleToggleFolder(folder.id)}
                    >
                      <span style={{ marginRight: "8px" }}>
                        {folder.expanded ? "▾" : "▸"}
                      </span>
                      {folder.name}
                    </div>
                    {folder.expanded && (
                      <div className="folder-children">
                        {files
                          .filter((f) => f.folderId === folder.id)
                          .map((file) => (
                            <div
                              key={file.id}
                              className={`tree-file ${file.id === currentFileId ? "active" : ""}`}
                              onClick={() => {
                                setCurrentFileId(file.id);
                                setSelectedFolderId(folder.id);
                              }}
                            >
                              {file.name}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </aside>

          {/* 全屏主内容区 */}
          <main className="main-column">
            <section className="preview-shell">
              <div className="preview-toolbar">
                <div className="preview-toolbar-leading">

                      className="icon-button"
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsLeftOpen(true)}
                      title="展开侧边栏"

                      <svg
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"

                        strokeWidth="2"
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                      >
                        <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" />
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                <div className="preview-toolbar-actions">
                  <span className="panel-badge">
                    {currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    className="icon-button"
                    onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
                  >
                    ⚙
                  </button>
                  {!isRightOpen && (
                    <button
                      className="icon-button"
                      onClick={() => setIsRightOpen(true)}
                    >
                      <svg
                        viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"
                        width="20"
                        height="20"
                        fill="currentColor"
                      >
```
                        <path d="M824.888889 170.666667H199.111111a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889 56.888889v568.888888a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889 56.888889h625.777778a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889-56.888889V227.555556a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889-56.888889z m0 597.333333a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445 28.444444H227.555556a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445-28.444444V256a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445-28.444444h568.888888a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445 28.444444z" />
```

## Assistant

你这次不是项目坏了，是命令里多了一个中文/弯引号字符。

你输入的是：
```bash
npm run dev:desktop‘
```

正确的是：
```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```

最后面那个 `‘` 被 npm 当成脚本名的一部分了，所以它去找 `dev:desktop‘`，自然报 `Missing script`。

另外这条：
```text
npm warn Unknown project config "electron_mirror"
```
目前只是警告，不影响你运行 `dev:desktop`。

直接重新输这一条就行：
```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { askFileQuestion, uploadCourseFile } from "./api.js";
import {
  saveCustomFont,
  loadCustomFont,
  deleteCustomFont,
} from "./fontStore.js";
import PdfPreview from "./PdfPreview.jsx";

const CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = "folder-current";
const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = "course-pdf-theme";
const DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH = "~/Documents";

const INITIAL_FOLDERS = [
  {
    id: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID,
    name: "当前课堂资料",
    expanded: true,
    sourceType: "documents",
    folderPath: `${DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH}/当前课堂资料`,
    nativePath: "",
  },
  {
    id: "folder-ml",
    name: "机器学习导论",
    expanded: false,
    sourceType: "documents",
    folderPath: `${DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH}/机器学习导论`,
    nativePath: "",
  },
  {
    id: "folder-network",
    name: "计算机网络",
    expanded: false,
    sourceType: "documents",
    folderPath: `${DEFAULT_DOCUMENTS_PATH}/计算机网络`,
    nativePath: "",
  },
];

const INITIAL_FILES = [
  { id: "demo-1", folderId: "folder-ml", name: "机器学习课件-01.pdf" },
  { id: "demo-2", folderId: "folder-network", name: "TCP协议详解.pdf" },
];

const INITIAL_MESSAGES = [
  {
    role: "assistant",
    text: "上传一份 PDF 之后，就可以在右侧直接针对这份文件提问。",
  },
];

function App() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) || "light",
  );
  const [isLeftOpen, setIsLeftOpen] = useState(true);
  const [isRightOpen, setIsRightOpen] = useState(true);
  const [leftWidth] = useState(284);
  const [rightWidth] = useState(360);
  const [folders, setFolders] = useState(INITIAL_FOLDERS);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState(INITIAL_FILES);
  const [selectedFolderId, setSelectedFolderId] = useState(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID);
  const [currentFileId, setCurrentFileId] = useState("");
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState(INITIAL_MESSAGES);
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState("");
  const [isAsking, setIsAsking] = useState(false);
  const [isSettingsOpen, setIsSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const chatMessagesRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme);
  }, [theme]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatMessagesRef.current) {
      chatMessagesRef.current.scrollTop = chatMessagesRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [chatMessages]);

  const currentFile = files.find((file) => file.id === currentFileId) || null;

  function handleToggleFolder(folderId) {
    setFolders((prev) =>
      prev.map((f) =>
        f.id === folderId ? { ...f, expanded: !f.expanded } : f,
      ),
    );
  }

  async function handleUploadFile(event) {
    const [file] = event.target.files || [];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
      const targetId = selectedFolderId || CURRENT_FOLDER_ID;
      setFiles((prev) => [{ ...uploaded, folderId: targetId }, ...prev]);
      setCurrentFileId(uploaded.id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("上传失败", err);
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!chatInput.trim() || isAsking) return;

    const question = chatInput;
    setChatInput("");
    setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: "user", text: question }]);

    if (!currentFile) return;

    setIsAsking(true);
    try {
      const res = await askFileQuestion({
        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
      });
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: res.answer },
      ]);
    } catch (err) {
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: "问答出错，请稍后再试。" },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsAsking(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-frame">
      <div className="frame-toggle frame-toggle-left">
        <button
          className="icon-button"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsLeftOpen((current) => !current)}
          title={isLeftOpen ? "收起侧边栏" : "展开侧边栏"}
        >
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"
            width="18"
            height="18"
            fill="currentColor"
            style={{ transform: isLeftOpen ? "scaleX(-1)" : "none" }}
          >
            <path d="M824.888889 170.666667H199.111111a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889 56.888889v568.888888a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889 56.888889h625.777778a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889-56.888889V227.555556a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889-56.888889z m0 597.333333a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445 28.444444H227.555556a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445-28.444444V256a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445-28.444444h568.888888a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445 28.444444z" />
            <path d="M512 256m28.444444 0l227.555556 0q28.444444 0 28.444444 28.444444l0 455.111112q0 28.444444-28.444444 28.444444l-227.555556 0q-28.444444 0-28.444444-28.444444l0-455.111112q0-28.444444 28.444444-28.444444Z" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="frame-toggle frame-toggle-right">
        <button
          className="icon-button"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsRightOpen((current) => !current)}
          title={isRightOpen ? "收起问答栏" : "展开问答栏"}
        >
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"
            width="18"
            height="18"
            fill="currentColor"
            style={{ transform: isRightOpen ? "scaleX(-1)" : "none" }}
          >
            <path d="M824.888889 170.666667H199.111111a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889 56.888889v568.888888a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889 56.888889h625.777778a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889-56.888889V227.555556a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889-56.888889z m0 597.333333a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445 28.444444H227.555556a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445-28.444444V256a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445-28.444444h568.888888a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445 28.444444z" />
            <path d="M512 256m28.444444 0l227.555556 0q28.444444 0 28.444444 28.444444l0 455.111112q0 28.444444-28.444444 28.444444l-227.555556 0q-28.444444 0-28.444444-28.444444l0-455.111112q0-28.444444 28.444444-28.444444Z" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        className={`app-shell ${!isRightOpen ? "right-closed" : ""}`}
        style={{ "--right-panel-width": `${rightWidth}px` }}
      >
        <div
          className={`workspace-shell ${!isLeftOpen ? "left-closed" : ""}`}
          style={{ "--left-panel-width": `${leftWidth}px` }}
        >
          <aside className="sidebar">
            <div className="file-tree-panel">
              <div className="panel-header sidebar-header">
                <div className="window-controls-slot" />
              </div>
              <div className="folder-tree">
                {folders.map((folder) => (
                  <div key={folder.id} className="folder-item">
                    <div
                      className="folder-row"
                      onClick={() => handleToggleFolder(folder.id)}
                    >
                      <span style={{ marginRight: "8px" }}>
                        {folder.expanded ? "▾" : "▸"}
                      </span>
                      {folder.name}
                    </div>
                    {folder.expanded && (
                      <div className="folder-children">
                        {files
                          .filter((f) => f.folderId === folder.id)
                          .map((file) => (
                            <div
                              key={file.id}
                              className={`tree-file ${file.id === currentFileId ? "active" : ""}`}
                              onClick={() => {
                                setCurrentFileId(file.id);
                                setSelectedFolderId(folder.id);
                              }}
                            >
                              {file.name}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </aside>

          {/* 全屏主内容区 */}
          <main className="main-column">
            <section className="preview-shell">
              <div className="preview-toolbar">
                <div className="preview-toolbar-leading" />
                <div className="preview-toolbar-actions">
                  <span className="panel-badge">
                    {currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    className="icon-button"
                    onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
                  >
                    ⚙
                  </button>
                  <input
                    id="file-input"
                    type="file"
                    accept=".pdf"
                    hidden
                    onChange={handleUploadFile}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="preview-stage">
                {currentFile ? (
                  <PdfPreview file={currentFile} />
                ) : (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: "grid",
                      placeItems: "center",
                      height: "100%",
                      color: "var(--text-secondary)",
                    }}
                  >
                    <label
                      htmlFor="file-input"
                      style={{ cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "center" }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ fontSize: "24px", marginBottom: "8px" }}>
                        📄
                      </div>
                      点击上传 PDF 开始预览
                    </label>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </section>
          </main>
        </div>

        {/* 右侧聊天栏 */}
        <aside className="chat-column">
          <div className="panel-header">
            <h2 style={{ fontSize: "15px", margin: 0, fontWeight: 500 }}>
              课件问答
            </h2>
          </div>
          <div className="chat-shell">
            <div className="chat-messages" ref={chatMessagesRef}>
              {chatMessages.map((m, i) => (
                <div key={i} className={`message ${m.role}`}>
                  {m.text}
                </div>
              ))}
              {isAsking && (
                <div className="message assistant">AI 正在思考中...</div>
              )}
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmitQuestion}>
              <textarea
                value={chatInput}
                onChange={(e) => setChatInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="针对这份 PDF 提问..."
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleSubmitQuestion(e);
                  }
                }}
              />
            </form>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>

      {isSettingsOpen && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3
                className="modal-title"
                style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "16px" }}
              >
                设置
              </h3>
              <button
                className="icon-button"
                onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="settings-row">
                <span style={{ fontSize: "14px" }}>主题模式</span>
                <select
                  value={theme}
                  onChange={(e) => setTheme(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    padding: "4px 8px",
                    borderRadius: "6px",
                    border: "1px solid var(--border)",
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="light">浅色</option>
                  <option value="dark">深色</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="settings-row">
                <span style={{ fontSize: "14px" }}>清除数据</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    localStorage.clear();
                    window.location.reload();
                  }}
                  style={{
                    padding: "4px 12px",
                    borderRadius: "6px",
                    border: "none",
                    background: "#ff4d4f",
                    color: "white",
                    cursor: "pointer",
                  }}
                >
                  重置应用
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

我现在按一套更稳的方案重构，不再在现有这套覆盖/压缩逻辑上打补丁：

1. 把“桌面导航”独立成单一顶栏，只负责拖拽区和左右侧栏切换按钮。

```
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { askFileQuestion, uploadCourseFile } from "./api.js";
import PdfPreview from "./PdfPreview.jsx";

const CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = "folder-current";
const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = "course-pdf-theme";

const INITIAL_FOLDERS = [
  { id: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID, name: "当前课堂资料", expanded: true },
  { id: "folder-ml", name: "机器学习导论", expanded: false },
  { id: "folder-network", name: "计算机网络", expanded: false },
];

const INITIAL_FILES = [
  { id: "demo-1", folderId: "folder-ml", name: "机器学习课件-01.pdf" },
  { id: "demo-2", folderId: "folder-network", name: "TCP协议详解.pdf" },
];

const INITIAL_MESSAGES = [
  {
    role: "assistant",
    text: "上传一份 PDF 之后，就可以在右侧直接针对这份文件提问。",
  },
];

function PanelToggleIcon({ mirrored = false }) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"
      width="18"
      height="18"
      fill="currentColor"
      style={{ transform: mirrored ? "scaleX(-1)" : "none" }}
    >
      <path d="M824.888889 170.666667H199.111111a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889 56.888889v568.888888a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889 56.888889h625.777778a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889-56.888889V227.555556a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889-56.888889z m0 597.333333a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445 28.444444H227.555556a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445-28.444444V256a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445-28.444444h568.888888a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445 28.444444z" />
      <path d="M512 256m28.444444 0l227.555556 0q28.444444 0 28.444444 28.444444l0 455.111112q0 28.444444-28.444444 28.444444l-227.555556 0q-28.444444 0-28.444444-28.444444l0-455.111112q0-28.444444 28.444444-28.444444Z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function App() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) || "light",
  );
  const [isLeftOpen, setIsLeftOpen] = useState(true);
  const [isRightOpen, setIsRightOpen] = useState(true);
  const [folders, setFolders] = useState(INITIAL_FOLDERS);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState(INITIAL_FILES);
  const [selectedFolderId, setSelectedFolderId] = useState(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID);
  const [currentFileId, setCurrentFileId] = useState("");
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState(INITIAL_MESSAGES);
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState("");
  const [isAsking, setIsAsking] = useState(false);
  const [isSettingsOpen, setIsSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const chatMessagesRef = useRef(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme);
  }, [theme]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatMessagesRef.current) {
      chatMessagesRef.current.scrollTop = chatMessagesRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [chatMessages]);

  const currentFile = files.find((file) => file.id === currentFileId) || null;

  function handleToggleFolder(folderId) {
    setFolders((prev) =>
      prev.map((folder) =>
        folder.id === folderId
          ? { ...folder, expanded: !folder.expanded }
          : folder,
      ),
    );
  }

  function handleSelectFile(fileId, folderId) {
    setCurrentFileId(fileId);
    setSelectedFolderId(folderId);
  }

  async function handleUploadFile(event) {
    const [file] = event.target.files || [];
    if (!file) return;

    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
      const targetFolderId = selectedFolderId || CURRENT_FOLDER_ID;

      setFiles((prev) => [{ ...uploaded, folderId: targetFolderId }, ...prev]);
      setCurrentFileId(uploaded.id);
      setSelectedFolderId(targetFolderId);
      setFolders((prev) =>
        prev.map((folder) =>
          folder.id === targetFolderId ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("上传失败", error);
    } finally {
      event.target.value = "";
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!chatInput.trim() || isAsking) return;

    const question = chatInput.trim();
    setChatInput("");
    setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: "user", text: question }]);

    if (!currentFile) {
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: "请先上传或选择一份 PDF。" },
      ]);
      return;
    }

    setIsAsking(true);
    try {
      const response = await askFileQuestion({
        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
      });
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: response.answer },
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: "问答出错，请稍后再试。" },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsAsking(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-frame">
      <header className="app-topbar">
        <div className="topbar-cluster topbar-left">
          <div className="window-controls-slot" aria-hidden="true" />
          <button
            className="icon-button nav-toggle-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsLeftOpen((current) => !current)}
            title={isLeftOpen ? "收起文件栏" : "展开文件栏"}
          >
            <PanelToggleIcon mirrored={isLeftOpen} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="topbar-cluster topbar-right">
          <button
            className="icon-button nav-toggle-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsRightOpen((current) => !current)}
            title={isRightOpen ? "收起问答栏" : "展开问答栏"}
          >
            <PanelToggleIcon mirrored={isRightOpen} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="app-body">
        <main className="main-layer">
          <section className="preview-shell">
            <div className="preview-toolbar">
              <div className="preview-toolbar-actions">
                <button
                  className="secondary-button"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                >
                  上传 PDF
                </button>
                <span className="panel-badge">
                  {currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}
                </span>
                <button
                  className="icon-button"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
                  title="打开设置"
                >
                  ⚙
                </button>
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  id="file-input"
                  type="file"
                  accept=".pdf"
                  hidden
                  onChange={handleUploadFile}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="preview-stage">
              {currentFile ? (
                <PdfPreview file={currentFile} />
              ) : (
                <div className="empty-state">
                  <label
                    className="upload-card"
                    htmlFor="file-input"
                    onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                  >
                    <div className="upload-icon">PDF</div>
                    <div className="upload-title">点击上传 PDF 开始预览</div>
                    <div className="upload-copy">
                      上传后的文件会进入当前选中的文件夹。
                    </div>
                  </label>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>
        </main>

        <aside
          className={`sidebar-panel left-panel ${isLeftOpen ? "open" : "closed"}`}
        >
          <div className="sidebar-panel-inner">
            <div className="sidebar-top-spacer" aria-hidden="true" />
            <div className="folder-tree">
              {folders.map((folder) => {
                const folderFiles = files.filter(
                  (file) => file.folderId === folder.id,
                );

                return (
                  <article className="folder-item" key={folder.id}>
                    <button
                      className={`folder-row ${
                        selectedFolderId === folder.id ? "active" : ""
                      }`}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleToggleFolder(folder.id)}
                    >
                      <span className="folder-row-main">
                        <span className="folder-chevron">
                          {folder.expanded ? "▾" : "▸"}
                        </span>
                        <span>{folder.name}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="folder-count">{folderFiles.length}</span>
                    </button>

                    {folder.expanded ? (
                      <div className="folder-children">
                        {folderFiles.length ? (
                          folderFiles.map((file) => (
                            <button
                              className={`tree-file ${
                                file.id === currentFileId ? "active" : ""
                              }`}
                              key={file.id}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleSelectFile(file.id, folder.id)}
                            >
                              {file.name}
                            </button>
                          ))
                        ) : (
                          <div className="tree-empty">这个文件夹里还没有文件</div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ) : null}
                  </article>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>

        <aside
          className={`sidebar-panel right-panel ${isRightOpen ? "open" : "closed"}`}
        >
          <div className="chat-panel-inner">
            <div className="chat-header">
              <h2 className="section-title">课件问答</h2>
            </div>

            <div className="chat-shell">
              <div className="chat-messages" ref={chatMessagesRef}>
                {chatMessages.map((message, index) => (
                  <div
                    className={`message ${message.role}`}
                    key={`${message.role}-${index}`}
                  >
                    {message.text}
                  </div>
                ))}
                {isAsking ? (
                  <div className="message assistant">AI 正在思考中...</div>
                ) : null}
              </div>

              <form className="chat-form" onSubmit={handleSubmitQuestion}>
                <textarea
                  value={chatInput}
                  onChange={(event) => setChatInput(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="针对这份 PDF 提问..."
                  onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                      event.preventDefault();
                      handleSubmitQuestion(event);
                    }
                  }}
                />
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>

      {isSettingsOpen ? (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3 className="modal-title">设置</h3>
              <button
                className="icon-button"
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="settings-row">
                <span>主题模式</span>
                <select
                  value={theme}
                  onChange={(event) => setTheme(event.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="light">浅色</option>
                  <option value="dark">深色</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;
```

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { GlobalWorkerOptions, getDocument } from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.mjs";
import workerSource from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url";

const DEFAULT_SCALE = 1.1;
const MIN_SCALE = 0.8;
const MAX_SCALE = 2;
const SCALE_STEP = 0.15;

GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerSource;

function formatScale(scale) {
  return `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
}

function getErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error?.name === "InvalidPDFException") {
    return "这个文件不是有效的 PDF。";
  }

  if (error?.name === "MissingPDFException") {
    return "没有找到可加载的 PDF 文件。";
  }

  return "PDF 加载失败，请检查文件内容或预览地址。";
}

export default function PdfPreview({ file }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const renderTaskRef = useRef(null);
  const [pdfDocument, setPdfDocument] = useState(null);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [pageNumber, setPageNumber] = useState(1);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(DEFAULT_SCALE);
  const [isLoadingDocument, setIsLoadingDocument] = useState(false);
  const [isRenderingPage, setIsRenderingPage] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setPdfDocument(null);
    setPageCount(0);
    setPageNumber(1);
    setScale(DEFAULT_SCALE);
    setErrorMessage("");
    renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();

    if (!file?.previewUrl) {
      setIsLoadingDocument(false);
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;
    const loadingTask = getDocument({
      url: file.previewUrl,
      isEvalSupported: false,
    });

    setIsLoadingDocument(true);

    loadingTask.promise
      .then((nextDocument) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          nextDocument.destroy().catch(() => {});
          return;
        }

        setPdfDocument(nextDocument);
        setPageCount(nextDocument.numPages);
        setPageNumber(1);
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          return;
        }

        setErrorMessage(getErrorMessage(error));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsLoadingDocument(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
      loadingTask.destroy();
    };
  }, [file?.id, file?.previewUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument) {
      return;
    }

    return () => {
      pdfDocument.destroy().catch(() => {});
    };
  }, [pdfDocument]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument || !canvasRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;

    async function renderPage() {
      setIsRenderingPage(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      try {
        const page = await pdfDocument.getPage(pageNumber);
        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;

        if (!canvas) {
          return;
        }

        const context = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false });

        if (!context) {
          setErrorMessage("当前浏览器无法初始化 PDF 画布。");
          return;
        }

        const outputScale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * outputScale);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * outputScale);
        canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(viewport.width)}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(viewport.height)}px`;
        context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
        const renderTask = page.render({
          canvasContext: context,
          viewport,
          transform: outputScale === 1 ? null : [outputScale, 0, 0, outputScale, 0, 0],
        });

        renderTaskRef.current = renderTask;
        await renderTask.promise;

        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsRenderingPage(false);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (isCancelled || error?.name === "RenderingCancelledException") {
          return;
        }

        setIsRenderingPage(false);
        setErrorMessage("PDF 页面渲染失败。");
      }
    }

    renderPage();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
    };
  }, [pageNumber, pdfDocument, scale]);

  function handlePreviousPage() {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.max(1, currentPage - 1));
  }

  function handleNextPage() {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.min(pageCount, currentPage + 1));
  }

  function handleZoomOut() {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.max(MIN_SCALE, Number((currentScale - SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  function handleZoomIn() {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Number((currentScale + SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="pdf-viewer">
      <div className="pdf-viewer-toolbar">
        <div className="pdf-viewer-status">
          {pageCount ? `第 ${pageNumber} / ${pageCount} 页` : "正在准备页面"}
        </div>
        <div className="pdf-viewer-controls">
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePreviousPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber <= 1}
          >
            上一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNextPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber >= pageCount}
          >
            下一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomOut}
            disabled={scale <= MIN_SCALE}
          >
            缩小
          </button>
          <span className="viewer-scale">{formatScale(scale)}</span>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomIn}
            disabled={scale >= MAX_SCALE}
          >
            放大
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="pdf-canvas-wrap">
        {errorMessage ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>预览不可用</strong>
            <p>{errorMessage}</p>
          </div>
        ) : isLoadingDocument ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>正在加载 PDF</strong>
            <p>文件已经导入，正在用 PDF.js 生成预览。</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {isRenderingPage ? <div className="pdf-rendering-badge">渲染中</div> : null}
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="pdf-canvas" />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 8px 16px 0 0;
  -webkit-app-region: drag;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.topbar-cluster {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.topbar-left {
  padding-left: 0;
}

.topbar-right {
  padding-right: 0;
}

.window-controls-slot {
  width: var(--traffic-slot-width);
  flex: 0 0 var(--traffic-slot-width);
}

.app-body {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.main-layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 10;
}

.preview-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--content-surface);
}

.preview-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: calc(var(--toolbar-height) + 8px) 16px 14px;
}

.preview-toolbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.preview-stage {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0 16px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  background: var(--content-surface-strong);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sidebar-panel {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 30;
  transition: transform 0.28s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.left-panel {
  left: 0;
  width: var(--left-panel-width);
}

.right-panel {
  right: 0;
  width: var(--right-panel-width);
}

.sidebar-panel.closed {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.left-panel.closed {
  transform: translateX(calc(-100% - 16px));
}

.right-panel.closed {
  transform: translateX(calc(100% + 16px));
}

.sidebar-panel.open {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.sidebar-panel-inner,
.chat-panel-inner {
  height: 100%;
  padding-top: calc(var(--toolbar-height) + 8px);
}

.sidebar-panel-inner {
  width: 100%;
  padding-left: 16px;
  padding-right: 16px;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
}

.chat-panel-inner {
  width: 100%;
  padding-left: 16px;
  padding-right: 16px;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  background: var(--content-surface);
  box-shadow: -12px 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

.file-tree-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0 14px 14px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-window);
  background: var(--sidebar-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel);
  backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(160%);
}

.sidebar-top-spacer {
  flex: 0 0 42px;
}

.folder-tree {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-top: 10px;
}

.folder-item {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.folder-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.folder-row:hover,
.folder-row.active {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.folder-row-main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.folder-chevron {
  width: 10px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.folder-count {
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  font-size: 11px;
}

.folder-children {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding-left: 22px;
}

.tree-file {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.tree-file:hover {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.tree-file.active {
  background: var(--selection);
  color: var(--marker);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.tree-empty {
  padding: 4px 10px;
  color: var(--text-tertiary);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.chat-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0 0 12px;
}

.chat-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  height: calc(100% - 44px);
}

.chat-messages {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.chat-form {
  display: grid;
}

.message {
  max-width: 90%;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.message.assistant {
  align-self: flex-start;
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;
}

.message.user {
  align-self: flex-end;
  background: var(--selection);
  color: var(--marker);
  border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
}

.section-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.icon-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
  -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.icon-button:hover {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.nav-toggle-button {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(140%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(140%);
}

.secondary-button {
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.secondary-button:hover {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.panel-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 30px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.empty-state {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 24px;
}

.upload-card {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 28px 32px;
  border: var(--line-width) dashed var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--surface);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.upload-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--surface-muted);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.upload-title {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.upload-copy {
  max-width: 260px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 92px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  resize: none;
  outline: none;
}

textarea:focus,
select:focus {
  border-color: var(--marker);
}

.pdf-viewer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.pdf-viewer-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-bottom: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  background: var(--content-chrome);
}

.pdf-viewer-status,
.viewer-scale {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.pdf-viewer-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.viewer-button {
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.viewer-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--surface-muted);
}

.viewer-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.55;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.pdf-canvas-wrap {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  display: grid;
  place-items: start center;
  padding: 20px;
}

.pdf-canvas {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
}

.pdf-state {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.pdf-state strong {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.pdf-state p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.pdf-rendering-badge {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  justify-self: end;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 11px;
  z-index: 1;
}

.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: rgba(10, 14, 20, 0.28);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.modal-content {
  width: 380px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.modal-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 16px 16px 12px;
}

.modal-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.modal-body {
  padding: 0 16px 16px;
}

.settings-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
}

select {
  min-width: 108px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  background: var(--surface-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  outline: none;
}

```

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { askFileQuestion, uploadCourseFile } from "./api.js";
import PdfPreview from "./PdfPreview.jsx";

const CURRENT_FOLDER_ID = "folder-current";
const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = "course-pdf-theme";

const INITIAL_FOLDERS = [
  { id: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID, name: "当前课堂资料", expanded: true },
  { id: "folder-ml", name: "机器学习导论", expanded: false },
  { id: "folder-network", name: "计算机网络", expanded: false },
];

const INITIAL_FILES = [
  { id: "demo-1", folderId: "folder-ml", name: "机器学习课件-01.pdf" },
  { id: "demo-2", folderId: "folder-network", name: "TCP协议详解.pdf" },
];

const INITIAL_MESSAGES = [
  {
    role: "assistant",
    text: "上传一份 PDF 之后，就可以在右侧直接针对这份文件提问。",
  },
];

function PanelToggleIcon({ mirrored = false }) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"
      width="18"
      height="18"
      fill="currentColor"
      style={{ transform: mirrored ? "scaleX(-1)" : "none" }}
    >
      <path d="M824.888889 170.666667H199.111111a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889 56.888889v568.888888a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889 56.888889h625.777778a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0 56.888889-56.888889V227.555556a56.888889 56.888889 0 0 0-56.888889-56.888889z m0 597.333333a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445 28.444444H227.555556a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1-28.444445-28.444444V256a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445-28.444444h568.888888a28.444444 28.444444 0 0 1 28.444445 28.444444z" />
      <path d="M512 256m28.444444 0l227.555556 0q28.444444 0 28.444444 28.444444l0 455.111112q0 28.444444-28.444444 28.444444l-227.555556 0q-28.444444 0-28.444444-28.444444l0-455.111112q0-28.444444 28.444444-28.444444Z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function App() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) || "light",
  );
  const [isLeftOpen, setIsLeftOpen] = useState(true);
  const [isRightOpen, setIsRightOpen] = useState(true);
  const [folders, setFolders] = useState(INITIAL_FOLDERS);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState(INITIAL_FILES);
  const [selectedFolderId, setSelectedFolderId] = useState(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID);
  const [currentFileId, setCurrentFileId] = useState("");
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState(INITIAL_MESSAGES);
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState("");
  const [isAsking, setIsAsking] = useState(false);
  const [isSettingsOpen, setIsSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const chatMessagesRef = useRef(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme);
  }, [theme]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatMessagesRef.current) {
      chatMessagesRef.current.scrollTop = chatMessagesRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [chatMessages]);

  const currentFile = files.find((file) => file.id === currentFileId) || null;

  function handleToggleFolder(folderId) {
    setFolders((prev) =>
      prev.map((folder) =>
        folder.id === folderId
          ? { ...folder, expanded: !folder.expanded }
          : folder,
      ),
    );
  }

  function handleSelectFile(fileId, folderId) {
    setCurrentFileId(fileId);
    setSelectedFolderId(folderId);
  }

  async function handleUploadFile(event) {
    const [file] = event.target.files || [];
    if (!file) return;

    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
      const targetFolderId = selectedFolderId || CURRENT_FOLDER_ID;

      setFiles((prev) => [{ ...uploaded, folderId: targetFolderId }, ...prev]);
      setCurrentFileId(uploaded.id);
      setSelectedFolderId(targetFolderId);
      setFolders((prev) =>
        prev.map((folder) =>
          folder.id === targetFolderId ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("上传失败", error);
    } finally {
      event.target.value = "";
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!chatInput.trim() || isAsking) return;

    const question = chatInput.trim();
    setChatInput("");
    setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: "user", text: question }]);

    if (!currentFile) {
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: "请先上传或选择一份 PDF。" },
      ]);
      return;
    }

    setIsAsking(true);
    try {
      const response = await askFileQuestion({
        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
      });

  font-size: 13px;

```
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;

}

}
```

        folder.id === folderId
          ? { ...folder, expanded: !folder.expanded }
          : folder,
      ),
    );
  }

  function handleSelectFile(fileId, folderId) {
    setCurrentFileId(fileId);
    setSelectedFolderId(folderId);
  }

  async function handleUploadFile(event) {
    const [file] = event.target.files || [];
    if (!file) return;

    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
      const targetFolderId = selectedFolderId || CURRENT_FOLDER_ID;

      setFiles((prev) => [{ ...uploaded, folderId: targetFolderId }, ...prev]);
      setCurrentFileId(uploaded.id);
      setSelectedFolderId(targetFolderId);
      setFolders((prev) =>
        prev.map((folder) =>
          folder.id === targetFolderId ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("上传失败", error);
    } finally {
      event.target.value = "";
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!chatInput.trim() || isAsking) return;

    const question = chatInput.trim();
    setChatInput("");
    setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: "user", text: question }]);

    if (!currentFile) {
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: "请先上传或选择一份 PDF。" },
      ]);
      return;
    }

    setIsAsking(true);
    try {
      const response = await askFileQuestion({
        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
      });
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: response.answer },
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: "问答出错，请稍后再试。" },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsAsking(false);
    }
  }

  return (

          <button

            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsLeftOpen((current) => !current)}
            title={isLeftOpen ? "收起文件栏" : "展开文件栏"}
          >
            <PanelToggleIcon mirrored={!isLeftOpen} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="topbar-cluster topbar-right">
          <button
            className="icon-button nav-toggle-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsRightOpen((current) => !current)}
            title={isRightOpen ? "收起问答栏" : "展开问答栏"}
          >
            <PanelToggleIcon mirrored={isRightOpen} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div
        className={`app-body ${isLeftOpen ? "left-open" : "left-closed"} ${
          isRightOpen ? "right-open" : "right-closed"
        }`}
      >
        <aside
          className={`sidebar-panel left-panel ${isLeftOpen ? "open" : "closed"}`}
        >
          <div className="sidebar-panel-inner">
            <div className="sidebar-top-spacer" aria-hidden="true" />
            <div className="summary-panel">
              <div className="summary-list">
                {INITIAL_SUMMARIES.map((item, index) => {
                  const isExpanded = expandedSummaryId === item.id;

                  return (
                    <article
                      className={`summary-item ${isExpanded ? "expanded" : ""}`}
                      key={item.id}
                    >
                      <button
                        className="summary-trigger"
                        type="button"

                          setExpandedSummaryId((currentId) =>
                            currentId === item.id ? "" : item.id,

                        }
                      >

```
.mode-switch {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(76px, 1fr));
  align-items: center;
  padding: 3px;
  border: var(--line-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  overflow: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%);
}

.mode-switch-thumb {
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  left: 3px;
  width: calc(50% - 3px);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24),
    0 6px 18px rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.08);
  transition:
    transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 220ms ease,
    box-shadow 220ms ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.mode-switch.mode-review .mode-switch-thumb {
  transform: translateX(100%);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .mode-switch {
  color-scheme: dark;
}

.mode-switch-button {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  min-width: 76px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.mode-switch-button.active {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
```

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { GlobalWorkerOptions, getDocument } from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.mjs";
import workerSource from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url";

const DEFAULT_SCALE = 1.1;
const MIN_SCALE = 0.8;
const MAX_SCALE = 2;
const SCALE_STEP = 0.15;

GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerSource;

function formatScale(scale) {
  return `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
}

function getErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error?.name === "InvalidPDFException") {
    return "这个文件不是有效的 PDF。";
  }

  if (error?.name === "MissingPDFException") {
    return "没有找到可加载的 PDF 文件。";
  }

  return "PDF 加载失败，请检查文件内容或预览地址。";
}

export default function PdfPreview({ file }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const renderTaskRef = useRef(null);
  const [pdfDocument, setPdfDocument] = useState(null);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [pageNumber, setPageNumber] = useState(1);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(DEFAULT_SCALE);
  const [isLoadingDocument, setIsLoadingDocument] = useState(false);
  const [isRenderingPage, setIsRenderingPage] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setPdfDocument(null);
    setPageCount(0);
    setPageNumber(1);
    setScale(DEFAULT_SCALE);
    setErrorMessage("");
    renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();

    if (!file?.previewUrl) {
      setIsLoadingDocument(false);
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;
    const loadingTask = getDocument({
      url: file.previewUrl,
      isEvalSupported: false,
    });

    setIsLoadingDocument(true);

    loadingTask.promise
      .then((nextDocument) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          nextDocument.destroy().catch(() => {});
          return;
        }

        setPdfDocument(nextDocument);
        setPageCount(nextDocument.numPages);
        setPageNumber(1);
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          return;
        }

        setErrorMessage(getErrorMessage(error));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsLoadingDocument(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
      loadingTask.destroy();
    };
  }, [file?.id, file?.previewUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument) {
      return;
    }

    return () => {
      pdfDocument.destroy().catch(() => {});
    };
  }, [pdfDocument]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument || !canvasRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;

    async function renderPage() {
      setIsRenderingPage(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      try {
        const page = await pdfDocument.getPage(pageNumber);
        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;

        if (!canvas) {
          return;
        }

        const context = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false });

        if (!context) {
          setErrorMessage("当前浏览器无法初始化 PDF 画布。");
          return;
        }

        const outputScale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * outputScale);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * outputScale);
        canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(viewport.width)}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(viewport.height)}px`;
        context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
        const renderTask = page.render({
          canvasContext: context,
          viewport,
          transform: outputScale === 1 ? null : [outputScale, 0, 0, outputScale, 0, 0],
        });

        renderTaskRef.current = renderTask;
        await renderTask.promise;

        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsRenderingPage(false);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (isCancelled || error?.name === "RenderingCancelledException") {
          return;
        }

        setIsRenderingPage(false);
        setErrorMessage("PDF 页面渲染失败。");
      }
    }

    renderPage();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
    };
  }, [pageNumber, pdfDocument, scale]);

  function handlePreviousPage() {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.max(1, currentPage - 1));
  }

  function handleNextPage() {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.min(pageCount, currentPage + 1));
  }

  function handleZoomOut() {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.max(MIN_SCALE, Number((currentScale - SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  function handleZoomIn() {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Number((currentScale + SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="pdf-viewer">
      <div className="pdf-viewer-toolbar">
        <div className="pdf-viewer-status">
          {pageCount ? `第 ${pageNumber} / ${pageCount} 页` : "正在准备页面"}
        </div>
        <div className="pdf-viewer-controls">
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePreviousPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber <= 1}
          >
            上一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNextPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber >= pageCount}
          >
            下一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomOut}
            disabled={scale <= MIN_SCALE}
          >
            缩小
          </button>
          <span className="viewer-scale">{formatScale(scale)}</span>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomIn}
            disabled={scale >= MAX_SCALE}
          >
            放大
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="pdf-canvas-wrap">
        {errorMessage ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>预览不可用</strong>
            <p>{errorMessage}</p>
          </div>
        ) : isLoadingDocument ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>正在加载 PDF</strong>
            <p>文件已经导入，正在用 PDF.js 生成预览。</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
