const API_CONFIG = {
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:8000/api",
  useMock: true,
  endpoints: {
    upload: "/files/upload",
    chat: "/qa/ask",
  },
};

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function createUrl(path) {
  return `${API_CONFIG.baseUrl}${path}`;
}

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(createUrl(path), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(options.headers || {}),
    },
    ...options,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`请求失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function uploadCourseFile(file) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(300);
    const isPdf =
      (file.type && file.type.includes("pdf")) || file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");

    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      name: file.name,
      type: file.type || "application/octet-stream",
      size: file.size,
      previewUrl: isPdf ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : "",
      extractedText: `Mock 文本索引已生成，可用于右侧问答。文件名: ${file.name}`,
    };
  }

  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append("file", file);

  const response = await fetch(createUrl(API_CONFIG.endpoints.upload), {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`文件上传失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function askFileQuestion(payload) {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(650);
    return {
      answer: `根据当前 PDF 内容，你的问题“${payload.question}”大概率与第 ${Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(Math.random() * 15),
      )} 页相关。接真接口后，这里可以返回精确页码、原文片段和解释。`,
      citations: ["当前文件文本索引"],
    };
  }

  return request(API_CONFIG.endpoints.chat, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

export const apiConfig = API_CONFIG;

import { app, BrowserWindow, dialog, ipcMain, shell } from "electron";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const devServerUrl = process.env.VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL;

function getDocumentsDisplayPath(folderName) {
  return `~/Documents/${folderName}`;
}

function getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName) {
  return path.join(app.getPath("documents"), folderName);
}

async function ensureDirectory(folderPath) {
  await fs.mkdir(folderPath, { recursive: true });
}

async function createMainWindow() {
  const mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1480,
    height: 940,
    minWidth: 1180,
    minHeight: 760,
    backgroundColor: "#0f1115",
    autoHideMenuBar: true,
    ...(process.platform === "darwin"
      ? {
          titleBarStyle: "hidden",
          trafficLightPosition: {
            x: 18,
            y: 15,
          },
        }
      : {}),
    webPreferences: {
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      preload: path.join(__dirname, "preload.cjs"),
    },
  });

  if (devServerUrl) {
    await mainWindow.loadURL(devServerUrl);
    return;
  }

  await mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(projectRoot, "dist", "index.html"));
}

ipcMain.handle("workspace:create-documents-folder", async (_, folderName) => {
  const nextName = String(folderName || "").trim();
  if (!nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);
  await ensureDirectory(folderPath);

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:rename-documents-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const currentName = String(payload?.currentName || "").trim();
  const nextName = String(payload?.nextName || "").trim();

  if (!currentName || !nextName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "工作区名称不能为空。" };
  }

  const currentPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(currentName);
  const nextPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(nextName);

  if (currentPath !== nextPath) {
    try {
      await fs.rename(currentPath, nextPath);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error?.code === "ENOENT") {
        await ensureDirectory(nextPath);
      } else {
        return { ok: false, message: "重命名工作区文件夹失败。" };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    folderPath: nextPath,
    displayPath: getDocumentsDisplayPath(nextName),
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:pick-existing-folder", async () => {
  const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog({
    title: "选择已有工作区文件夹",
    properties: ["openDirectory"],
  });

  if (result.canceled || !result.filePaths.length) {
    return null;
  }

  const folderPath = result.filePaths[0];

  return {
    name: path.basename(folderPath),
    folderPath,
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:reveal-folder", async (_, payload) => {
  const sourceType = payload?.sourceType;
  const folderName = String(payload?.folderName || "").trim();
  let folderPath = String(payload?.folderPath || "").trim();

  if (sourceType === "documents") {
    if (!folderName) {
      return { ok: false, message: "缺少工作区名称。" };
    }

    folderPath = getDocumentsFolderPath(folderName);
    await ensureDirectory(folderPath);
  }

  if (!folderPath) {
    return { ok: false, message: "没有可显示的文件夹路径。" };
  }

  const openError = await shell.openPath(folderPath);
  if (openError) {
    return { ok: false, message: openError };
  }

  return { ok: true };
});

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  await createMainWindow();

  app.on("activate", async () => {
    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) {
      await createMainWindow();
    }
  });
});

app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
  if (process.platform !== "darwin") {
    app.quit();
  }
});

# 课堂 PDF 智能定位助手

这个项目已经按你当前的页面架构重建为 `React + Vite`：

1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
3. 每个文件夹右侧有三点菜单，可修改名称、删除、查看“在文件管理器中显示”入口。
4. 如果没有选择已有文件夹，新建工作区会默认归到 `~/Documents` 下对应名称的目录。
5. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域，上传文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹，并由 `PDF.js` 渲染预览。
6. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
7. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。

说明：
Web 版浏览器不能真正拉起系统文件管理器，所以“在文件管理器中显示”在浏览器里仍然是占位交互。
Electron 桌面版会真正调用系统文件管理器打开对应工作区文件夹。

## 项目结构

- `index.html`: Vite 入口
- `vite.config.js`: Vite 配置
- `src/main.jsx`: React 挂载入口
- `src/App.jsx`: 主界面与交互逻辑
- `src/PdfPreview.jsx`: 基于 `PDF.js` 的预览组件
- `src/api.js`: 上传和问答接口层
- `src/styles.css`: 主题与布局样式
- `electron/main.js`: Electron 主进程
- `electron/preload.cjs`: 桌面能力桥接层

## 启动方式

先安装依赖：

```bash
npm install
```

如果桌面版启动时报 `Electron failed to install correctly`，先执行：

```bash
npm run repair:electron
```

项目已经内置 Electron 镜像配置，修复脚本会优先从镜像下载桌面二进制。

开发模式运行：

```bash
npm run dev
```

默认会输出本地访问地址，通常是：

```text
http://localhost:5173
```

桌面版开发运行：

```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```

如果已经构建过前端，也可以直接启动桌面壳：

```bash
npm run build
npm run start:desktop
```

## 后端接口对接

当前 `src/api.js` 默认使用 Mock 模式。后续只需要替换两个方法：

- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口

推荐返回字段：

```json
{
  "id": "file_001",
  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
  "type": "application/pdf",
  "previewUrl": "https://...",
  "extractedText": "整份文件抽取后的文本"
}
```

```json
{
  "answer": "老师刚才提到的内容大约在第 12 页",
  "citations": ["第12页原文", "当前文件文本索引"]
}
```

import type {
  ApiConfig,
  AskFileQuestionPayload,
  AskFileQuestionResult,
  CourseFile,
} from "../types";

const API_CONFIG: ApiConfig = {
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:8000/api",
  useMock: true,
  endpoints: {
    upload: "/files/upload",
    chat: "/qa/ask",
  },
};

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function createUrl(path: string): string {
  return `${API_CONFIG.baseUrl}${path}`;
}

async function request<TResponse>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<TResponse> {
  const response = await fetch(createUrl(path), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(options.headers ?? {}),
    },
    ...options,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`请求失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return (await response.json()) as TResponse;
}

/**
 * Upload a course file and return the minimal metadata required by the UI.
 * The mock branch mirrors the real contract so the frontend can be integrated
 * with backend services later without rewriting the view layer.
 */
export async function uploadCourseFile(file: File): Promise<CourseFile> {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(300);

    const isPdf =
      (file.type && file.type.includes("pdf")) ||
      file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");

    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      name: file.name,
      type: file.type || "application/octet-stream",
      size: file.size,
      previewUrl: isPdf ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : "",
      extractedText: `Mock 文本索引已生成，可用于右侧问答。文件名: ${file.name}`,
      folderId: "",
    };
  }

  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append("file", file);

  const response = await fetch(createUrl(API_CONFIG.endpoints.upload), {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`文件上传失败: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return (await response.json()) as CourseFile;
}

/**
 * Ask a question against the currently selected PDF.
 * Keeping this service small makes it straightforward to replace the mock
 * branch with the real backend contract later.
 */
export async function askFileQuestion(
  payload: AskFileQuestionPayload,
): Promise<AskFileQuestionResult> {
  if (API_CONFIG.useMock) {
    await wait(650);

    return {
      answer: `根据当前 PDF 内容，你的问题“${payload.question}”大概率与第 ${Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(Math.random() * 15),
      )} 页相关。接真接口后，这里可以返回精确页码、原文片段和解释。`,
      citations: ["当前文件文本索引"],
    };
  }

  return request<AskFileQuestionResult>(API_CONFIG.endpoints.chat, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
}

export const apiConfig = API_CONFIG;

```

import type { CourseFile, WorkspaceFolder } from "../types";

interface ReviewSidebarProps {

  files: ReadonlyArray<CourseFile>;

  currentFileId: string;

  onSelectFile: (fileId: string, folderId: string) => void;

export default function ReviewSidebar({
  folders,
  files,
  selectedFolderId,
  currentFileId,
  onToggleFolder,
  onSelectFile,
}: ReviewSidebarProps): JSX.Element {

    <div className="folder-tree">
      {folders.map((folder) => {
        const folderFiles = files.filter((file) => file.folderId === folder.id);

        return (
          <article className="folder-item" key={folder.id}>
            <button
              className={`folder-row ${selectedFolderId === folder.id ? "active" : ""}`}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onToggleFolder(folder.id)}
            >
              <span className="folder-row-main">
                <span className="folder-chevron">

                </span>
                <span>{folder.name}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="folder-count">{folderFiles.length}</span>
            </button>

            {folder.expanded ? (
              <div className="folder-children">
                {folderFiles.length ? (
                  folderFiles.map((file) => (
                    <button
                      className={`tree-file ${file.id === currentFileId ? "active" : ""}`}
                      key={file.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onSelectFile(file.id, folder.id)}
                    >
                      {file.name}
                    </button>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <div className="tree-empty">这个文件夹里还没有文件</div>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </article>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, type FormEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import type { ChatMessage } from "../types";

interface ChatPanelProps {
  messages: ReadonlyArray<ChatMessage>;
  value: string;
  isAsking: boolean;
  onChange: (nextValue: string) => void;
  onSubmit: () => void;
}

export default function ChatPanel({
  messages,
  value,
  isAsking,
  onChange,
  onSubmit,
}: ChatPanelProps): JSX.Element {
  const messagesRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!messagesRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    messagesRef.current.scrollTop = messagesRef.current.scrollHeight;
  }, [messages, isAsking]);

  function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    onSubmit();
  }

  function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>): void {
    if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
      event.preventDefault();
      onSubmit();
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="chat-header">
        <h2 className="section-title">课件问答</h2>
      </div>

      <div className="chat-shell">
        <div className="chat-messages" ref={messagesRef}>
          {messages.map((message, index) => (
            <div className={`message ${message.role}`} key={`${message.role}-${index}`}>
              {message.text}
            </div>
          ))}
          {isAsking ? <div className="message assistant">AI 正在思考中...</div> : null}
        </div>

        <form className="chat-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <textarea
            value={value}
            onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="针对这份 PDF 提问..."
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          />
        </form>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

```
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { GlobalWorkerOptions, getDocument } from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.mjs";
import type { PDFDocumentProxy, RenderTask } from "pdfjs-dist/types/src/display/api";
import workerSource from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url";
import type { CourseFile } from "../types";

const DEFAULT_SCALE = 1.1;
const MIN_SCALE = 0.8;
const MAX_SCALE = 2;
const SCALE_STEP = 0.15;

GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerSource;

interface PdfPreviewProps {
  file: CourseFile;
}

function formatScale(scale: number): string {
  return `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
}

function hasErrorName(error: unknown, name: string): boolean {
  return (
    typeof error === "object" &&
    error !== null &&
    "name" in error &&
    (error as { name?: string }).name === name
  );
}

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (hasErrorName(error, "InvalidPDFException")) {
    return "这个文件不是有效的 PDF。";
  }

  if (hasErrorName(error, "MissingPDFException")) {
    return "没有找到可加载的 PDF 文件。";
  }

  return "PDF 加载失败，请检查文件内容或预览地址。";
}

export default function PdfPreview({ file }: PdfPreviewProps): JSX.Element {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const renderTaskRef = useRef<RenderTask | null>(null);

  const [pdfDocument, setPdfDocument] = useState<PDFDocumentProxy | null>(null);
  const [pageCount, setPageCount] = useState(0);
  const [pageNumber, setPageNumber] = useState(1);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(DEFAULT_SCALE);
  const [isLoadingDocument, setIsLoadingDocument] = useState(false);
  const [isRenderingPage, setIsRenderingPage] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setPdfDocument(null);
    setPageCount(0);
    setPageNumber(1);
    setScale(DEFAULT_SCALE);
    setErrorMessage("");
    renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();

    if (!file.previewUrl) {
      setIsLoadingDocument(false);
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;
    const loadingTask = getDocument({
      url: file.previewUrl,
      isEvalSupported: false,
    });

    setIsLoadingDocument(true);

    loadingTask.promise
      .then((nextDocument) => {
        if (isCancelled) {
          void nextDocument.destroy();
          return;
        }

        setPdfDocument(nextDocument);
        setPageCount(nextDocument.numPages);
        setPageNumber(1);
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setErrorMessage(getErrorMessage(error));
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsLoadingDocument(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
      void loadingTask.destroy();
    };
  }, [file.id, file.previewUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument) {
      return;
    }

    return () => {
      void pdfDocument.destroy();
    };
  }, [pdfDocument]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDocument || !canvasRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;

    async function renderPage(): Promise<void> {
      setIsRenderingPage(true);
      setErrorMessage("");

      try {
        const page = await pdfDocument.getPage(pageNumber);
        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;

        if (!canvas) {
          return;
        }

        const context = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false });

        if (!context) {
          setErrorMessage("当前浏览器无法初始化 PDF 画布。");
          return;
        }

        const outputScale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * outputScale);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * outputScale);
        canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(viewport.width)}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(viewport.height)}px`;
        context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();

        const renderTask = page.render({
          canvasContext: context,
          viewport,
          transform:
            outputScale === 1
              ? null
              : [outputScale, 0, 0, outputScale, 0, 0],
        });

        renderTaskRef.current = renderTask;
        await renderTask.promise;

        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsRenderingPage(false);
        }
      } catch (error: unknown) {
        if (isCancelled || hasErrorName(error, "RenderingCancelledException")) {
          return;
        }

        setIsRenderingPage(false);
        setErrorMessage("PDF 页面渲染失败。");
      }
    }

    void renderPage();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
    };
  }, [pageNumber, pdfDocument, scale]);

  function handlePreviousPage(): void {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.max(1, currentPage - 1));
  }

  function handleNextPage(): void {
    setPageNumber((currentPage) => Math.min(pageCount, currentPage + 1));
  }

  function handleZoomOut(): void {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.max(MIN_SCALE, Number((currentScale - SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  function handleZoomIn(): void {
    setScale((currentScale) =>
      Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Number((currentScale + SCALE_STEP).toFixed(2))),
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="pdf-viewer">
      <div className="pdf-viewer-toolbar">
        <div className="pdf-viewer-status">
          {pageCount ? `第 ${pageNumber} / ${pageCount} 页` : "正在准备页面"}
        </div>
        <div className="pdf-viewer-controls">
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePreviousPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber <= 1}
          >
            上一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNextPage}
            disabled={!pdfDocument || pageNumber >= pageCount}
          >
            下一页
          </button>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomOut}
            disabled={scale <= MIN_SCALE}
          >
            缩小
          </button>
          <span className="viewer-scale">{formatScale(scale)}</span>
          <button
            className="viewer-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={handleZoomIn}
            disabled={scale >= MAX_SCALE}
          >
            放大
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="pdf-canvas-wrap">
        {errorMessage ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>预览不可用</strong>
            <p>{errorMessage}</p>
          </div>
        ) : isLoadingDocument ? (
          <div className="pdf-state">
            <strong>正在加载 PDF</strong>
            <p>文件已经导入，正在用 PDF.js 生成预览。</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {isRenderingPage ? <div className="pdf-rendering-badge">渲染中</div> : null}
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="pdf-canvas" />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ChangeEvent } from "react";
import {
  CURRENT_FOLDER_ID,
  INITIAL_SUMMARIES,
  THEME_STORAGE_KEY,
  cloneInitialFiles,
  cloneInitialFolders,
  cloneInitialMessages,
} from "./constants";
import type {
  ChatMessage,
  CourseFile,
  ThemeMode,
  ViewMode,
  WorkspaceFolder,
} from "./types";
import { askFileQuestion, uploadCourseFile } from "./services/api";
import ChatPanel from "./components/ChatPanel";
import ModeSwitch from "./components/ModeSwitch";
import PanelToggleIcon from "./components/PanelToggleIcon";
import PdfPreview from "./components/PdfPreview";
import ReviewSidebar from "./components/ReviewSidebar";
import SummarySidebar from "./components/SummarySidebar";

function getStoredTheme(): ThemeMode {
  const storedTheme = window.localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
  return storedTheme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
}

/**
 * TypeScript reference implementation for the current product surface.
 * The goal is to keep behavior aligned with the existing JS version while
 * providing a maintainable foundation for future frontend collaboration.
 */
export default function App(): JSX.Element {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<ThemeMode>(getStoredTheme);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<ViewMode>("normal");
  const [isLeftOpen, setIsLeftOpen] = useState(true);
  const [isRightOpen, setIsRightOpen] = useState(true);

  const [folders, setFolders] = useState<WorkspaceFolder[]>(cloneInitialFolders);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<CourseFile[]>(cloneInitialFiles);
  const [selectedFolderId, setSelectedFolderId] = useState(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID);
  const [currentFileId, setCurrentFileId] = useState("");
  const [expandedSummaryId, setExpandedSummaryId] = useState(INITIAL_SUMMARIES[0]?.id ?? "");

  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>(cloneInitialMessages);
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState("");
  const [isAsking, setIsAsking] = useState(false);
  const [isSettingsOpen, setIsSettingsOpen] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    window.localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const currentFile = useMemo(
    () => files.find((file) => file.id === currentFileId) ?? null,
    [files, currentFileId],
  );

  function handleToggleFolder(folderId: string): void {
    setFolders((previousFolders) =>
      previousFolders.map((folder) =>
        folder.id === folderId
          ? { ...folder, expanded: !folder.expanded }
          : folder,
      ),
    );
  }

  function handleSelectFile(fileId: string, folderId: string): void {
    setCurrentFileId(fileId);
    setSelectedFolderId(folderId);
  }

  function handleToggleSummary(summaryId: string): void {
    setExpandedSummaryId((currentId) => (currentId === summaryId ? "" : summaryId));
  }

  async function handleUploadFile(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>): Promise<void> {
    const [file] = event.target.files ?? [];
    if (!file) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);
      const targetFolderId = selectedFolderId || CURRENT_FOLDER_ID;

      setFiles((previousFiles) => [
        { ...uploaded, folderId: targetFolderId },
        ...previousFiles,
      ]);
      setCurrentFileId(uploaded.id);
      setSelectedFolderId(targetFolderId);
      setFolders((previousFolders) =>
        previousFolders.map((folder) =>
          folder.id === targetFolderId ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("上传失败", error);
    } finally {
      event.target.value = "";
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmitQuestion(): Promise<void> {
    const question = chatInput.trim();
    if (!question || isAsking) {
      return;
    }

    setChatInput("");
    setChatMessages((previousMessages) => [
      ...previousMessages,
      { role: "user", text: question },
    ]);

    if (!currentFile) {
      setChatMessages((previousMessages) => [
        ...previousMessages,
        { role: "assistant", text: "请先上传或选择一份 PDF。" },
      ]);
      return;
    }

    setIsAsking(true);

    try {
      const response = await askFileQuestion({
        question,
        currentFileName: currentFile.name,
      });

      setChatMessages((previousMessages) => [
        ...previousMessages,
        { role: "assistant", text: response.answer },
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("问答失败", error);
      setChatMessages((previousMessages) => [
        ...previousMessages,
        { role: "assistant", text: "问答出错，请稍后再试。" },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsAsking(false);
    }
  }

  function handlePreviewStageClick(): void {
    if (!currentFile) {
      fileInputRef.current?.click();
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-frame">
      <header className="app-topbar">
        <div className="topbar-cluster topbar-left">
          <div className="window-controls-slot" aria-hidden="true" />
          <button
            className="icon-button nav-toggle-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsLeftOpen((current) => !current)}
            title={isLeftOpen ? "收起左侧栏" : "展开左侧栏"}
          >
            <PanelToggleIcon mirrored={!isLeftOpen} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="topbar-center">
          <ModeSwitch value={viewMode} onChange={setViewMode} />
        </div>

        <div className="topbar-cluster topbar-right">
          <button
            className="icon-button nav-toggle-button"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsRightOpen((current) => !current)}
            title={isRightOpen ? "收起问答栏" : "展开问答栏"}
          >
            <PanelToggleIcon mirrored={isRightOpen} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div
        className={`app-body ${isLeftOpen ? "left-open" : "left-closed"} ${
          isRightOpen ? "right-open" : "right-closed"
        }`}
      >
        <aside
          className={`sidebar-panel left-panel ${isLeftOpen ? "open" : "closed"}`}
        >
          <div className="sidebar-panel-inner">
            <div className="sidebar-top-spacer" aria-hidden="true" />
            <div className="file-tree-panel sidebar-mode-shell">
              <div
                className={`sidebar-mode-pane ${
                  viewMode === "normal" ? "active" : "inactive"
                }`}
              >
                <SummarySidebar
                  summaries={INITIAL_SUMMARIES}
                  expandedSummaryId={expandedSummaryId}
                  onToggleSummary={handleToggleSummary}
                />
              </div>

              <div
                className={`sidebar-mode-pane ${
                  viewMode === "review" ? "active" : "inactive"
                }`}
              >
                <ReviewSidebar
                  folders={folders}
                  files={files}
                  selectedFolderId={selectedFolderId}
                  currentFileId={currentFileId}
                  onToggleFolder={handleToggleFolder}
                  onSelectFile={handleSelectFile}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>

        <main className="main-layer">
          <section className="preview-shell">
            <div className="preview-toolbar">
              <div className="preview-toolbar-actions">
                <span className="panel-badge">
                  {currentFile ? currentFile.name : "未选择文件"}
                </span>
                <button
                  className="icon-button"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
                  title="打开设置"
                >
                  ⚙
                </button>
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  id="file-input-ts"
                  type="file"
                  accept=".pdf"
                  hidden
                  onChange={handleUploadFile}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div
              className={`preview-stage ${currentFile ? "" : "preview-stage-empty"}`.trim()}
              onClick={handlePreviewStageClick}
            >
              {currentFile ? (
                <PdfPreview file={currentFile} />
              ) : (
                <div className="empty-state">
                  <div className="upload-card">
                    <div className="upload-icon">PDF</div>
                    <div className="upload-title">点击上传 PDF 开始预览</div>
                    <div className="upload-copy">
                      上传后的文件会进入当前选中的文件夹。
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>
        </main>

        <aside
          className={`sidebar-panel right-panel ${isRightOpen ? "open" : "closed"}`}
        >
          <div className="chat-panel-inner">
            <ChatPanel
              messages={chatMessages}
              value={chatInput}
              isAsking={isAsking}
              onChange={setChatInput}
              onSubmit={() => {
                void handleSubmitQuestion();
              }}
            />
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>

      {isSettingsOpen ? (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3 className="modal-title">设置</h3>
              <button
                className="icon-button"
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="settings-row">
                <span>主题模式</span>
                <select
                  value={theme}
                  onChange={(event) => setTheme(event.target.value as ThemeMode)}
                >
                  <option value="light">浅色</option>
                  <option value="dark">深色</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

```

# 课堂 PDF 智能定位助手

这个项目当前保留了两套前端实现：

- `src/`: 现有的 JavaScript 版本，继续作为当前运行版本保留
- `src-ts/`: 新增的 TypeScript 版本，按更清晰的模块结构重写，便于后续协作和维护

整体产品形态保持一致：

1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
## 项目结构

- `index.html`: JavaScript 版本入口
- `index-ts.html`: TypeScript 版本入口
- `vite.config.js`: JavaScript 版本 Vite 配置
- `vite.ts.config.js`: TypeScript 版本 Vite 配置
- `src/`: 当前 JavaScript 版本源码
- `src-ts/`: 新增的 TypeScript 版本源码
- `src-ts/components/`: TS 组件层
- `src-ts/services/`: TS 接口层
- `src-ts/types.ts`: TS 领域模型与接口定义
- `src/styles.css`: 共享主题与布局样式
- `electron/main.js`: Electron 主进程
- `electron/preload.cjs`: 桌面能力桥接层

## 启动方式
开发模式运行：

```bash
npm run dev
```

TypeScript 版本开发模式运行：

```bash
npm run dev:ts
```

默认会输出本地访问地址，通常是：

```text
http://localhost:5173
```

TypeScript 版本默认运行在：

```text
http://127.0.0.1:3001/index-ts.html
```

桌面版开发运行：

```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```

TypeScript 版本桌面开发运行：

```bash
npm run dev:desktop:ts
```

如果已经构建过前端，也可以直接启动桌面壳：

```bash
npm run build
npm run start:desktop
```

TypeScript 版本的类型检查和构建：

```bash
npm run typecheck:ts
npm run build:ts
npm run start:desktop:ts
```

## TypeScript 版本说明

`src-ts/` 不是对现有代码的覆盖，而是一套并行版本，目的有两点：

- 保留当前可运行的 JS 版本，避免影响正在推进的界面工作
- 提供更适合长期维护的 TS 结构，包括显式类型、拆分后的组件、独立服务层和更清晰的职责边界

## 后端接口对接

当前 `src/api.js` 和 `src-ts/services/api.ts` 都默认使用 Mock 模式。后续只需要替换两个方法：

- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口

# 课堂 PDF 智能定位助手

这个项目当前保留了两套前端实现：

- `src/`: 现有的 JavaScript 版本，继续作为当前运行版本保留
- `src-ts/`: 新增的 TypeScript 版本，按更清晰的模块结构重写，便于后续协作和维护

整体产品形态保持一致：

1. 左侧是一栏文件夹树，点击文件夹展开文件。
2. 文件栏右上角是创建文件夹入口，可新建工作区文件夹或选择已有文件夹。
3. 每个文件夹右侧有三点菜单，可修改名称、删除、查看“在文件管理器中显示”入口。
4. 如果没有选择已有文件夹，新建工作区会默认归到 `~/Documents` 下对应名称的目录。
5. 中间是 PDF 上传与预览区域，上传文件会进入当前选中的工作区文件夹，并由 `PDF.js` 渲染预览。
6. 右侧是基于当前文件的问答区。
7. 浅色 / 深色主题可切换，后续可以直接接入软件设置。

说明：
Web 版浏览器不能真正拉起系统文件管理器，所以“在文件管理器中显示”在浏览器里仍然是占位交互。
Electron 桌面版会真正调用系统文件管理器打开对应工作区文件夹。

## 项目结构

- `index.html`: JavaScript 版本入口
- `index-ts.html`: TypeScript 版本入口
- `vite.config.js`: JavaScript 版本 Vite 配置
- `vite.ts.config.js`: TypeScript 版本 Vite 配置
- `src/`: 当前 JavaScript 版本源码
- `src-ts/`: 新增的 TypeScript 版本源码
- `src-ts/components/`: TS 组件层
- `src-ts/services/`: TS 接口层
- `src-ts/types.ts`: TS 领域模型与接口定义
- `src/styles.css`: 共享主题与布局样式
- `electron/main.js`: Electron 主进程
- `electron/preload.cjs`: 桌面能力桥接层

## 启动方式

先安装依赖：

```bash
npm install
```

如果桌面版启动时报 `Electron failed to install correctly`，先执行：

```bash
npm run repair:electron
```

项目已经内置 Electron 镜像配置，修复脚本会优先从镜像下载桌面二进制。

开发模式运行：

```bash
npm run dev
```

TypeScript 版本开发模式运行：

```bash
npm run dev:ts
```

默认会输出本地访问地址，通常是：

```text
http://localhost:5173
```

TypeScript 版本默认运行在：

```text
http://127.0.0.1:3001/index-ts.html
```

桌面版开发运行：

```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```

TypeScript 版本桌面开发运行：

```bash
npm run dev:desktop:ts
```

如果已经构建过前端，也可以直接启动桌面壳：

```bash
npm run build
npm run start:desktop
```

TypeScript 版本的类型检查和构建：

```bash
npm run typecheck:ts
npm run build:ts
npm run start:desktop:ts
```

## TypeScript 版本说明

`src-ts/` 不是对现有代码的覆盖，而是一套并行版本，目的有两点：

- 保留当前可运行的 JS 版本，避免影响正在推进的界面工作
- 提供更适合长期维护的 TS 结构，包括显式类型、拆分后的组件、独立服务层和更清晰的职责边界

## 后端接口对接

当前 `src/api.js` 和 `src-ts/services/api.ts` 都默认使用 Mock 模式。后续只需要替换两个方法：

- `uploadCourseFile(file)`: 上传 PDF，返回文件 id、预览地址、抽取文本等
- `askFileQuestion(payload)`: 右侧问答接口

推荐返回字段：

```json
{
  "id": "file_001",
  "name": "lecture1.pdf",
  "type": "application/pdf",
  "previewUrl": "https://...",
  "extractedText": "整份文件抽取后的文本"
}
```

```json
{
  "answer": "老师刚才提到的内容大约在第 12 页",
  "citations": ["第12页原文", "当前文件文本索引"]
}
```

## Assistant

报错的根因就是这一行：

```text
Error: Port 3000 is already in use
```

我查了你本机当前端口占用，`127.0.0.1:3000` 现在已经有一个 `node` 进程在监听，PID 是 `27739`。  
所以这次启动流程是：

1. `npm run dev` 想起一个新的 Vite 服务
2. 但 `vite.config.js` 里端口固定为 `3000`，而且 `strictPort: true`
3. 端口被占用后，Vite 直接退出
4. `concurrently` 检测到前面的进程挂了，就把后面的 Electron 也一起 `SIGTERM`
5. 后面那串 Electron 的 `mach_port_rendezvous` / `parent died` 只是连带报错，不是主因

另外这两类 warning 不是这次失败的原因：

- `Unknown project config "electron_mirror"`
- `Unknown env config "electron-mirror"`

你现在有两个处理办法：

1. 结束占用 `3000` 的旧进程，再重新跑 `npm run dev:desktop`
2. 或者我直接把项目开发端口改掉，比如改成 `3002`，同时把 `dev:desktop` 里的 `wait-on` 和 `VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL` 一起改掉

如果你要，我可以直接帮你把端口改掉，省得以后再撞到 `3000`。

PDF Matching](#3-pdf-matching)\n   - [4. Output](#4-output)\n5. [Running the Pipeline](#running-the-pipeline)\n6. [Full CLI Reference](#full-cli-reference)\n7. [Output Interface Specification](#output-interface-specification)\n\n---\n\n## Overview\n\n```\nMicrophone → Audio Enhancement → Deepgram STT ─────────────┐\n                                                            ↓\n                                             Transcript Quality Gate\n                                                            ↓\n                                        DeepSeek / LLM API (Summary)\n                                                            ↓\n                             PDF Slides → Embedding API (BGE-M3) → Page Matching\n                                                            ↓\n                                        merged_results.json + interface_output.json\n```\n\nEach stage is independently configurable.  Different providers can be used for each stage (e.g. Deepgram for transcription, DeepSeek for summarisation, SiliconFlow/BGE-M3 for embeddings).\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Python 3.10 or later\n- The `merge_syn` package installed (provides shared audio, quality, and bridge utilities)\n- API keys for your chosen providers (see below)\n\nInstall dependencies:\n\n```bash\npip install -r requirements.txt\n```\n\n---\n\n## API Key Configuration\n\nAll providers are managed through a shared registry stored at:\n\n```\n~/.config/lite_synphonia/providers.json\n```\n\nUse the `providers` sub-command to register each API key.  You only need to do this once per provider.\n\n### Register a Provider\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers add <name> \\\n    --base-url  <endpoint-url> \\\n    --model     <model-id> \\\n    --api-key   <your-api-key> \\\n    --service   <transcription|summarization|embedding>\n```\n\n### Recommended Provider Setup\n\n#### Transcription — Deepgram\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers add deepgram \\\n    --base-url  https://api.deepgram.com \\\n    --model     whisper-large \\\n    --api-key   YOUR_DEEPGRAM_API_KEY \\\n    --service   transcription\n```\n\nModels available on Deepgram: `whisper-large` (recommended for Chinese), `nova-2-general`, `nova-2`.\n`whisper-large` is more robust at lower audio signal levels; `nova-2-general` is faster but requires cleaner audio (RMS ≥ 0.015).\n\n#### Summarisation — DeepSeek\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers add deepseek \\\n    --base-url  https://api.deepseek.com/v1 \\\n    --model     deepseek-chat \\\n    --api-key   YOUR_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY \\\n    --service   summarization\n```\n\nAny OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint can be used here (OpenAI, MiniMax, Qwen, etc.).\n\n#### Embedding — SiliconFlow / BGE\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers add siliconflow-embed \\\n    --base-url  https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1 \\\n    --model     BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5 \\\n    --api-key   YOUR_SILICONFLOW_API_KEY \\\n    --service   embedding\n```\n\nBGE-family models (e.g. `BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5`, `BAAI/bge-m3`) support Chinese, English, and mixed-language content and do not require input prefixes.  For E5-family models, pass `--embedding-passage-prefix \"passage: \"` and `--embedding-query-prefix \"query: \"` at runtime (see CLI reference).\n\n### List Registered Providers\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers list\n```\n\n---\n\n## Function Reference\n\n### 1. Transcription\n\n**Purpose:** Capture microphone audio, enhance it, and convert it to a timestamped transcript using Deepgram's Speech-to-Text API.\n\n#### Audio Enhancement Pipeline\n\nRaw microphone samples pass through the following chain before being sent to Deepgram:\n\n| Step | Operation | Default | Effect |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | DC offset removal | always on | Removes hardware bias that AGC would amplify |\n| 2 | Input gain | `1.0` | Fixed scalar pre-multiplier |\n| 3 | Noise gate | threshold `0.003` | Zeroes chunks whose RMS is below the silence floor, preventing background noise from being amplified and hallucinated by Deepgram |\n| 4 | Bidirectional AGC | target `0.03`, max `2.0×` | Attenuates loud signals AND amplifies quiet ones toward the target RMS; the previous one-directional AGC only amplified, causing loud audio to clip |\n| 5 | Pre-emphasis | `α = 0.97` | High-pass filter `y[n] = x[n] − 0.97·x[n−1]`; boosts consonants (zh/ch/sh/s) that ASR models rely on; standard in Kaldi/ESPnet |\n| 6 | Soft-knee limiter | ceiling `0.72` | Applies a Hermite curve in the 85–100% zone before the ceiling instead of hard clipping; eliminates inter-modulation distortion that degrades confidence |\n| 7 | Hard clip | `[-1, 1]` | Safety net only |\n\nPass `--no-agc` to bypass steps 2–6 entirely when your hardware already provides a clean signal.\n\n#### Deepgram Transcription\n\nThe enhanced audio is encoded as 16-bit WAV at 16 kHz and sent to Deepgram's `/v1/listen` endpoint with the following parameters:\n\n```\npunctuate=true   smart_format=true   utterances=true\nutt_split=1.2    numerals=true       filler_words=false\n```\n\n`utt_split=1.2` uses a 1.2-second pause as the utterance boundary, which matches the natural thinking pauses in lecture speech.  `filler_words=false` removes disfluencies (uh, um, 那个, 就是) from the transcript.\n\n#### Fallback Chain\n\nIf the primary model returns no segments, the pipeline automatically retries in order:\n\n1. Enhanced audio, primary model, specified language\n2. Raw audio (pre-enhancement), primary model, specified language\n3. Enhanced audio, primary model, language auto-detect\n4. Enhanced audio, `whisper-large`, language auto-detect (only if primary is not whisper-large)\n\nThe model that actually produced the transcript is recorded in `transcription.json` under `runtime.selected_model`.\n\n#### Quality Gate\n\nAfter transcription, a quality assessment runs:\n\n- `decision: pass` — mean confidence ≥ threshold and content present → pipeline continues\n- `decision: warn` — confidence below the merge_syn hard floor but content passes a diversity check → downstream stages run with a warning flag\n- `decision: fail` — no usable content → downstream stages are blocked (use `--allow-low-quality-transcript` to override)\n\nThe quality confidence threshold defaults to `0.15` and is tunable with `--quality-confidence-threshold`.\n\n#### Output\n\n```\n<output-dir>/transcription/\n    transcription.json          Full payload (metrics, segments, quality, preflight)\n    raw_audio.wav               Pre-enhancement recording\n    enhanced_audio.wav          Post-enhancement recording\n    deepgram_response_raw.json  Present only when all attempts return empty results\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2. Summarisation\n\n**Purpose:** Condense the transcript into a concise summary using an OpenAI-compatible LLM API.\n\n#### Windowing\n\nFor long transcripts that exceed the LLM's effective context window, the transcript is processed in overlapping windows:\n\n| Parameter | Default | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `--summary-window-size` | 200 | Words per window |\n| `--summary-overlap-size` | 60 | Overlap words between consecutive windows |\n| `--summary-chunk-size` | 1200 | Characters read per incremental pass |\n| `--summary-max-new-tokens` | 384 | Maximum tokens the LLM may generate per call |\n\nWhen the full transcript fits within a single window (≤ 200 words), the LLM processes it in one pass with no boundary stitching.  This is the ideal case and the most common for lecture segments of 5–10 minutes.\n\n#### Providers\n\nAny OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.  Register it with `--service summarization`.  The model must support chat-completion (`/v1/chat/completions`).\n\nNote: DeepSeek and other providers that offer only chat completions cannot be used for embedding.  Keep the summarisation and embedding providers separate.\n\n#### Output\n\n```\n<output-dir>/\n    input/transcript.txt        Flat transcript fed to the LLM\n    summary/results.json        Summary rounds, text, and runtime metadata\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. PDF Matching\n\n**Purpose:** Given a PDF slide deck, assign each transcript segment to the slide page the speaker was most likely discussing at that moment.\n\n#### Architecture\n\nMatching is performed in two phases:\n\n**Phase A — PDF Preprocessing (once per unique PDF)**\n\n1. Extract text from each page and split into overlapping chunks (`pdf_reader`)\n2. Check the on-disk embedding cache (key: `sha256(pdf_bytes)[:16]_<model>.npz`)\n3. If cache miss: embed all chunks in a single batch API call; write cache\n4. If cache hit: load embeddings directly — no API call\n\n**Phase B — Query Matching (per run)**\n\n1. Collect all unique segment texts from the transcript\n2. Embed them in a single batch API call (all segments at once — previously one call per segment)\n3. The matching loop uses only local numpy dot products — no further API calls\n4. A Viterbi smoother enforces global monotonic ordering (lecture slides only advance)\n\nThis architecture reduces API calls during matching from O(N segments) to O(1) regardless of transcript length.\n\n#### Embedding Prefix Configuration\n\n| Model family | passage prefix | query prefix |\n|---|---|---|\n| BGE-M3, OpenAI | `\"\"` (default) | `\"\"` (default) |\n| multilingual-E5 | `\"passage: \"` | `\"query: \"` |\n\nSet prefixes via `--embedding-passage-prefix` and `--embedding-query-prefix`.\n\n#### PDF Embedding Cache\n\nBy default, chunk embeddings are cached to `<output-dir>/.pdf_embed_cache/`.  The cache key encodes both the PDF content (SHA-256) and the model name, so it invalidates automatically when either changes.  On a cache hit, the PDF embedding stage is skipped entirely.\n\nDisable the cache:\n```bash\n--pdf-cache-dir none\n",

Summarisation\n\n**Purpose:** Condense the transcript into a concise summary using an OpenAI-compatible LLM API.\n\n#### Windowing\n\nFor long transcripts that exceed the LLM's effective context window, the transcript is processed in overlapping windows:\n\n| Parameter | Default | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `--summary-window-size` | 200 | Words per window |\n| `--summary-overlap-size` | 60 | Overlap words between consecutive windows |\n| `--summary-chunk-size` | 1200 | Characters read per incremental pass |\n| `--summary-max-new-tokens` | 384 | Maximum tokens the LLM may generate per call |\n\nWhen the full transcript fits within a single window (≤ 200 words), the LLM processes it in one pass with no boundary stitching.  This is the ideal case and the most common for lecture segments of 5–10 minutes.\n\n#### Providers\n\nAny OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.  Register it with `--service summarization`.  The model must support chat-completion (`/v1/chat/completions`).\n\nNote: DeepSeek and other providers that offer only chat completions cannot be used for embedding.  Keep the summarisation and embedding providers separate.\n\n#### Output\n\n```\n<output-dir>/\n    input/transcript.txt        Flat transcript fed to the LLM\n    summary/results.json        Summary rounds, text, and runtime metadata\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. PDF Matching\n\n**Purpose:** Given a PDF slide deck, assign each transcript segment to the slide page the speaker was most likely discussing at that moment.\n\n#### Architecture\n\nMatching is performed in two phases:\n\n**Phase A — PDF Preprocessing (once per unique PDF)**\n\n1. Extract text from each page and split into overlapping chunks (`pdf_reader`)\n2. Check the on-disk embedding cache (key: `sha256(pdf_bytes)[:16]_<model>.npz`)\n3. If cache miss: embed all chunks in a single batch API call; write cache\n4. If cache hit: load embeddings directly — no API call\n\n**Phase B — Query Matching (per run)**\n\n1. Collect all unique segment texts from the transcript\n2. Embed them in a single batch API call (all segments at once — previously one call per segment)\n3. The matching loop uses only local numpy dot products — no further API calls\n4. A Viterbi smoother enforces global monotonic ordering (lecture slides only advance)\n\nThis architecture reduces API calls during matching from O(N segments) to O(1) regardless of transcript length.\n\n#### Embedding Prefix Configuration\n\n| Model family | passage prefix | query prefix |\n|---|---|---|\n| BGE-M3, OpenAI | `\"\"` (default) | `\"\"` (default) |\n| multilingual-E5 | `\"passage: \"` | `\"query: \"` |\n\nSet prefixes via `--embedding-passage-prefix` and `--embedding-query-prefix`.\n\n#### PDF Embedding Cache\n\nBy default, chunk embeddings are cached to `<output-dir>/.pdf_embed_cache/`.  The cache key encodes both the PDF content (SHA-256) and the model name, so it invalidates automatically when either changes.  On a cache hit, the PDF embedding stage is skipped entirely.\n\nDisable the cache:\n```bash\n--pdf-cache-dir none\n",

}

A Viterbi smoother enforces global monotonic ordering (lecture slides only advance)\n\nThis architecture reduces API calls during matching from O(N segments) to O(1) regardless of transcript length.\n\n#### Embedding Prefix Configuration\n\n| Model family | passage prefix | query prefix |\n|---|---|---|\n| BGE-M3, OpenAI | `\"\"` (default) | `\"\"` (default) |\n| multilingual-E5 | `\"passage: \"` | `\"query: \"` |\n\nSet prefixes via `--embedding-passage-prefix` and `--embedding-query-prefix`.\n\n#### PDF Embedding Cache\n\nBy default, chunk embeddings are cached to `<output-dir>/.pdf_embed_cache/`.  The cache key encodes both the PDF content (SHA-256) and the model name, so it invalidates automatically when either changes.  On a cache hit, the PDF embedding stage is skipped entirely.\n\nDisable the cache:\n```bash\n--pdf-cache-dir none\n```\n\nUse a shared cache directory across multiple runs:\n```bash\n--pdf-cache-dir ~/.cache/lite_synphonia/pdf_embeddings\n```\n\n#### Output\n\n```\n<output-dir>/pdf_match/results.json\n```\n\nThe `timeline` array contains page-level time ranges:\n\n```json\n[\n  { \"page_index\": 0, \"start_time\": 0.0,  \"end_time\": 43.2, \"confidence\": 0.81 },\n  { \"page_index\": 2, \"start_time\": 43.2, \"end_time\": 90.0, \"confidence\": 0.76 }\n]\n```\n\nThe `segment_matches` array gives per-segment assignments with raw page scores, smoothed page, and the reason for any state-machine decision (e.g. `page_switch_confirmed`, `stay_current_page`, `global_monotonic_smoothing`).\n\n---\n\n### 4. All downstream consumers must handle missing optional fields gracefully.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"schema_version\": \"1.0\",\n  \"activity_id\":    \"a3f9c1d2e4b5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5\",\n  \"transcript_meta\": {\n      \"segment_count\":     30,\n      \"mean_confidence\":   0.7286,\n      \"recorded_seconds\":  300.0,\n      \"language\":          \"zh\"\n    }\n  },\n\n  \"summary\":  \"deepseek\"\n    }\n  },\n\n  \"ppt\": {\n    \"ppt_present\":    true,\n    \"ppt_file_path\":  \"/path/to/slides.pdf\",\n    \"ppt_id\":         \"\",\n\n    \"matched_slides\": [\n      { \"slide_index\": 0, \"start_time\": 0.0,   \"end_time\": 43.2, \"confidence\": 0.81 },\n      { \"slide_index\": 2, \"start_time\": 43.2,  \"end_time\": 90.0, \"confidence\": 0.76 }\n    ],\n\n    \"ppt_text_excerpt\": [\n      { \"slide_index\": 0, \"text_preview\": \"深度学习入门...\" },\n      { \"slide_index\": 2, \"text_preview\": \"卷积神经网络...\" }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n#### Required vs Optional Fields\n\n| Field | Required | Present when |\n|---|---|---|\n| `schema_version` | ✓ | Always |\n| `activity_id` | ✓ | Always (auto-generated UUID4 if not supplied) |\n| `created_at_utc` | ✓ | Always In high-quality restoration, keeping the 'look and feel' of the structure is way more important than just chasing a low error number. But the real question we’re trying to answer is: Is MSE actually a good way to tell if a photo looks ‘good,’ or is there a better way?Before we could fix anything, we had to ‘diagnose’ the image. Looking at the original and its FFT spectrum, it’s clear we’re dealing with a mess of noise. We’ve got periodic stripes—you can see those pulses off-center in the spectrum—plus that annoying salt-and-pepper noise. So, we came up with a four-step game plan: analyze the spectrum, clean up the stripes in the frequency domain, refine the details in the spatial domain, and then double-check everything with different metrics.Step one: getting rid of those stripes. We used a Low-Pass Filter (LPF) and played around with the cutoff frequency, D0. At 70, the stripes were still there. At 50, the whole thing got way too blurry. We found that 60 was the ‘Goldilocks’ zone. It killed the stripes and brought our MSE down to 0.0299, but we still had some graininess and slight blurring to deal with.Next, we wondered: could we just use a standard spatial filter and call it a day? We tested three classics. Mean and Gaussian filters were honestly a bit of a disaster—they blurred everything, and Gaussian actually had the worst MSE at 0.0301. The Median filter was the clear winner here, hitting an MSE of 0.0178. It’s definitely the king of handling that salt-and-pepper look.\"\"Since no single filter was perfect, we decided to chain them together. We built a pipeline starting with the LPF and followed it up with spatial filters. The ‘LPF + Median’ combo gave us the best ‘traditional’ result with an MSE of 0.0294. This proved that a two-stage approach is way more robust when you’re fighting mixed noise.So, looking at the numbers, you’d think the standalone Median filter is the champion because it has the lowest MSE, right? Well, here’s the plot twist: numbers can be misleading. As we move into our exploration phase, we’re going to show you why the 'best' ranking on paper can actually look pretty bad to the human eye.This is where things get interesting. MSE is great at counting pixel errors, but it’s totally blind to the actual *structure* of a photo. Our data showed that while the Median filter has a great score, it ‘over-smooths’ everything. It basically turns textures into plastic. This confirmed that we needed a smarter metric, which is why we brought in SSIM.To make our evaluation feel more ‘human,’ we used SSIM. Unlike MSE, which just looks at pixel brightness, SSIM checks for three things: luminance, contrast, and—most importantly—structure. It cares if the edges and textures actually look like they’re supposed to. And man, did the rankings change! The Median filter, our previous ‘winner,’ crashed down to 5th place. Meanwhile, the ‘LPF + Mean’ combo jumped to the top. It turns out, our eyes care way more about structure than pixel-perfect math.Even with SSIM, we hit a wall. All these classic filters have the same problem: they’re ‘isotropic,’ meaning they blur everything equally. They can’t tell the difference between noise and a sharp edge. The Gaussian filter was the worst offender here, proving that if your smoothing isn't ‘smart,’ you’re just going to ruin the image quality.That’s where NLM, or Non-Local Means, comes in. You can see the workflow here. Instead of just averaging the pixels right next to each other, NLM scans the whole area for patches that look similar. On the right, you can see how it works: the algorithm finds areas that match our target patch (the dark blue box). The better the match—shown in darker green—the more ‘weight’ that area gets. It’s basically using the patterns in the image to fix itself, which is why it’s so much better at keeping edges sharp.To wrap things up, our tests confirmed that the ‘LPF + NLM’ combo is the real MVP. It hit the highest SSIM of 0.607 while keeping a very solid MSE. The big takeaway from our journey? In high-quality restoration, keeping the 'look and feel' of the structure is way more important than just chasing a low error number. Sometimes you have to accept a bit of numerical noise to get a result that actually looks real. That’s it for us! Thanks for listening, and I’d love to hear your questions.\n",

## Assistant

我读完了，结论先说清楚：

这套 `lite_synphonia` 目前本质上不是一个 Web 后端服务，而是一套 **CLI 流水线**。它负责把一次讲课处理成标准化 JSON 结果，然后可选写入知识库。入口在 [lite_synphonia/__main__.py](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/lite_synphonia/__main__.py:271)，主流程在 [lite_synphonia/pipeline.py](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/lite_synphonia/pipeline.py:760)，配置模型在 [lite_synphonia/config.py](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/lite_synphonia/config.py:1)，对外稳定输出格式说明在 [lite_synphonia/README.md](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/lite_synphonia/README.md:285)。

**这套后端现在做了什么**
- 录音或读音频，做增强后调用 Deepgram 转录
- 对转录结果做质量判定，质量太差会阻断后续阶段
- 把转录文本送到 LLM 做摘要
- 如果给了 PDF，再做 transcript 到 slide 的页码匹配
- 最后写出 `merged_results.json` 和 `interface_output.json`
- 可选把最终结果写入知识库

核心流水线就是：

`音频 -> 转录 -> 摘要 -> PDF匹配 -> 标准输出`

**对前端最重要的产物**
前端不要直接依赖内部每一层细节，优先吃这个标准结果：

- `interface_output.json`

它里面已经整理好了三块：
- `transcription`
  - `transcript_text`
  - `transcript_meta`
- `summary`
  - `summary_text`
  - `keywords`
- `ppt`
  - `matched_slides`
  - `ppt_text_excerpt`

对应构造逻辑在 [lite_synphonia/pipeline.py](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/lite_synphonia/pipeline.py:977) 和写文件逻辑在 [lite_synphonia/pipeline.py](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/lite_synphonia/pipeline.py:1151)。

如果你要更细粒度内容，还可以读：
- `transcription/transcription.json`
- `summary/results.json`
- `pdf_match/results.json`

**和你前端怎么结合**
你当前前端是三栏，这样接最合适：

1. 左栏总结区
- 直接吃 `summary/results.json` 里的 `results`
- 或者吃 `interface_output.json.summary.summary_text`
- 但要注意：你现在的 UI 是“多个总结卡片，展开看依据转录”
- 这套后端目前有“摘要结果”和“完整转录”，但**没有天然的 summary -> source transcript 映射**
- 也就是说，如果你要做到“点开某条总结，看到对应依据”，后端最好补一个字段，比如：
  - `source_segment_ids`
  - 或 `start_time/end_time`
  - 或 `source_text_excerpt`

2. 中间 PDF 预览区
- 前端自己继续负责 PDF 预览
- 后端给你的是 `ppt.matched_slides`
- 字段里有：
  - `slide_index`
  - `start_time`
  - `end_time`
  - `confidence`
- 你可以根据“当前播放/转录时间”自动跳到对应 PDF 页
- 这正好对应你们项目“老师说到哪，PDF 跳到哪”

3. 右侧问答区
- 这套 `lite_synphonia` **没有现成 QA 接口**
- 我搜过代码，没有真正的 `ask/question/chat` 服务端实现，只有摘要阶段调用 chat-completion 模型
- 所以右侧问答需要你们单独再做一个接口
- 最简单的做法：
  - 把 `transcript_text + PDF文本 + matched_slides` 作为上下文
  - 再单独做 `/qa/ask`

**现在最大的问题**
这套后端目前是“跑完一次，写文件”，不是“前端可直接请求的 HTTP API”。

所以如果你要真正和前端接起来，建议包一层服务。最小可用接口我建议这样设计：

- `POST /api/activities`
  - 创建一次处理任务
  - 参数：`activity_id`, `pdf`, `seconds` 或音频来源
  - 返回：`activity_id`
- `GET /api/activities/:id/status`
  - 返回当前阶段：`transcribing / summarizing / matching / done / failed`
- `GET /api/activities/:id/interface`
  - 直接返回 `interface_output.json`
- `GET /api/activities/:id/transcription`
  - 返回 `transcription.json`
- `GET /api/activities/:id/pdf-match`
  - 返回 `pdf_match/results.json`
- `POST /api/qa/ask`
  - 这是右侧问答，需单独实现

**如果按你现在这个前端来接，我的实际建议**
先不要让前端直接碰 `lite_synphonia` 的 CLI。  
应该让你朋友在它外面包一层 `FastAPI` 或 `Flask`，把 `run_pipeline(cfg)` 包成任务接口，然后前端只请求 JSON。

最重要的前后端契约是这三个：

- 转录分段：`results[].{text,t0,t1,confidence}`
- 页码定位：`ppt.matched_slides[].{slide_index,start_time,end_time,confidence}`
- 标准总输出：`interface_output.json`

如果你要，我下一步可以直接给你一版：
1. 适合你当前前端的后端 API 设计文档
2. 或者直接帮你写一个 `FastAPI` 包装层，把 `lite_synphonia` 变成前端能调的接口。

import type { CourseFile, CourseFileKind } from "../types";

export function detectCourseFileKind(
  fileName: string,
  mimeType = "",
): CourseFileKind {
  const normalizedType = mimeType.toLowerCase();
  const lowerName = fileName.toLowerCase();

  if (normalizedType.includes("pdf") || lowerName.endsWith(".pdf")) {
    return "pdf";
  }

  if (lowerName.endsWith(".pptx")) {
    return "pptx";
  }

  if (lowerName.endsWith(".ppt")) {
    return "ppt";
  }

  return "other";
}

export function isPdfCourseFile(
  file: Pick<CourseFile, "name" | "type" | "kind">,
): boolean {
  if (file.kind) {
    return file.kind === "pdf";
  }

  return detectCourseFileKind(file.name, file.type ?? "") === "pdf";
}

function getWorkspaceCacheRoot() {
  return path.join(app.getPath("userData"), WORKSPACE_CACHE_DIRNAME);
}

function sanitizePathSegment(value) {
  return String(value || "")
    .trim()
    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^[-.]+|[-.]+$/g, "")
    .slice(0, 72);
}

function buildWorkspaceFolderName(fileName) {
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, "").replace(/\..+$/, "Z");
  const baseName = sanitizePathSegment(path.parse(fileName).name) || "workspace";
  return `${stamp}-${baseName}`;
}

function detectSourceKind(fileName, mimeType = "") {
  const lowerName = String(fileName || "").toLowerCase();
  const lowerType = String(mimeType || "").toLowerCase();

  if (lowerType.includes("pdf") || lowerName.endsWith(".pdf")) {
    return "pdf";
  }

  if (lowerName.endsWith(".pptx")) {
    return "pptx";
  }

  if (lowerName.endsWith(".ppt")) {
    return "ppt";
  }

  return "other";
}

function toBuffer(binaryPayload) {
  if (binaryPayload instanceof Uint8Array) {
    return Buffer.from(binaryPayload);
  }

  if (Array.isArray(binaryPayload)) {
    return Buffer.from(binaryPayload);
  }

  return Buffer.alloc(0);
}

  await fs.writeFile(destination, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), "utf8");
}

ipcMain.handle("workspace:create-normal-workspace", async (_, payload) => {
  const fileName = String(payload?.fileName || "").trim();
  const mimeType = String(payload?.mimeType || "").trim();
  const sourceKind = detectSourceKind(fileName, mimeType);
  const fileBytes = toBuffer(payload?.bytes);

  if (!fileName) {
    return { ok: false, message: "缺少上传文件名。" };
  }

  if (!["pdf", "ppt", "pptx"].includes(sourceKind)) {
    return { ok: false, message: "当前只支持 PDF、PPT 或 PPTX 文件。" };
  }

  if (!fileBytes.length) {
    return { ok: false, message: "上传文件内容为空，无法创建缓存工作区。" };
  }

  const workspaceId = randomUUID();
  const workspaceName = buildWorkspaceFolderName(fileName);
  const cacheRootPath = getWorkspaceCacheRoot();
  const workspacePath = path.join(cacheRootPath, workspaceName);
  const safeSourceFileName =
    sanitizePathSegment(path.parse(fileName).name) + path.extname(fileName).toLowerCase();

  const sourceCopyPath = path.join(workspacePath, safeSourceFileName || fileName);
  const transcriptPath = path.join(workspacePath, TRANSCRIPT_FILE_NAME);
  const summaryPath = path.join(workspacePath, SUMMARY_FILE_NAME);
  const sidebarStatePath = path.join(workspacePath, SIDEBAR_STATE_FILE_NAME);

  await ensureDirectory(workspacePath);

  await Promise.all([
    fs.writeFile(sourceCopyPath, fileBytes),
    writeJsonFile(
      transcriptPath,
      buildTranscriptSeed(workspaceId, fileName, sourceKind),
    ),
    writeJsonFile(
      summaryPath,
      buildSummarySeed(workspaceId, fileName, sourceKind),
    ),
    writeJsonFile(sidebarStatePath, normalizeSidebarState(payload?.sidebarState)),
  ]);

  return {
    ok: true,
    workspace: {
      workspaceId,
      workspaceName,
      workspacePath,
      cacheRootPath,
      sourceFileName: fileName,
      sourceKind,
      artifacts: {
        transcriptPath,
        summaryPath,
        sourceCopyPath,
        sidebarStatePath,
      },
    },
  };
});

import type {
  NormalSidebarStateSnapshot,
  SummaryCard,
  WorkspaceCache,
} from "../types";

function buildSidebarStateSnapshot(
  summaries: ReadonlyArray<SummaryCard>,
): NormalSidebarStateSnapshot {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    schemaVersion: "1.0",
    mode: "normal",
    status: "initialized",
    createdAtUtc: now,
    updatedAtUtc: now,
    items: summaries.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      summary: item.summary,
      transcript: item.transcript,
      transcriptSegmentIds: [],
      transcriptRange: {
        startTime: null,
        endTime: null,
      },
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Create the cache-backed workspace used by normal mode.
 * The renderer only prepares the binary payload and the current sidebar state;
 * all filesystem writes are delegated to the Electron main process.
 */
export async function createNormalModeWorkspace(
  file: File,
  summaries: ReadonlyArray<SummaryCard>,
): Promise<WorkspaceCache | null> {
  if (!window.desktopBridge?.createNormalWorkspace) {
    return null;
  }

  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
  const result = await window.desktopBridge.createNormalWorkspace({
    fileName: file.name,
    mimeType: file.type,
    bytes,
    sidebarState: buildSidebarStateSnapshot(summaries),
  });

  if (!result.ok || !result.workspace) {
    throw new Error(result.message || "缓存工作区创建失败。");
  }

  return result.workspace;
}

## 当前已落地的缓存工作区逻辑

在 `Normal` 模式下首次上传 `PDF / PPT / PPTX` 时，Electron 会在软件本地缓存目录里自动创建一个工作区文件夹。

当前实现使用的缓存根目录是：

- `<app userData>/workspace-cache/`

每个工作区会先落下这四个文件：

- `transcription.full.json`: 完整转录结果占位文件，后续可由后端回填
- `summary.full.json`: 完整总结结果占位文件，后续可由后端回填
- `原始文件副本`: 上传的 PDF / PPT / PPTX 文件副本
- `.normal-mode-state.json`: 隐藏状态文件，用于记录 Normal 模式左侧总结栏的数据结构和转录对应关系

这一步的目标是先把“上传文件 -> 创建缓存工作区 -> 落四个文件”的链路跑通，后续再逐步接入真实转录、总结和匹配结果。

  "source": "unified_exec_startup",
  "stdout": "import { useEffect, useRef, type FormEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from \"react\";\nimport type { ChatMessage } from \"../types\";\n\ninterface ChatPanelProps {\n  messages: ReadonlyArray<ChatMessage>;\n  value: string;\n  isAsking: boolean;\n  onChange: (nextValue: string) => void;\n  onSubmit: () => void;\n}\n\nexport default function ChatPanel({\n  messages,\n  value,\n  isAsking,\n  onChange,\n  onSubmit,\n}: ChatPanelProps) {\n  const messagesRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!messagesRef.current) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    messagesRef.current.scrollTop = messagesRef.current.scrollHeight;\n  }, [messages, isAsking]);\n\n  function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>): void {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    onSubmit();\n  }\n\n  function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>): void {\n    if (event.key === \"Enter\" && !event.shiftKey) {\n      event.preventDefault();\n      onSubmit();\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <div className=\"chat-header\">\n        <h2 className=\"section-title\">课件问答</h2>\n      </div>\n\n      <div className=\"chat-shell\">\n        <div className=\"chat-messages\" ref={messagesRef}>\n          {messages.map((message, index) => (\n            <div className={`message ${message.role}`} key={`${message.role}-${index}`}>\n              {message.text}\n            </div>\n          ))}\n          {isAsking ? <div className=\"message assistant\">AI 正在思考中...</div> : null}\n        </div>\n\n        <form className=\"chat-form\" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\n          <textarea\n            value={value}\n            onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}\n            placeholder=\"针对这份 PDF 提问...\"\n            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}\n          />\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </>\n  );\n}\n",

## Assistant

可以，这个需求的关键不是“加一个关闭按钮”这么简单，而是把“文件”改成“工作区”作为主对象。

你现在之所以会卡住，根因有两个：

- 前端当前只有 `currentFileId`，没有“当前工作区 / 历史工作区 / 活动工作区”的概念，所以只能显示一个当前文件，没法“关闭但保留进度”。见 [src/App.tsx](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/App.tsx:44)
- Electron 现在虽然会创建缓存工作区并落 4 个文件，但还没有“索引”或“读取历史工作区”的机制，所以前端没地方列出“上节课”。见 [electron/main.js](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/electron/main.js:13)

我建议把逻辑改成下面这样。

**核心模型**
不要再把“上传的 PDF/PPT 文件”当主对象，而要把“课堂工作区”当主对象。

一个工作区至少有这些状态：
- `workspaceId`
- `workspaceName`
- `sourceFileName`
- `sourceKind`
- `status`: `initialized | recording | transcribing | summarizing | matching | ready | paused | failed`
- `createdAtUtc`
- `updatedAtUtc`
- `lastOpenedAtUtc`
- `artifacts`
  - `transcription.full.json`
  - `summary.full.json`
  - `source copy`
  - `.normal-mode-state.json`

然后前端只维护一个：
- `activeWorkspaceId`

不是 `currentFileId`

**你要的两个能力，正确拆法**
1. 关闭当前预览  
不是删除文件，也不是删工作区  
只是把 `activeWorkspaceId = null`

结果：
- 中间栏不再显示当前 PDF/PPT
- 左侧 `Normal` 总结栏也不再绑定当前工作区
- 工作区还在缓存里，后面可以继续打开

2. 继续之前的转录过程  
本质是“重新选择一个已有工作区作为 activeWorkspace”

结果：
- 中间栏重新显示该工作区的源文件
- 左侧加载它的 `.normal-mode-state.json`
- 后续如果你朋友的后端支持继续跑，就继续轮询这个 `workspaceId/activity_id`

**我建议的 UI 行为**
1. 中间栏顶部加一个关闭按钮  
位置就在当前文件名 badge 旁边  
点击后只做一件事：清空当前活动工作区

2. 当没有活动工作区时，中间栏不应该还是上传页预览  
应该变成“工作区首页”，里面有两个入口：
- `上传新课件`
- `继续上次课程`

3. “继续上次课程”需要一个列表来源  
最合适的是缓存根目录下再维护一个：
- `workspace-index.json`

它只存轻量信息：
- `workspaceId`
- `workspaceName`
- `sourceFileName`
- `status`
- `updatedAtUtc`
- `lastOpenedAtUtc`

这样前端一启动就能直接读这个索引，列出最近工作区，而不用每次扫描所有子目录。

4. `Review` 模式建议直接承担“历史工作区选择器”职责  
也就是左侧不是单纯文件树，而是工作区列表
点开某个工作区，再展开它下面的源文件或结果文件

**上传时的规则**
这个逻辑也要定清楚，不然后面会混乱：

- 如果当前没有活动工作区
  - 上传文件 => 新建工作区，并设为 active
- 如果当前已经有活动工作区
  - 再上传文件时不要直接覆盖
  - 应该弹一个选择：
    - `新建工作区（推荐）`
    - `替换当前课件`
    - `取消`

否则你上一节课和下一节课的数据会混在一起。

**和后端联动时的正确方式**
后面接 `lite_synphonia` 时，建议直接把：
- `workspaceId` 作为 `activity_id`

这样前后端都围绕同一个 ID 工作。

前端 resume 的本质就是：
- 重新打开这个 `workspaceId`
- 继续读取该目录里的 JSON
- 或轮询后端这个 `activity_id` 的状态

**最小可行实现顺序**
我建议按这个顺序做，不会乱：

1. 加 `workspace-index.json`
2. 前端把主状态从 `currentFileId` 升级成 `activeWorkspaceId`
3. 中间栏加 `关闭预览`
4. 中间栏无活动工作区时显示“上传新课件 / 继续上次课程”
5. `Review` 模式接入历史工作区列表
6. 后面再接后端状态恢复

**我建议的第一步实现**
先只做这 3 件事：
- 加缓存根目录的 `workspace-index.json`
- 中间栏加“关闭当前预览”
- 无活动工作区时显示“继续上次课程”列表

这一步做完，你就已经能：
- 结束上一节课
- 开始下一节课
- 随时回到上一节课

这个阶段还不用碰真正的转录恢复。

如果你同意，我下一步就直接按这个最小版本实现。

async function readJsonFile(sourcePath, fallbackValue) {
  try {
    const raw = await fs.readFile(sourcePath, "utf8");
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.code === "ENOENT") {
      return fallbackValue;
    }

    throw error;
  }
}

function isWorkspaceStatus(value) {
  return WORKSPACE_STATUSES.has(String(value));
}

function normalizeIsoString(value, fallbackValue) {
  const normalized = String(value || "").trim();
  if (!normalized) {
    return fallbackValue;
  }

  const parsed = new Date(normalized);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.valueOf()) ? fallbackValue : parsed.toISOString();
}

function getMimeTypeForKind(sourceKind) {
  if (sourceKind === "pdf") {
    return "application/pdf";
  }

  if (sourceKind === "pptx") {
    return "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation";
  }

  if (sourceKind === "ppt") {
    return "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint";
  }

  return "application/octet-stream";
}

function sortWorkspaces(workspaces) {
  return [...workspaces].sort((left, right) => {
    const rightStamp = Date.parse(right.lastOpenedAtUtc || right.updatedAtUtc || 0);
    const leftStamp = Date.parse(left.lastOpenedAtUtc || left.updatedAtUtc || 0);
    return rightStamp - leftStamp;
  });
}

function createWorkspaceRecord(payload) {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const createdAtUtc = normalizeIsoString(payload?.createdAtUtc, now);
  const updatedAtUtc = normalizeIsoString(payload?.updatedAtUtc, createdAtUtc);

  return {
    workspaceId: String(payload?.workspaceId || ""),
    workspaceName: String(payload?.workspaceName || ""),
    workspacePath: String(payload?.workspacePath || ""),
    cacheRootPath: String(payload?.cacheRootPath || ""),
    sourceFileName: String(payload?.sourceFileName || ""),
    sourceKind: detectSourceKind(payload?.sourceFileName || "", payload?.sourceKind || ""),
    status: isWorkspaceStatus(payload?.status) ? String(payload.status) : "initialized",
    createdAtUtc,
    updatedAtUtc,
    lastOpenedAtUtc: normalizeIsoString(payload?.lastOpenedAtUtc, updatedAtUtc),
    artifacts: {
      transcriptPath: String(payload?.artifacts?.transcriptPath || ""),
      summaryPath: String(payload?.artifacts?.summaryPath || ""),
      sourceCopyPath: String(payload?.artifacts?.sourceCopyPath || ""),
      sidebarStatePath: String(payload?.artifacts?.sidebarStatePath || ""),
    },
  };
}

async function readWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath) {
  const payload = await readJsonFile(getWorkspaceIndexPath(cacheRootPath), {
    schemaVersion: "1.0",
    workspaces: [],
  });

  const workspaceList = Array.isArray(payload)
    ? payload
    : Array.isArray(payload?.workspaces)
      ? payload.workspaces
      : [];

  return workspaceList
    .map((item) => createWorkspaceRecord(item))
    .filter((item) => item.workspaceId && item.workspacePath);
}

async function writeWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath, workspaces) {
  await ensureDirectory(cacheRootPath);
  await writeJsonFile(getWorkspaceIndexPath(cacheRootPath), {
    schemaVersion: "1.0",
    workspaces: sortWorkspaces(workspaces),
  });
}

async function discoverWorkspaces(cacheRootPath) {
  await ensureDirectory(cacheRootPath);

  const directoryEntries = await fs.readdir(cacheRootPath, { withFileTypes: true });
  const discovered = [];

  for (const entry of directoryEntries) {
    if (!entry.isDirectory()) {
      continue;
    }

    const workspacePath = path.join(cacheRootPath, entry.name);
    const transcriptPath = path.join(workspacePath, TRANSCRIPT_FILE_NAME);
    const summaryPath = path.join(workspacePath, SUMMARY_FILE_NAME);
    const sidebarStatePath = path.join(workspacePath, SIDEBAR_STATE_FILE_NAME);

    const [transcriptPayload, summaryPayload, sidebarPayload, stats, childEntries] =
      await Promise.all([
        readJsonFile(transcriptPath, null),
        readJsonFile(summaryPath, null),
        readJsonFile(sidebarStatePath, null),
        fs.stat(workspacePath),
        fs.readdir(workspacePath, { withFileTypes: true }),
      ]);

    const sourceEntry = childEntries.find((child) => {
      if (!child.isFile()) {
        return false;
      }

      return ![
        TRANSCRIPT_FILE_NAME,
        SUMMARY_FILE_NAME,
        SIDEBAR_STATE_FILE_NAME,
        WORKSPACE_INDEX_FILE_NAME,
      ].includes(child.name);
    });

    const sourceFileName =
      String(transcriptPayload?.sourceFileName || "").trim() ||
      String(summaryPayload?.sourceFileName || "").trim() ||
      sourceEntry?.name ||
      entry.name;
    const sourceKind =
      detectSourceKind(
        sourceFileName,
        transcriptPayload?.sourceKind || summaryPayload?.sourceKind || "",
      ) || "other";
    const updatedAtUtc = normalizeIsoString(
      transcriptPayload?.updatedAtUtc ||
        summaryPayload?.updatedAtUtc ||
        sidebarPayload?.updatedAtUtc,
      stats.mtime.toISOString(),
    );
    const createdAtUtc = normalizeIsoString(
      transcriptPayload?.createdAtUtc ||
        summaryPayload?.createdAtUtc ||
        sidebarPayload?.createdAtUtc,
      stats.birthtime.toISOString(),
    );

    discovered.push(
      createWorkspaceRecord({
        workspaceId:
          transcriptPayload?.workspaceId ||
          summaryPayload?.workspaceId ||
          entry.name,
        workspaceName: entry.name,
        workspacePath,
        cacheRootPath,
        sourceFileName,
        sourceKind,
        status:
          transcriptPayload?.status ||
          summaryPayload?.status ||
          sidebarPayload?.status ||
          "initialized",
        createdAtUtc,
        updatedAtUtc,
        lastOpenedAtUtc: updatedAtUtc,
        artifacts: {
          transcriptPath,
          summaryPath,
          sourceCopyPath: sourceEntry ? path.join(workspacePath, sourceEntry.name) : "",
          sidebarStatePath,
        },
      }),
    );
  }

  return discovered;
}

async function syncWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath) {
  const [indexedWorkspaces, discoveredWorkspaces] = await Promise.all([
    readWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath),
    discoverWorkspaces(cacheRootPath),
  ]);

  const mergedById = new Map();

  for (const workspace of indexedWorkspaces) {
    mergedById.set(workspace.workspaceId, workspace);
  }

  for (const workspace of discoveredWorkspaces) {
    const current = mergedById.get(workspace.workspaceId);
    mergedById.set(
      workspace.workspaceId,
      current
        ? createWorkspaceRecord({
            ...workspace,
            lastOpenedAtUtc: current.lastOpenedAtUtc || workspace.lastOpenedAtUtc,
            status: current.status || workspace.status,
          })
        : workspace,
    );
  }

  const syncedWorkspaces = sortWorkspaces([...mergedById.values()]);
  await writeWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath, syncedWorkspaces);
  return syncedWorkspaces;
}

function buildSummaryCards(items: ReadonlyArray<NormalSidebarStateItem>): SummaryCard[] {
  return items.map((item) => ({
    id: item.id,
    summary: item.summary,
    transcript: item.transcript,
  }));
}

function getSourceMimeType(sourceKind: CourseFileKind, mimeType: string): string {
  if (mimeType) {
    return mimeType;
  }

  if (sourceKind === "pdf") {
    return "application/pdf";
  }

  if (sourceKind === "pptx") {
    return "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation";
  }

  if (sourceKind === "ppt") {
    return "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint";
  }

  return "application/octet-stream";
}

function createWorkspacePreviewUrl(
  workspace: WorkspaceCache,
  sourceFile: { mimeType: string; bytes: Uint8Array },
): string {
  if (workspace.sourceKind !== "pdf" || !sourceFile.bytes.byteLength) {
    return "";
  }

  const pdfBlob = new Blob([sourceFile.bytes], {
    type: getSourceMimeType(workspace.sourceKind, sourceFile.mimeType),
  });
  return URL.createObjectURL(pdfBlob);
}

function buildWorkspaceCourseFile(
  workspace: WorkspaceCache,
  sourceFile?: { fileName: string; mimeType: string; bytes: Uint8Array },
): CourseFile {
  const mimeType = sourceFile?.mimeType || "";
  const kind = detectCourseFileKind(workspace.sourceFileName, mimeType);

  return {
    id: `workspace-${workspace.workspaceId}`,
    folderId: CURRENT_FOLDER_ID,
    name: workspace.sourceFileName,
    previewUrl: sourceFile ? createWorkspacePreviewUrl(workspace, sourceFile) : "",
    kind,
    type: getSourceMimeType(kind, mimeType),
    size: sourceFile?.bytes.byteLength,
    workspace,
  };
}

export async function listNormalModeWorkspaces(): Promise<WorkspaceCache[]> {
  if (!window.desktopBridge?.listNormalWorkspaces) {
    return [];
  }

  const result = await window.desktopBridge.listNormalWorkspaces();
  if (!result.ok) {
    throw new Error(result.message || "读取缓存工作区列表失败。");
  }

  return result.workspaces;
}

export async function openNormalModeWorkspace(workspaceId: string): Promise<{
  workspace: WorkspaceCache;
  file: CourseFile;
  summaries: SummaryCard[];
}> {
  if (!window.desktopBridge?.openNormalWorkspace) {
    throw new Error("当前环境不支持打开缓存工作区。");
  }

  const result = await window.desktopBridge.openNormalWorkspace(workspaceId);
  if (!result.ok || !result.workspace) {
    throw new Error(result.message || "打开缓存工作区失败。");
  }

  return {
    workspace: result.workspace,
    file: buildWorkspaceCourseFile(result.workspace, result.sourceFile),
    summaries: buildSummaryCards(result.sidebarState?.items ?? []),
  };
}

  function sortWorkspacesByRecent(workspaces: ReadonlyArray<WorkspaceCache>): WorkspaceCache[] {
    return [...workspaces].sort((left, right) => {
      const rightStamp = Date.parse(right.lastOpenedAtUtc || right.updatedAtUtc || "");
      const leftStamp = Date.parse(left.lastOpenedAtUtc || left.updatedAtUtc || "");
      return rightStamp - leftStamp;
    });
  }

  function upsertWorkspace(
    previousWorkspaces: ReadonlyArray<WorkspaceCache>,
    workspace: WorkspaceCache,
  ): WorkspaceCache[] {
    return sortWorkspacesByRecent([
      workspace,
      ...previousWorkspaces.filter((item) => item.workspaceId !== workspace.workspaceId),
    ]);
  }

  function upsertFile(
    previousFiles: ReadonlyArray<CourseFile>,
    nextFile: CourseFile,
  ): CourseFile[] {
    return [nextFile, ...previousFiles.filter((file) => file.id !== nextFile.id)];
  }

  async function refreshRecentWorkspaces(): Promise<void> {
    if (!window.desktopBridge?.listNormalWorkspaces) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const workspaces = await listNormalModeWorkspaces();
      setRecentWorkspaces(workspaces);

      console.error("读取缓存工作区失败", error);
