  async function handleOpenWorkspace(workspaceId: string): Promise<void> {
    setIsWorkspaceLoading(true);
    setWorkspaceErrorMessage("");

    try {
      const openedWorkspace = await openNormalModeWorkspace(workspaceId);
      const existingFile = files.find((file) => file.id === openedWorkspace.file.id);
      const nextFile =
        existingFile && existingFile.previewUrl
          ? {
              ...openedWorkspace.file,
              previewUrl: existingFile.previewUrl,
            }
          : openedWorkspace.file;

      if (
        existingFile?.previewUrl &&
        openedWorkspace.file.previewUrl &&
        existingFile.previewUrl !== openedWorkspace.file.previewUrl
      ) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(openedWorkspace.file.previewUrl);
      }

      setFiles((previousFiles) => upsertFile(previousFiles, nextFile));
      setFolders((previousFolders) =>
        previousFolders.map((folder) =>
          folder.id === CURRENT_FOLDER_ID ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,
        ),
      );
      setSelectedFolderId(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID);
      setCurrentFileId(nextFile.id);
      setActiveWorkspaceId(openedWorkspace.workspace.workspaceId);
      setSummaries(openedWorkspace.summaries);
      setExpandedSummaryId("");
      setRecentWorkspaces((previousWorkspaces) =>
        upsertWorkspace(previousWorkspaces, openedWorkspace.workspace),
      );

      setIsWorkspaceLoading(false);

null,\n    [files, currentFileId],\n  );\n  const canPreviewCurrentFile = currentFile ? isPdfCourseFile(currentFile) : false;\n\n  function sortWorkspacesByRecent(workspaces: ReadonlyArray<WorkspaceCache>): WorkspaceCache[] {\n    return [...workspaces].sort((left, right) => {\n      const rightStamp = Date.parse(right.lastOpenedAtUtc || right.updatedAtUtc || \"\");\n      const leftStamp = Date.parse(left.lastOpenedAtUtc || left.updatedAtUtc || \"\");\n      return rightStamp - leftStamp;\n    });\n  }\n\n  function upsertWorkspace(\n    previousWorkspaces: ReadonlyArray<WorkspaceCache>,\n    workspace: WorkspaceCache,\n  ): WorkspaceCache[] {\n    return sortWorkspacesByRecent([\n      workspace,\n      ...previousWorkspaces.filter((item) => item.workspaceId !== workspace.workspaceId),\n    ]);\n  }\n\n  function upsertFile(\n    previousFiles: ReadonlyArray<CourseFile>,\n    nextFile: CourseFile,\n  ): CourseFile[] {\n    return [nextFile, ...previousFiles.filter((file) => file.id !== nextFile.id)];\n  }\n\n  async function refreshRecentWorkspaces(): Promise<void> {\n    if (!window.desktopBridge?.listNormalWorkspaces) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const workspaces = await listNormalModeWorkspaces();\n      setRecentWorkspaces(workspaces);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"读取缓存工作区失败\", error);\n      setWorkspaceErrorMessage(\"读取缓存工作区失败，请稍后再试。\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  function handleToggleFolder(folderId: string): void {\n    setFolders((previousFolders) =>\n      previousFolders.map((folder) =>\n        folder.id === folderId\n          ? { ...folder, expanded: !folder.expanded }\n          : folder,\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n\n  function handleSelectFile(fileId: string, folderId: string): void {\n    setSelectedFolderId(folderId);\n\n    const nextFile = files.find((file) => file.id === fileId);\n    if (nextFile?.workspace?.workspaceId) {\n      void handleOpenWorkspace(nextFile.workspace.workspaceId);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setCurrentFileId(fileId);\n    setActiveWorkspaceId(\"\");\n    setExpandedSummaryId(\"\");\n    setSummaries([]);\n    setWorkspaceErrorMessage(\"\");\n  }\n\n  function handleToggleSummary(summaryId: string): void {\n    setExpandedSummaryId((currentId) => (currentId === summaryId ? \"\" : summaryId));\n  }\n\n  function handleCloseCurrentPreview(): void {\n    setCurrentFileId(\"\");\n    setActiveWorkspaceId(\"\");\n    setSummaries([]);\n    setExpandedSummaryId(\"\");\n    setWorkspaceErrorMessage(\"\");\n  }\n\n  async function handleOpenWorkspace(workspaceId: string): Promise<void> {\n    setIsWorkspaceLoading(true);\n    setWorkspaceErrorMessage(\"\");\n\n    try {\n      const openedWorkspace = await openNormalModeWorkspace(workspaceId);\n      const existingFile = files.find((file) => file.id === openedWorkspace.file.id);\n      const nextFile =\n        existingFile && existingFile.previewUrl\n          ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,\n        ),\n      );\n      setSelectedFolderId(CURRENT_FOLDER_ID);\n      setCurrentFileId(nextFile.id);\n      setActiveWorkspaceId(openedWorkspace.workspace.workspaceId);\n      setSummaries(openedWorkspace.summaries);\n      setExpandedSummaryId(\"\");\n      setRecentWorkspaces((previousWorkspaces) =>\n        upsertWorkspace(previousWorkspaces, openedWorkspace.workspace),\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"打开缓存工作区失败\", error);\n      setWorkspaceErrorMessage(\"打开缓存工作区失败，请稍后再试。\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsWorkspaceLoading(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async function handleUploadFile(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>): Promise<void> {\n    const [file] = event.target.files ?? [];\n    if (!file) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const uploaded = await uploadCourseFile(file);\n      const workspace =\n        viewMode === \"normal\"\n          ? await createNormalModeWorkspace(file, summaries)\n          : null;\n      const targetFolderId = selectedFolderId || CURRENT_FOLDER_ID;\n      const nextFileId = workspace ? `workspace-${workspace.workspaceId}` : uploaded.id;\n      const nextFile = {\n        ...uploaded,\n        id: nextFileId,\n        folderId: targetFolderId,\n        workspace: workspace ?? undefined,\n      };\n\n      setFiles((previousFiles) => upsertFile(previousFiles, nextFile));\n      setCurrentFileId(nextFile.id);\n      setSelectedFolderId(targetFolderId);\n      setWorkspaceErrorMessage(\"\");\n      setFolders((previousFolders) =>\n        previousFolders.map((folder) =>\n          folder.id === targetFolderId ? { ...folder, expanded: true } : folder,\n        ),\n      );\n\n      if (workspace) {\n        setActiveWorkspaceId(workspace.workspaceId);\n        setSummaries([]);\n        setExpandedSummaryId(\"\");\n        setRecentWorkspaces((previousWorkspaces) =>\n          upsertWorkspace(previousWorkspaces, workspace),\n        );\n      } else {\n        setActiveWorkspaceId(\"\");\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"上传失败\", error);\n      setWorkspaceErrorMessage(\"上传或创建缓存工作区失败，请稍后再试。\");\n    } finally {\n      event.target.value = \"\";\n    }\n  }\n\n  async function handleSubmitQuestion(): Promise<void> {\n    const question = chatInput.trim();\n    if (!question || isAsking) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setChatInput(\"\");\n    setChatMessages((previousMessages) => [\n",

你现在这个现象，最可能是这条链路：

1. 你改完代码后，Vite 只热更新了前端页面
2. 但 `electron/main.js` 和 `electron/preload.cjs` 不会跟着热更新
3. 所以当前桌面进程里，`openNormalWorkspace` 这类新桥接方法还没生效
4. 结果就是：
   - 历史列表能显示
     原因：这是前端内存里的数据，或者旧逻辑扫目录得来的
   - 但点开历史记录没法恢复
     原因：真正负责“从缓存目录读回文件”的 Electron 桥还没换成新版本

我这里还确认了一个旁证：
- 你的缓存目录已经存在：`~/Library/Application Support/course-pdf-viewer/workspace-cache`
- 但当前还没有看到 `workspace-index.json`

这说明你现在运行的桌面进程，大概率还不是我刚加完“工作区索引”那版主进程。

我已经顺手补了一个兜底：
- 如果只是“关闭当前课件后在同一轮会话里重新打开”，即使 Electron 桥没重启，也会优先从前端内存里的文件恢复
- 同时把错误提示改成了更具体的信息，不再只是泛泛地说“打开失败”

我也重新跑过：
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run build`

都通过了。

你现在要做的不是继续点，而是完整重启桌面端：

1. 彻底关掉 Electron 窗口
2. 停掉当前终端里的 `npm run dev:desktop`
3. 重新执行：
```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```
4. 重新上传一个 `PDF` 到 `Normal` 模式
5. 去这个目录确认是否出现：
```text
~/Library/Application Support/course-pdf-viewer/workspace-cache/workspace-index.json
```
6. 再测试“关闭当前课件 -> 从历史记录重新打开”

如果你重启后还是不行，现在界面会显示更具体的错误文案。把那句原文发给我，我直接继续定位。

## Assistant

构建还在跑。完成后这次调整就能直接验证“一个文件一个工作区”的组织方式。这个问题我已经按“一个文件 = 一个独立工作区”改了。

之前的问题在于前端还是旧模型：
- 所有上传文件都被塞进一个总文件夹
- 工作区只是缓存层有，界面层没有真正按工作区组织

现在改成了：
- 每个 `PDF / PPT / PPTX` 对应一个独立工作区
- `Review` 侧栏里每个文件会变成一个单独的工作区项
- 工作区名称默认取源文件名，不再挂在“当前课堂资料”这种总目录下面
- 打开历史工作区时，会直接选中这个工作区，而不是回到一个公共文件夹

对应改动：
- [src/App.tsx](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/src/App.tsx:1)

- `npm run typecheck`

都通过了。

你现在需要完整重启桌面端再看效果：
```bash
npm run dev:desktop
```

重启后你可以直接检查两件事：
1. 上传两个不同的 PDF，`Review` 侧栏里应该出现两个独立工作区
2. 关闭当前课件后，从历史里重新打开，应该还是回到对应那个文件自己的工作区

下一步如果继续收这个模型，合理的改法是把工作区名称改成“可编辑名称”，不要永远等于文件名。这样后面一份课件可以被你命名成“第 3 周 深度学习 第一次课”这种更可读的工作区。

ipcMain.handle("workspace:rename-normal-workspace", async (_, payload) => {
  const workspaceId = String(payload?.workspaceId || "").trim();
  const workspaceName = getDefaultWorkspaceDisplayName(payload?.workspaceName || "");

  if (!workspaceId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "缺少工作区标识。" };
  }

  const cacheRootPath = getWorkspaceCacheRoot();
  const indexedWorkspaces = await syncWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath);
  const matchedWorkspace = indexedWorkspaces.find(
    (item) => item.workspaceId === workspaceId,
  );

  if (!matchedWorkspace) {
    return { ok: false, message: "没有找到对应的工作区。" };
  }

  const workspace = createWorkspaceRecord({
    ...matchedWorkspace,
    workspaceName,
    updatedAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
  const nextIndex = sortWorkspaces([
    workspace,
    ...indexedWorkspaces.filter((item) => item.workspaceId !== workspace.workspaceId),
  ]);
  await writeWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath, nextIndex);

  return {
    ok: true,
    workspace,
  };
});

ipcMain.handle("workspace:delete-normal-workspace", async (_, workspaceId) => {
  const nextWorkspaceId = String(workspaceId || "").trim();

  if (!nextWorkspaceId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "缺少工作区标识。" };
  }

  const cacheRootPath = getWorkspaceCacheRoot();
  const indexedWorkspaces = await syncWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath);
  const matchedWorkspace = indexedWorkspaces.find(
    (item) => item.workspaceId === nextWorkspaceId,
  );

  if (!matchedWorkspace) {
    return { ok: false, message: "没有找到对应的工作区。" };
  }

  await fs.rm(matchedWorkspace.workspacePath, {
    recursive: true,
    force: true,
  });

  const nextIndex = indexedWorkspaces.filter(
    (item) => item.workspaceId !== matchedWorkspace.workspaceId,
  );
  await writeWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath, nextIndex);

  return {
    ok: true,
    workspaceId: matchedWorkspace.workspaceId,
  };
});

export async function renameNormalModeWorkspace(
  payload: RenameNormalWorkspacePayload,
): Promise<WorkspaceCache> {
  if (!window.desktopBridge?.renameNormalWorkspace) {
    throw new Error("当前环境不支持重命名缓存工作区。");
  }

  const result = await window.desktopBridge.renameNormalWorkspace(payload);
  if (!result.ok || !result.workspace) {
    throw new Error(result.message || "重命名缓存工作区失败。");
  }

  return result.workspace;
}

export async function deleteNormalModeWorkspace(workspaceId: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!window.desktopBridge?.deleteNormalWorkspace) {
    throw new Error("当前环境不支持删除缓存工作区。");
  }

  const result = await window.desktopBridge.deleteNormalWorkspace(workspaceId);
  if (!result.ok || !result.workspaceId) {
    throw new Error(result.message || "删除缓存工作区失败。");
  }

  return result.workspaceId;
}

  async function handleRenameWorkspace(workspaceId: string): Promise<void> {
    const currentWorkspace = recentWorkspaces.find(
      (workspace) => workspace.workspaceId === workspaceId,
    );

    if (!currentWorkspace) {
      setWorkspaceErrorMessage("没有找到要重命名的工作区。");
      return;
    }

    const nextWorkspaceName = window.prompt(
      "请输入新的工作区名称",
      currentWorkspace.workspaceName,
    );

    if (nextWorkspaceName === null) {
      return;
    }

    const trimmedName = nextWorkspaceName.trim();
    if (!trimmedName) {
      setWorkspaceErrorMessage("工作区名称不能为空。");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const renamedWorkspace = await renameNormalModeWorkspace({
        workspaceId,
        workspaceName: trimmedName,
      });

      setRecentWorkspaces((previousWorkspaces) =>
        upsertWorkspace(previousWorkspaces, renamedWorkspace),
      );
      setFiles((previousFiles) =>
        previousFiles.map((file) =>
          file.workspace?.workspaceId === workspaceId
            ? {
                ...file,
                workspace: renamedWorkspace,
              }
            : file,
        ),
      );
      setWorkspaceErrorMessage("");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("重命名工作区失败", error);
      setWorkspaceErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "重命名工作区失败。",
      );
    }
  }

  async function handleDeleteWorkspace(workspaceId: string): Promise<void> {
    const currentWorkspace = recentWorkspaces.find(
      (workspace) => workspace.workspaceId === workspaceId,
    );

    if (!currentWorkspace) {
      setWorkspaceErrorMessage("没有找到要删除的工作区。");
      return;
    }

    const shouldDelete = window.confirm(
      `确定删除工作区“${currentWorkspace.workspaceName}”吗？缓存目录和副本文件也会一起删除。`,
    );

    if (!shouldDelete) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const deletedWorkspaceId = await deleteNormalModeWorkspace(workspaceId);
      setRecentWorkspaces((previousWorkspaces) =>
        previousWorkspaces.filter(
          (workspace) => workspace.workspaceId !== deletedWorkspaceId,
        ),
      );
      setFiles((previousFiles) =>
        previousFiles.filter(
          (file) => file.workspace?.workspaceId !== deletedWorkspaceId,
        ),
      );
      setFolders((previousFolders) =>
        previousFolders.filter((folder) => folder.id !== deletedWorkspaceId),
      );

      if (activeWorkspaceId === deletedWorkspaceId || selectedFolderId === deletedWorkspaceId) {
        handleCloseCurrentPreview();
        setSelectedFolderId("");
      }

      setWorkspaceErrorMessage("");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("删除工作区失败", error);
      setWorkspaceErrorMessage(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "删除工作区失败。",
      );
    }
  }

现在有三处变化：

1. 工作区支持重命名和删除  
在 `Review` 侧栏里，展开某个工作区后会看到两个操作：
- `重命名`
- `删除`

它们会直接作用到缓存工作区，并同步更新前端状态。删除时会把对应缓存目录一起删掉。

2. 侧栏显示创建日期  
每个工作区条目现在会显示：
- 工作区名称
- `创建于 YYYY/M/D`

3. 工作区名称和源文件名分离  
之前前端实际上更像“文件列表”。现在改成：
- 工作区名：可重命名的业务名称
- 源文件名：仍然保留在子项和历史列表里

- [electron/main.js](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/electron/main.js:1)
- [electron/preload.cjs](/Users/wangwenbin/projects/比赛项目前端/electron/preload.cjs:1)

```bash

```

  "formatted_output": "import { useEffect, useRef, type FormEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from \"react\";\nimport type { ChatMessage } from \"../types\";\n\ninterface ChatPanelProps {\n  messages: ReadonlyArray<ChatMessage>;\n  value: string;\n  isAsking: boolean;\n  onChange: (nextValue: string) => void;\n  onSubmit: () => void;\n}\n\nexport default function ChatPanel({\n  messages,\n  value,\n  isAsking,\n  onChange,\n  onSubmit,\n}: ChatPanelProps) {\n  const messagesRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!messagesRef.current) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    messagesRef.current.scrollTop = messagesRef.current.scrollHeight;\n  }, [messages, isAsking]);\n\n  function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>): void {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    onSubmit();\n  }\n\n  function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>): void {\n    if (event.key === \"Enter\" && !event.shiftKey) {\n      event.preventDefault();\n      onSubmit();\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <div className=\"chat-header\">\n        <h2 className=\"section-title\">课件问答</h2>\n      </div>\n\n      <div className=\"chat-shell\">\n        <div className=\"chat-messages\" ref={messagesRef}>\n          {messages.map((message, index) => (\n            <div className={`message ${message.role}`} key={`${message.role}-${index}`}>\n              {message.text}\n            </div>\n          ))}\n          {isAsking ? <div className=\"message assistant\">AI 正在思考中...</div> : null}\n        </div>\n\n        <form className=\"chat-form\" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\n          <textarea\n            value={value}\n            onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}\n            placeholder=\"针对这份 PDF 提问...\"\n            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}\n          />\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </>\n  );\n}\n",
  "status": "completed"
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

function getStoredPanelWidth(
  storageKey: string,
  fallbackValue: number,
  minValue: number,
  maxValue: number,
): number {
  const storedValue = window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
  const parsedValue = storedValue ? Number(storedValue) : Number.NaN;

  if (!Number.isFinite(parsedValue)) {
    return fallbackValue;
  }

  return clamp(parsedValue, minValue, maxValue);
}

  function handleResizeStart(side: "left" | "right", pointerX: number): void {
    const frameRect = appFrameRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!frameRect) {
      return;
    }

    setResizeSide(side);
    document.body.style.cursor = "col-resize";
    document.body.style.userSelect = "none";

    function handlePointerMove(event: PointerEvent): void {
      const currentRect = appFrameRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!currentRect) {
        return;
      }

      if (side === "left") {
        const maxWidth = Math.min(
          MAX_LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH,
          currentRect.width - (isRightOpen ? rightPanelWidth : 0) - MIN_CENTER_WIDTH,
        );
        const nextWidth = clamp(
          event.clientX - currentRect.left,
          MIN_LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH,
          Math.max(MIN_LEFT_PANEL_WIDTH, maxWidth),
        );
        setLeftPanelWidth(nextWidth);
        return;
      }

      const maxWidth = Math.min(
        MAX_RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH,
        currentRect.width - (isLeftOpen ? leftPanelWidth : 0) - MIN_CENTER_WIDTH,
      );
      const nextWidth = clamp(
        currentRect.right - event.clientX,
        MIN_RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH,
        Math.max(MIN_RIGHT_PANEL_WIDTH, maxWidth),
      );
      setRightPanelWidth(nextWidth);
    }

    function stopResize(): void {
      setResizeSide((current) => (current === side ? null : current));
      document.body.style.cursor = "";
      document.body.style.userSelect = "";
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", stopResize);
      window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", stopResize);
    }

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", stopResize);
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopResize);

    handlePointerMove(new PointerEvent("pointermove", { clientX: pointerX }));
  }

  const frameStyle = {
    "--left-panel-width": `${leftPanelWidth}px`,
    "--right-panel-width": `${rightPanelWidth}px`,
  } as CSSProperties;

  return (
    <div
      className={`app-frame ${resizeSide ? "is-resizing" : ""}`}
      ref={appFrameRef}
      style={frameStyle}
    >
      <header className="app-topbar">

  "stdout": "# LiteSynphonia\n\nA zero-local-model lecture and meeting processing pipeline.  All AI operations — transcription, summarisation, and embedding — are performed via remote API calls.  No PyTorch, no Whisper binary, and no local model files are required.\n\n---\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n1. [Overview](#overview)\n2. [Prerequisites](#prerequisites)\n3. [API Key Configuration](#api-key-configuration)\n4. [Function Reference](#function-reference)\n   - [1. Transcription](#1-transcription)\n   - [2. Summarisation](#2-summarisation)\n   - [3. PDF Matching](#3-pdf-matching)\n   - [4. Output](#4-output)\n5. [Running the Pipeline](#running-the-pipeline)\n6. [Full CLI Reference](#full-cli-reference)\n7. [Output Interface Specification](#output-interface-specification)\n\n---\n\n## Overview\n\n```\nMicrophone → Audio Enhancement → Deepgram STT ─────────────┐\n                                                            ↓\n                                             Transcript Quality Gate\n                                                            ↓\n                                        DeepSeek / LLM API (Summary)\n                                                            ↓\n                             PDF Slides → Embedding API (BGE-M3) → Page Matching\n                                                            ↓\n                                        merged_results.json + interface_output.json\n```\n\nEach stage is independently configurable.  Different providers can be used for each stage (e.g. Deepgram for transcription, DeepSeek for summarisation, SiliconFlow/BGE-M3 for embeddings).\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Python 3.10 or later\n- The `merge_syn` package installed (provides shared audio, quality, and bridge utilities)\n- API keys for your chosen providers (see below)\n\nInstall dependencies:\n\n```bash\npip install -r requirements.txt\n```\n\n---\n\n## API Key Configuration\n\nAll providers are managed through a shared registry stored at:\n\n```\n~/.config/lite_synphonia/providers.json\n```\n\nUse the `providers` sub-command to register each API key.  You only need to do this once per provider.\n\n### Register a Provider\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers add <name> \\\n    --base-url  <endpoint-url> \\\n    --model     <model-id> \\\n    --api-key   <your-api-key> \\\n    --service   <transcription|summarization|embedding>\n```\n\n### Recommended Provider Setup\n\n#### Transcription — Deepgram\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers add deepgram \\\n    --base-url  https://api.deepgram.com \\\n    --model     whisper-large \\\n    --api-key   YOUR_DEEPGRAM_API_KEY \\\n    --service   transcription\n```\n\nModels available on Deepgram: `whisper-large` (recommended for Chinese), `nova-2-general`, `nova-2`.\n`whisper-large` is more robust at lower audio signal levels; `nova-2-general` is faster but requires cleaner audio (RMS ≥ 0.015).\n\n#### Summarisation — DeepSeek\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers add deepseek \\\n    --base-url  https://api.deepseek.com/v1 \\\n    --model     deepseek-chat \\\n    --api-key   YOUR_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY \\\n    --service   summarization\n```\n\nAny OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint can be used here (OpenAI, MiniMax, Qwen, etc.).\n\n#### Embedding — SiliconFlow / BGE\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers add siliconflow-embed \\\n    --base-url  https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1 \\\n    --model     BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5 \\\n    --api-key   YOUR_SILICONFLOW_API_KEY \\\n    --service   embedding\n```\n\nBGE-family models (e.g. `BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5`, `BAAI/bge-m3`) support Chinese, English, and mixed-language content and do not require input prefixes.  For E5-family models, pass `--embedding-passage-prefix \"passage: \"` and `--embedding-query-prefix \"query: \"` at runtime (see CLI reference).\n\n### List Registered Providers\n\n```bash\npython3 -m lite_synphonia providers list\n```\n\n---\n\n## Function Reference\n\n### 1. Transcription\n\n**Purpose:** Capture microphone audio, enhance it, and convert it to a timestamped transcript using Deepgram's Speech-to-Text API.\n\n#### Audio Enhancement Pipeline\n\nRaw microphone samples pass through the following chain before being sent to Deepgram:\n\n| Step | Operation | Default | Effect |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | DC offset removal | always on | Removes hardware bias that AGC would amplify |\n| 2 | Input gain | `1.0` | Fixed scalar pre-multiplier |\n| 3 | Noise gate | threshold `0.003` | Zeroes chunks whose RMS is below the silence floor, preventing background noise from being amplified and hallucinated by Deepgram |\n| 4 | Bidirectional AGC | target `0.03`, max `2.0×` | Attenuates loud signals AND amplifies quiet ones toward the target RMS; the previous one-directional AGC only amplified, causing loud audio to clip |\n| 5 | Pre-emphasis | `α = 0.97` | High-pass filter `y[n] = x[n] − 0.97·x[n−1]`; boosts consonants (zh/ch/sh/s) that ASR models rely on; standard in Kaldi/ESPnet |\n| 6 | Soft-knee limiter | ceiling `0.72` | Applies a Hermite curve in the 85–100% zone before the ceiling instead of hard clipping; eliminates inter-modulation distortion that degrades confidence |\n| 7 | Hard clip | `[-1, 1]` | Safety net only |\n\nPass `--no-agc` to bypass steps 2–6 entirely when your hardware already provides a clean signal.\n\n#### Deepgram Transcription\n\nThe enhanced audio is encoded as 16-bit WAV at 16 kHz and sent to Deepgram's `/v1/listen` endpoint with the following parameters:\n\n```\npunctuate=true   smart_format=true   utterances=true\nutt_split=1.2    numerals=true       filler_words=false\n```\n\n`utt_split=1.2` uses a 1.2-second pause as the utterance boundary, which matches the natural thinking pauses in lecture speech.  `filler_words=false` removes disfluencies (uh, um, 那个, 就是) from the transcript.\n\n#### Fallback Chain\n\nIf the primary model returns no segments, the pipeline automatically retries in order:\n\n1. Enhanced audio, primary model, specified language\n2. Raw audio (pre-enhancement), primary model, specified language\n3. Enhanced audio, primary model, language auto-detect\n4. Enhanced audio, `whisper-large`, language auto-detect (only if primary is not whisper-large)\n\nThe model that actually produced the transcript is recorded in `transcription.json` under `runtime.selected_model`.\n\n#### Quality Gate\n\nAfter transcription, a quality assessment runs:\n\n- `decision: pass` — mean confidence ≥ threshold and content present → pipeline continues\n- `decision: warn` — confidence below the merge_syn hard floor but content passes a diversity check → downstream stages run with a warning flag\n- `decision: fail` — no usable content → downstream stages are blocked (use `--allow-low-quality-transcript` to override)\n\nThe quality confidence threshold defaults to `0.15` and is tunable with `--quality-confidence-threshold`.\n\n#### Output\n\n```\n<output-dir>/transcription/\n    transcription.json          Full payload (metrics, segments, quality, preflight)\n    raw_audio.wav               Pre-enhancement recording\n    enhanced_audio.wav          Post-enhancement recording\n    deepgram_response_raw.json  Present only when all attempts return empty results\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2. Summarisation\n\n**Purpose:** Condense the transcript into a concise summary using an OpenAI-compatible LLM API.\n\n#### Windowing\n\nFor long transcripts that exceed the LLM's effective context window, the transcript is processed in overlapping windows:\n\n| Parameter | Default | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `--summary-window-size` | 200 | Words per window |\n| `--summary-overlap-size` | 60 | Overlap words between consecutive windows |\n| `--summary-chunk-size` | 1200 | Characters read per incremental pass |\n| `--summary-max-new-tokens` | 384 | Maximum tokens the LLM may generate per call |\n\nWhen the full transcript fits within a single window (≤ 200 words), the LLM processes it in one pass with no boundary stitching.  This is the ideal case and the most common for lecture segments of 5–10 minutes.\n\n#### Providers\n\nAny OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.  Register it with `--service summarization`.  The model must support chat-completion (`/v1/chat/completions`).\n\nNote: DeepSeek and other providers that offer only chat completions cannot be used for embedding.  Keep the summarisation and embedding providers separate.\n\n#### Output\n\n```\n<output-dir>/\n    input/transcript.txt        Flat transcript fed to the LLM\n    summary/results.json        Summary rounds, text, and runtime metadata\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. PDF Matching\n\n**Purpose:** Given a PDF slide deck, assign each transcript segment to the slide page the speaker was most likely discussing at that moment.\n\n#### Architecture\n\nMatching is performed in two phases:\n\n**Phase A — PDF Preprocessing (once per unique PDF)**\n\n1. Extract text from each page and split into overlapping chunks (`pdf_reader`)\n2. Check the on-disk embedding cache (key: `sha256(pdf_bytes)[:16]_<model>.npz`)\n3. If cache miss: embed all chunks in a single batch API call; write cache\n4. If cache hit: load embeddings directly — no API call\n\n**Phase B — Query Matching (per run)**\n\n1. Collect all unique segment texts from the transcript\n2. Embed them in a single batch API call (all segments at once — previously one call per segment)\n3. The matching loop uses only local numpy dot products — no further API calls\n4. A Viterbi smoother enforces global monotonic ordering (lecture slides only advance)\n\nThis architecture reduces API calls during matching from O(N segments) to O(1) regardless of transcript length.\n\n#### Embedding Prefix Configuration\n\n| Model family | passage prefix | query prefix |\n|---|---|---|\n| BGE-M3, OpenAI | `\"\"` (default) | `\"\"` (default) |\n| multilingual-E5 | `\"passage: \"` | `\"query: \"` |\n\nSet prefixes via `--embedding-passage-prefix` and `--embedding-query-prefix`.\n\n#### PDF Embedding Cache\n\nBy default, chunk embeddings are cached to `<output-dir>/.pdf_embed_cache/`.  The cache key encodes both the PDF content (SHA-256) and the model name, so it invalidates automatically when either changes.  On a cache hit, the PDF embedding stage is skipped entirely.\n\nDisable the cache:\n```bash\n--pdf-cache-dir none\n",

Enhanced audio, `whisper-large`, language auto-detect (only if primary is not whisper-large)\n\nThe model that actually produced the transcript is recorded in `transcription.json` under `runtime.selected_model`.\n\n#### Quality Gate\n\nAfter transcription, a quality assessment runs:\n\n- `decision: pass` — mean confidence ≥ threshold and content present → pipeline continues\n- `decision: warn` — confidence below the merge_syn hard floor but content passes a diversity check → downstream stages run with a warning flag\n- `decision: fail` — no usable content → downstream stages are blocked (use `--allow-low-quality-transcript` to override)\n\nThe quality confidence threshold defaults to `0.15` and is tunable with `--quality-confidence-threshold`.\n\n#### Output\n\n```\n<output-dir>/transcription/\n    transcription.json          Full payload (metrics, segments, quality, preflight)\n    raw_audio.wav               Pre-enhancement recording\n    enhanced_audio.wav          Post-enhancement recording\n    deepgram_response_raw.json  Present only when all attempts return empty results\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2. Summarisation\n\n**Purpose:** Condense the transcript into a concise summary using an OpenAI-compatible LLM API.\n\n#### Windowing\n\nFor long transcripts that exceed the LLM's effective context window, the transcript is processed in overlapping windows:\n\n| Parameter | Default | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `--summary-window-size` | 200 | Words per window |\n| `--summary-overlap-size` | 60 | Overlap words between consecutive windows |\n| `--summary-chunk-size` | 1200 | Characters read per incremental pass |\n| `--summary-max-new-tokens` | 384 | Maximum tokens the LLM may generate per call |\n\nWhen the full transcript fits within a single window (≤ 200 words), the LLM processes it in one pass with no boundary stitching.  This is the ideal case and the most common for lecture segments of 5–10 minutes.\n\n#### Providers\n\nAny OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.  Register it with `--service summarization`.  The model must support chat-completion (`/v1/chat/completions`).\n\nNote: DeepSeek and other providers that offer only chat completions cannot be used for embedding.  Keep the summarisation and embedding providers separate.\n\n#### Output\n\n```\n<output-dir>/\n    input/transcript.txt        Flat transcript fed to the LLM\n    summary/results.json        Summary rounds, text, and runtime metadata\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. PDF Matching\n\n**Purpose:** Given a PDF slide deck, assign each transcript segment to the slide page the speaker was most likely discussing at that moment.\n\n#### Architecture\n\nMatching is performed in two phases:\n\n**Phase A — PDF Preprocessing (once per unique PDF)**\n\n1. Extract text from each page and split into overlapping chunks (`pdf_reader`)\n2. Check the on-disk embedding cache (key: `sha256(pdf_bytes)[:16]_<model>.npz`)\n3. If cache miss: embed all chunks in a single batch API call; write cache\n4. If cache hit: load embeddings directly — no API call\n\n**Phase B — Query Matching (per run)**\n\n1. Collect all unique segment texts from the transcript\n2. Embed them in a single batch API call (all segments at once — previously one call per segment)\n3. The matching loop uses only local numpy dot products — no further API calls\n4. A Viterbi smoother enforces global monotonic ordering (lecture slides only advance)\n\nThis architecture reduces API calls during matching from O(N segments) to O(1) regardless of transcript length.\n\n#### Embedding Prefix Configuration\n\n| Model family | passage prefix | query prefix |\n|---|---|---|\n| BGE-M3, OpenAI | `\"\"` (default) | `\"\"` (default) |\n| multilingual-E5 | `\"passage: \"` | `\"query: \"` |\n\nSet prefixes via `--embedding-passage-prefix` and `--embedding-query-prefix`.\n\n#### PDF Embedding Cache\n\nBy default, chunk embeddings are cached to `<output-dir>/.pdf_embed_cache/`.  The cache key encodes both the PDF content (SHA-256) and the model name, so it invalidates automatically when either changes.  On a cache hit, the PDF embedding stage is skipped entirely.\n\nDisable the cache:\n```bash\n--pdf-cache-dir none\n",

frozenset({\n    \"这个\", \"那个\", \"一个\", \"一些\", \"可以\", \"没有\", \"我们\", \"他们\", \"你们\",\n    \"因为\", \"所以\", \"但是\", \"然后\", \"如果\", \"虽然\", \"已经\", \"非常\", \"一样\",\n    \"这些\", \"那些\", \"什么\", r\"[^\\u3400-\\u4dbf\\u4e00-\\u9fff\\uf900-\\ufaff]+\"\n    r\"|[\" + re.escape(_ZH_SPLIT_CHARS) + r\"]+\"\n)\n\n\ndef _extract_keywords(text: str, top_n: int = 10) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Extract top-N keywords from Chinese text without an external tokenizer.\n\n    Strategy: split on function characters (\"的\",\"在\",\"是\",...) to obtain\n    phrase-level candidates like \"深度学习\" and \"卷积神经网络\", then rank by\n    frequency.  For longer phrases, 2-3 char sub-grams are also emitted so\n    individual technical terms nested inside longer strings are captured.\n    A deduplication pass then removes shorter grams that are substrings of\n    an already-retained keyword.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not text:\n        return []\n\n    candidates: list[str] = []\n    for phrase in _PHRASE_SPLIT_RE.split(text):\n        phrase = phrase.strip()\n        if len(phrase) < 2:\n            continue\n        # Accept only pure-CJK phrases\n        if not all(_CJK_CHAR_RE.fullmatch(c) for c in phrase):\n            continue\n        # Direct phrase candidates only — no sub-gram decomposition.\n        #\n        # Window gram approaches (bigrams, sliding n-grams) inflate the\n        # frequency of common component characters (\"学习\", \"神经\") above\n        # the compound terms they belong to, causing the compound to be\n        # suppressed. Single-\n        # occurrence terms in synthetic tests are an acceptable trade-off.\n        if len(phrase) <= 6 and phrase not in _ZH_STOPWORDS:\n            candidates.append(phrase)\n        elif len(phrase) <= 8:\n            # Accept slightly longer phrases (7-8 chars) only when they look\n            # like a proper technical term — no function-char characters remain\n            # after the split, and the phrase is entirely composed of CJK chars\n            # (already guaranteed by the fullmatch check above).\n            if phrase not in _ZH_STOPWORDS:\n                candidates.append(phrase)\n\n    freq: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for c in candidates:\n        freq[c] = freq.get(c, 0) + 1\n\n    # Sort: frequency desc; at equal frequency prefer LONGER terms (more\n    # specific compound terms over shorter common components).\n    ranked = sorted(freq.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], -len(kv[0])))\n    return [word for word, _ in ranked[:top_n]]\n\n\ndef build_interface_payload(\n    *,\n    activity_id: str,\n    transcription_payload: dict[str, Any],\n    summary_payload: dict[str, Any],\n    pdf_payload: dict[str, Any],\n    pdf_path: str,\n    run_started_at: datetime,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Build the standardised cross-module interface payload.\n\n    Required fields are always present. required\n      \"created_at_utc\": ISO-8601,     # required\n\n      \"transcription\": {\n        \"start_time\":      float,     # required — first segment t0 (seconds)\n        \"end_time\":        float,     # required — last  segment t1 (seconds)\n        \"transcript_text\": str,       # required — full joined transcript\n        \"transcript_meta\": { ... }    # optional\n      },\n\n      \"summary\": {\n        \"summary_text\": str,          # required\n        \"keywords\":     [str, ...],   # required (may be empty list)\n        \"summary_meta\": { ... }       # optional\n      },\n\n      \"ppt\": {\n        \"ppt_present\":      bool,     # required\n        \"ppt_file_path\":    str,      # required when ppt_present=true\n        \"ppt_id\":           str,      # required when ppt_present=true (reserved)\n        \"matched_slides\":   [ ... ],  # optional\n        \"ppt_text_excerpt\": [ ... ]   # optional\n      }\n    }\n    \"\"\"\n    # ── activity_id (auto-generate UUID if caller did not supply one) ──────\n    aid = activity_id.strip() or uuid.uuid4().hex\n\n    # ── Transcription ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    t_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = transcription_payload.get(\"results\") or []\n    start_time = float(t_results[0][\"t0\"])  if t_results else 0.0\n    end_time   = float(t_results[-1][\"t1\"]) if t_results else 0.0\n    transcript_text = \" \".join(\n        str(r.get(\"text\", \"\")).strip() for r in t_results if r.get(\"text\")\n    ).strip()\n\n    transcription_section: dict[str, Any] = {\n        \"start_time\":      round(start_time, 3),\n        \"end_time\":        round(end_time, 3),\n        \"transcript_text\": transcript_text,\n    }\n    # transcript_meta — optional\n    if t_results:\n        metrics  = transcription_payload.get(\"metrics\", {})\n        quality  = transcription_payload.get(\"transcription_quality\", {})\n        runtime  = transcription_payload.get(\"runtime\", {})\n        t_meta: dict[str, Any] = {\n            \"segment_count\":     len(t_results),\n            \"mean_confidence\":   round(\n                float((quality.get(\"stats\") or {}).get(\"mean_confidence\", 0.0)), 4\n            ),\n            \"recorded_seconds\":  round(float(metrics.get(\"recorded_seconds\", 0.0)), 2),\n            \"language\":          str(runtime.get(\"language\", \"\")),\n        }\n        transcription_section[\"transcript_meta\"] = t_meta\n\n    # ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    s_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = summary_payload.get(\"results\") or []\n    # Collect text from all summary rounds — field name varies by provider\n    summary_parts: list[str] = []\n    for r in s_results:\n        if not isinstance(r, dict):\n            continue\n        text = (\n            r.get(\"summary\") or r.get(\"text\") or r.get(\"output\") or\n            r.get(\"content\") or r.get(\"response\") or \"\"\n        )\n        if text:\n            summary_parts.append(str(text).strip())\n    summary_text = \"\\n\\n\".join(summary_parts)\n\n    # keywords — try explicit field first, fall back to frequency extraction\n    keyword_set: list[str] = []\n    for r in s_results:\n        if isinstance(r, dict) and isinstance(r.get(\"keywords\"), list):\n            keyword_set.extend(str(k) for k in r[\"keywords\"] if k)\n    if not keyword_set and summary_text:\n        keyword_set = _extract_keywords(summary_text)\n    # Also scan transcript for domain terms not in summary\n    if transcript_text and len(keyword_set) < 5:\n        extra = _extract_keywords(transcript_text, top_n=5)\n        seen = set(keyword_set)\n        for kw in extra:\n            if kw not in seen:\n                keyword_set.append(kw)\n                seen.add(kw)\n\n    summary_section: dict[str, Any] = {\n        \"summary_text\": summary_text,\n        \"keywords\":     keyword_set[:15],    # cap at 15\n    }\n    # summary_meta — optional\n    s_runtime = summary_payload.get(\"runtime\", {})\n    if s_results or isinstance(s_runtime, dict):\n        s_meta: dict[str, Any] = {\"rounds\": len(s_results)}\n        if isinstance(s_runtime, dict):\n            if s_runtime.get(\"provider\"):\n                s_meta[\"provider\"] = str(s_runtime[\"provider\"])\n            if s_runtime.get(\"model_id\"):\n                s_meta[\"model\"] = str(s_runtime[\"model_id\"])\n        summary_section[\"summary_meta\"] = s_meta\n\n    # ── PPT / PDF ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    ppt_present = bool(pdf_path and pdf_path.strip())\n    ppt_section: dict[str, Any] = {\"ppt_present\": ppt_present}\n\n    if ppt_present:\n        ppt_section[\"ppt_file_path\"] = pdf_path\n        # ppt_id — reserved for future asset-management integration\n        ppt_section[\"ppt_id\"] = \"\"\n\n        # matched_slides — optional (from timeline)\n        timeline: list[dict[str, Any]] = pdf_payload.get(\"timeline\") or []\n        if timeline:\n            matched_slides = [\n                {\n                    \"slide_index\": int(entry.get(\"page_index\", 0)),\n                    \"start_time\":  round(float(entry.get(\"start_time\", 0.0)), 3),\n                    \"end_time\":    round(float(entry.get(\"end_time\",   0.0)), 3),\n                    \"confidence\":  round(float(entry.get(\"confidence\", 0.0)), 4),\n                }\n                for entry in timeline\n            ]\n            ppt_section[\"matched_slides\"] = matched_slides\n\n        # ppt_text_excerpt — optional (preview text for each matched page)\n        pages: list[dict[str, Any]] = pdf_payload.get(\"pages\") or []\n        if pages and timeline:\n            matched_idxs = {int(e.get(\"page_index\", -1)) for e in timeline}\n            excerpts = [\n                {\n                    \"slide_index\":  p[\"page_index\"],\n                    \"text_preview\": str(p.get(\"text_preview\", \"\"))[:200],\n                }\n                for p in pages\n                if int(p.get(\"page_index\", -1)) in matched_idxs\n                and p.get(\"text_preview\")\n            ]\n            if excerpts:\n                ppt_section[\"ppt_text_excerpt\"] = excerpts\n    else:\n        ppt_section[\"ppt_file_path\"] = \"\"\n        ppt_section[\"ppt_id\"] = \"\"\n\n    return {\n        \"schema_version\": _INTERFACE_SCHEMA_VERSION,\n        \"activity_id\":    aid,\n        \"created_at_utc\": run_started_at.isoformat(),\n        \"transcription\":  transcription_section,\n        \"summary\":        summary_section,\n        \"ppt\":            ppt_section,\n    }\n\n\ndef _write_interface_output(\n    output_dir: Path,\n    payload: dict[str, Any],\n) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Write interface_output.json alongside merged_results.json.\"\"\"\n    dest = output_dir / \"interface_output.json\"\n    dest.write_text(\n        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),\n        encoding=\"utf-8\",\n    )\n",

                        Peak limiter ceiling after enhancement (0–1). 0.72
                        gives ~3 dB headroom before digital full-scale,
                        preventing the hard clipping at 0.88 that degrades
                        Deepgram confidence. Default: 0.72.
  --no-agc              Bypass the AGC/limiter enhancement chain entirely. Use
                        when hardware already provides a clean, well-levelled
                        signal, or to diagnose whether enhancement is causing
                        problems.
  --pre-emphasis PRE_EMPHASIS
                        Pre-emphasis filter coefficient α (y[n] = x[n] -
                        α·x[n-1]). Boosts high-frequency consonants
                        (zh/ch/sh/s) that ASR relies on. Standard value is
                        0.97 (Kaldi/ESPnet default). Set to 0.0 to disable.
                        Default: 0.97.
  --transcription-provider TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER
                        Provider name for Deepgram STT (from registry).
                        Default: deepgram.
  --transcription-model TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL
                        Deepgram model name. Default: whisper-large.
  --transcription-language TRANSCRIPTION_LANGUAGE
                        BCP-47 language for Deepgram (e.g. zh-CN, en-US). Use
                        'auto' to disable forced language and let Deepgram
                        decide. Default: map from --language.
  --summary-provider SUMMARY_PROVIDER
                        Provider name for the LLM summarization API (from
                        registry). Default: minimax.
  --summary-window-size SUMMARY_WINDOW_SIZE
                        Words per summarization window.
  --summary-overlap-size SUMMARY_OVERLAP_SIZE
                        Overlap words between windows.
  --summary-chunk-size SUMMARY_CHUNK_SIZE
                        Incremental reader chunk size (chars).
  --summary-max-new-tokens SUMMARY_MAX_NEW_TOKENS
                        Max tokens the LLM may generate per call.
  --pdf-path PDF_PATH   Optional PDF slide file for transcript-to-page
                        matching.
  --embedding-provider EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
                        Provider name for text embeddings used in PDF
                        matching. Must support /v1/embeddings (e.g. minimax-
                        embed, openai-embed). Default: minimax-embed.
  --embedding-model EMBEDDING_MODEL
                        Embedding model ID. Default: embo-01 (MiniMax).
  --embedding-batch-size EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE
                        Max texts per embedding API call.
  --embedding-format {auto,minimax,openai}
                        Wire format for the embedding API. 'auto' (default)
                        detects from the provider base URL: URLs containing
                        'minimaxi' → MiniMax format (request key 'texts',
                        response key 'vectors'); all others → OpenAI format
                        (request key 'input', response key
                        'data[].embedding'). Use 'minimax' or 'openai' to
                        force a specific format.
  --embedding-passage-prefix EMBEDDING_PASSAGE_PREFIX
                        Text prepended to each PDF chunk before embedding.
                        E5-family models require 'passage: '; BGE-M3 and
                        OpenAI models use plain text (default: empty string,

      : undefined,
    message: payload?.message ? String(payload.message) : "",
    exitCode:
      typeof payload?.exitCode === "number" && Number.isFinite(payload.exitCode)
        ? payload.exitCode
        : undefined,
  };
}

function getWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, processingStatus = "initialized") {
  const cachedStatus = workspacePipelineRuns.get(workspaceId);
  if (cachedStatus) {
    return cachedStatus;
  }

  return createWorkspacePipelineStatus({
    workspaceId,
    runState: "idle",
    processingStatus,
  });
}

function setWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, nextState) {
  const current = workspacePipelineRuns.get(workspaceId);
  const status = createWorkspacePipelineStatus({
    ...current,
    ...nextState,
    workspaceId,
  });
  workspacePipelineRuns.set(workspaceId, status);
  return status;
}

async function getIndexedWorkspace(cacheRootPath, workspaceId) {
  const indexedWorkspaces = await syncWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath);
  const workspace = indexedWorkspaces.find((item) => item.workspaceId === workspaceId);
  return { indexedWorkspaces, workspace };
}

async function persistWorkspaceRecord(cacheRootPath, workspace) {
  const indexedWorkspaces = await syncWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath);
  const nextIndex = sortWorkspaces([
    workspace,
    ...indexedWorkspaces.filter((item) => item.workspaceId !== workspace.workspaceId),
  ]);
  await writeWorkspaceIndex(cacheRootPath, nextIndex);
  return workspace;
}

function buildTranscriptText(transcriptionPayload) {
  const results = Array.isArray(transcriptionPayload?.results)
    ? transcriptionPayload.results
    : [];

  return results
    .map((item) => String(item?.text || "").trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ")
    .trim();
}

function buildSidebarItemsFromSummary(summaryPayload, interfacePayload, transcriptText) {
  const results = Array.isArray(summaryPayload?.results) ? summaryPayload.results : [];
  const items = results
    .map((result, index) => {
      const summary = String(result?.summary || result?.text || "").trim();
      const transcript = String(result?.input_text || "").trim();

      if (!summary) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        id: `summary-round-${result?.round_number || index + 1}`,
        summary,
        transcript,
        transcriptSegmentIds: [],
        transcriptRange: {
          startTime: null,
          endTime: null,
        },
      };
    })
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (items.length) {
    return items;
  }

  const consolidatedSummary = String(
    interfacePayload?.summary?.summary_text ||
      summaryPayload?.consolidated_summary?.summary ||
      "",
  ).trim();

  if (!consolidatedSummary) {
    return [];
  }

  return [
    {
      id: "summary-consolidated",
      summary: consolidatedSummary,
      transcript: transcriptText,
      transcriptSegmentIds: [],
      transcriptRange: {
        startTime: null,
        endTime: null,
      },
    },
  ];
}

function buildTranscriptArtifact(
  workspace,
  transcriptionPayload,
  transcriptText,
  processingStatus,
) {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const results = Array.isArray(transcriptionPayload?.results)
    ? transcriptionPayload.results
    : [];

  return {
    schemaVersion: "1.1",
    workspaceId: workspace.workspaceId,
    status: processingStatus,
    sourceFileName: workspace.sourceFileName,
    sourceKind: workspace.sourceKind,
    transcriptText,
    segments: results,
    createdAtUtc: workspace.createdAtUtc,
    updatedAtUtc: now,
    runtime: transcriptionPayload?.runtime || {},
    metrics: transcriptionPayload?.metrics || {},
    transcriptionQuality: transcriptionPayload?.transcription_quality || {},
    stageStatus: transcriptionPayload?.stage_status || {},
    liteSynphonia: transcriptionPayload || {},
  };
}

function buildSummaryArtifact(
  workspace,
  summaryPayload,
  interfacePayload,
  sidebarItems,
  processingStatus,
) {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    schemaVersion: "1.1",
    workspaceId: workspace.workspaceId,
    status: processingStatus,
    sourceFileName: workspace.sourceFileName,
    sourceKind: workspace.sourceKind,
    summaryText: String(interfacePayload?.summary?.summary_text || "").trim(),
    items: sidebarItems,
    keywords: Array.isArray(interfacePayload?.summary?.keywords)
      ? interfacePayload.summary.keywords
      : [],
    createdAtUtc: workspace.createdAtUtc,
    updatedAtUtc: now,
    runtime: summaryPayload?.runtime || {},
    consolidatedSummary: summaryPayload?.consolidated_summary || {},
    stageStatus: summaryPayload?.stage_status || {},
    liteSynphonia: summaryPayload || {},
  };
}

async function syncLiteSynphoniaArtifacts(workspace, processingStatus) {
  const transcriptionSourcePath = path.join(
    workspace.workspacePath,
    "transcription",
    "transcription.json",
  );
  const summarySourcePath = path.join(
    workspace.workspacePath,
    "summary",
    "results.json",
  );
  const interfaceSourcePath = path.join(
    workspace.workspacePath,
    LITESYNPHONIA_INTERFACE_FILE_NAME,
  );

  const [transcriptionPayload, summaryPayload, interfacePayload] = await Promise.all([
    readJsonFile(transcriptionSourcePath, null),
    readJsonFile(summarySourcePath, null),
    readJsonFile(interfaceSourcePath, null),
  ]);

  if (!transcriptionPayload) {
    throw new Error("缺少 LiteSynphonia 转录结果文件。");
  }

  const transcriptText =
    String(interfacePayload?.transcription?.transcript_text || "").trim() ||
    buildTranscriptText(transcriptionPayload);
  const sidebarItems = buildSidebarItemsFromSummary(
    summaryPayload,
    interfacePayload,
    transcriptText,
  );
  const sidebarState = normalizeSidebarState({
    status: processingStatus,
    createdAtUtc: workspace.createdAtUtc,
    updatedAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
    items: sidebarItems,
  });
  const transcriptArtifact = buildTranscriptArtifact(
    workspace,
    transcriptionPayload,
    transcriptText,
    processingStatus,
  );
  const summaryArtifact = buildSummaryArtifact(
    workspace,
    summaryPayload,
    interfacePayload,
    sidebarItems,
    processingStatus,
  );

  await Promise.all([
    writeJsonFile(workspace.artifacts.transcriptPath, transcriptArtifact),
    writeJsonFile(workspace.artifacts.summaryPath, summaryArtifact),
    writeJsonFile(workspace.artifacts.sidebarStatePath, sidebarState),
  ]);

  return {
    transcriptArtifact,
    summaryArtifact,
    sidebarState,
  };
}

function inferProcessingStatusFromOutput(line, sourceKind) {
  const text = String(line || "");

  if (
    text.includes("麦克风预检") ||
    text.includes("skip-mic") ||
    text.includes("音频:")
  ) {
    return "recording";
  }

  if (text.includes("转录完成")) {
    return "summarizing";
  }

  if (sourceKind === "pdf" && text.includes("PDF matching")) {
    return "matching";
  }

  if (text.includes("接口输出") || text.includes("全部完成")) {
    return "ready";
  }

  return null;
}

ipcMain.handle("workspace:start-normal-pipeline", async (_, payload) => {
  const workspaceId = String(payload?.workspaceId || "").trim();
  const recordSeconds = Math.min(
    600,
    Math.max(1, Number(payload?.recordSeconds) || DEFAULT_RECORD_SECONDS),
  );

  if (!workspaceId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "缺少工作区标识。" };
  }

  const cacheRootPath = getWorkspaceCacheRoot();
  const { workspace } = await getIndexedWorkspace(cacheRootPath, workspaceId);

  if (!workspace) {
    return { ok: false, message: "没有找到对应的工作区。" };
  }

  const currentPipelineStatus = getWorkspacePipelineStatus(
    workspaceId,
    workspace.status,
  );
  if (currentPipelineStatus.runState === "running") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "当前工作区已有正在执行的转录任务。",
      status: currentPipelineStatus,
    };
  }

  const startedAtUtc = new Date().toISOString();
  const activeWorkspace = createWorkspaceRecord({
    ...workspace,
    status: "recording",
    updatedAtUtc: startedAtUtc,
  });
  await persistWorkspaceRecord(cacheRootPath, activeWorkspace);

  const initialStatus = setWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, {
    runState: "running",
    processingStatus: "recording",
    startedAtUtc,
    finishedAtUtc: undefined,
    message: `正在录制 ${recordSeconds} 秒音频...`,
    exitCode: undefined,
  });

  const pipelineArgs = [
    "-m",
    "lite_synphonia",
    "--activity-id",
    workspaceId,
    "--output-dir",
    activeWorkspace.workspacePath,
    "--seconds",
    String(recordSeconds),
  ];

  if (activeWorkspace.sourceKind === "pdf" && activeWorkspace.artifacts.sourceCopyPath) {
    pipelineArgs.push("--pdf-path", activeWorkspace.artifacts.sourceCopyPath);
  }

  const childProcess = spawn("python3", pipelineArgs, {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
  });

  const stderrChunks = [];

  function applyProgressStatus(nextProcessingStatus, message) {
    const progressStatus = setWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, {
      runState: "running",
      processingStatus: nextProcessingStatus,
      message,
    });

    if (nextProcessingStatus !== activeWorkspace.status) {
      void persistWorkspaceRecord(
        cacheRootPath,
        createWorkspaceRecord({
          ...activeWorkspace,
          status: nextProcessingStatus,
          updatedAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
        }),
      );
    }

    return progressStatus;
  }

  function handleOutputChunk(chunk, source) {
    const text = chunk.toString("utf8");
    if (source === "stderr") {
      stderrChunks.push(text);
    }

    for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      const trimmedLine = line.trim();
      if (!trimmedLine) {
        continue;
      }

      const inferredStatus = inferProcessingStatusFromOutput(trimmedLine);
      if (inferredStatus) {
        applyProgressStatus(inferredStatus, trimmedLine);
      } else {
        setWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, {
          message: trimmedLine,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  childProcess.stdout?.on("data", (chunk) => {
    handleOutputChunk(chunk, "stdout");
  });
  childProcess.stderr?.on("data", (chunk) => {
    handleOutputChunk(chunk, "stderr");
  });

  childProcess.on("error", async (error) => {
    const finishedAtUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    const failedWorkspace = createWorkspaceRecord({
      ...activeWorkspace,
      status: "failed",
      updatedAtUtc: finishedAtUtc,
    });

    await persistWorkspaceRecord(cacheRootPath, failedWorkspace);
    setWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, {
      runState: "failed",
      processingStatus: "failed",
      finishedAtUtc,
      message: `LiteSynphonia 启动失败: ${error.message}`,
    });
  });

  childProcess.on("close", async (code) => {
    const finishedAtUtc = new Date().toISOString();

    if (code === 0) {
      try {
        await syncLiteSynphoniaArtifacts(activeWorkspace, "ready");
        const completedWorkspace = createWorkspaceRecord({
          ...activeWorkspace,
          status: "ready",
          updatedAtUtc: finishedAtUtc,
        });
        await persistWorkspaceRecord(cacheRootPath, completedWorkspace);
        setWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, {
          runState: "succeeded",
          processingStatus: "ready",
          finishedAtUtc,
          exitCode: code,
          message: "转录、总结和结果同步已完成。",
        });
      } catch (error) {
        const failedWorkspace = createWorkspaceRecord({
          ...activeWorkspace,
          status: "failed",
          updatedAtUtc: finishedAtUtc,
        });
        await persistWorkspaceRecord(cacheRootPath, failedWorkspace);
        setWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, {
          runState: "failed",
          processingStatus: "failed",
          finishedAtUtc,
          exitCode: code,
          message:
            error instanceof Error
              ? `工作区结果同步失败: ${error.message}`
              : "工作区结果同步失败。",
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    const failedWorkspace = createWorkspaceRecord({
      ...activeWorkspace,
      status: "failed",
      updatedAtUtc: finishedAtUtc,
    });
    await persistWorkspaceRecord(cacheRootPath, failedWorkspace);
    const stderrMessage = stderrChunks.join("").trim();
    setWorkspacePipelineStatus(workspaceId, {
      runState: "failed",
      processingStatus: "failed",
      finishedAtUtc,
      exitCode: typeof code === "number" ? code : undefined,
      message:
        stderrMessage ||
        `LiteSynphonia 运行失败，退出码 ${typeof code === "number" ? code : "unknown"}。`,
    });
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    status: initialStatus,
  };
});

});

export async function startNormalModeWorkspacePipeline(
  payload: StartNormalWorkspacePipelinePayload,
): Promise<WorkspacePipelineStatus> {
  if (!window.desktopBridge?.startNormalWorkspacePipeline) {
    throw new Error("当前环境不支持启动 LiteSynphonia 流水线。");

}

): Promise<WorkspacePipelineStatus> {

  if (!result.ok || !result.status) {

}

  function getPipelineStatusLabel(status: WorkspacePipelineStatus | null): string {
    if (!status) {
      return "未开始转录";
    }

    if (status.runState === "running") {
      switch (status.processingStatus) {
        case "recording":
          return "正在录制";
        case "transcribing":
          return "正在转录";
        case "summarizing":
          return "正在总结";
        case "matching":
          return "正在匹配页码";
        default:
          return "处理中";
      }
    }

    if (status.runState === "succeeded") {
      return "已完成";
    }

    if (status.runState === "failed") {
      return "运行失败";
    }

    if (status.processingStatus === "ready") {
      return "已完成";
    }

    return "未开始转录";
  }

- 然后前端会自动重新打开当前工作区，左侧 `Normal` 总结栏会显示真实摘要结果

你现在先把 provider 配好，至少这两个：

```bash
python3 -m lite_synphonia providers add deepgram \
  --base-url https://api.deepgram.com \
  --model whisper-large \
  --api-key YOUR_DEEPGRAM_API_KEY \
  --service transcription
```

```bash
python3 -m lite_synphonia providers add minimax \
  --base-url https://api.minimaxi.chat/v1 \
  --model MiniMax-Text-01 \
  --api-key YOUR_MINIMAX_API_KEY \
  --service summarization
```

如果你还要让 PDF 页码匹配一起跑，再补一个 embedding provider：

```bash
python3 -m lite_synphonia providers add minimax-embed \
  --base-url https://api.minimaxi.chat/v1 \
  --model embo-01 \
  --api-key YOUR_MINIMAX_API_KEY \
  --service embedding
```

然后再确认一次：

```bash
python3 -m lite_synphonia providers list
```

async function readProviderEntries() {
  const candidatePaths = [PROVIDER_CONFIG_PATH, LEGACY_PROVIDER_CONFIG_PATH];

  for (const candidatePath of candidatePaths) {
    try {
      const payload = await readJsonFile(candidatePath, null);
      const providers = Array.isArray(payload?.providers)
        ? payload.providers
        : Array.isArray(payload)
          ? payload
          : [];

      if (providers.length) {
        return {
          providerPath: candidatePath,
          entries: providers,
        };
      }
    } catch (_error) {
      // Ignore malformed/absent provider files here; the caller gets a single
      // deterministic remediation path instead of low-signal parse noise.
    }
  }

  return {
    providerPath: PROVIDER_CONFIG_PATH,
    entries: [],
  };
}

async function checkWorkspacePipelinePrerequisites(workspace) {
  const { providerPath, entries } = await readProviderEntries();
  const requiredServices = workspace.sourceKind === "pdf"
    ? ["transcription", "summarization", "embedding"]
    : ["transcription", "summarization"];

  const availableByService = new Map();
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const apiKey = String(entry?.api_key || "").trim();
    const services = Array.isArray(entry?.services) ? entry.services : [];

    if (!apiKey) {
      continue;
    }

    for (const service of services) {
      const nextService = String(service || "").trim();
      if (!nextService) {
        continue;
      }

      const serviceEntries = availableByService.get(nextService) || [];
      serviceEntries.push(String(entry?.name || "").trim() || "unnamed");
      availableByService.set(nextService, serviceEntries);
    }
  }

  const missingServices = requiredServices.filter(
    (service) => !(availableByService.get(service) || []).length,
  );

  if (!missingServices.length) {
    return { ok: true, providerPath };
  }

  const commandHints = [];
  if (missingServices.includes("transcription")) {
    commandHints.push(
      "python3 -m lite_synphonia providers add deepgram --base-url https://api.deepgram.com --model whisper-large --api-key <你的Key> --service transcription",
    );
  }
  if (missingServices.includes("summarization")) {
    commandHints.push(
      "python3 -m lite_synphonia providers add minimax --base-url https://api.minimaxi.chat/v1 --model MiniMax-Text-01 --api-key <你的Key> --service summarization",
    );
  }
  if (missingServices.includes("embedding")) {
    commandHints.push(
      "python3 -m lite_synphonia providers add minimax-embed --base-url https://api.minimaxi.chat/v1 --model embo-01 --api-key <你的Key> --service embedding",
    );
  }

  return {
    ok: false,
    message: [
      "LiteSynphonia provider 未配置完整。",
      `缺少服务: ${missingServices.join(", ")}`,
      `配置文件路径: ${providerPath}`,
      "先在项目根目录执行以下命令之一:",
      ...commandHints,
    ].join("\n"),
  };
}

## Assistant

那就不该让用户手动配 `python3 -m lite_synphonia providers add ...`。

如果目标是“前后端整合成一个 app”，当前这套 CLI provider 配置只是临时联调方式，不是最终产品形态。最终应该是：

**推荐架构**
- 外壳：`Electron`
- 前端：你现在这套 `React + TS`
- 本地后端：把 `lite_synphonia` 作为 app 内部服务运行
- 数据边界：每个 `PDF/PPT` 一个工作区目录

前端不直接碰 `lite_synphonia` CLI，也不要求用户在终端配 provider。正确流程应该是：

1. 用户上传 `PDF/PPT`
2. app 自动创建工作区
3. 用户点击 `开始转录`
4. Electron 主进程启动本地后端任务
5. 后端产出结果写回工作区
6. 前端轮询状态并刷新左栏总结 / 中间预览联动

**这意味着要改两件事**
1. `provider` 配置要进 app 设置页  
不是终端命令，而是设置页里填：
- Deepgram API Key
- MiniMax API Key

然后由 app 写到自己的配置目录，后端直接读取。

2. `lite_synphonia` 要从 CLI 用法改成“app 内部调用”  
有两种落地方式：

- 方式 A：Electron 主进程直接 `spawn python3 -m lite_synphonia ...`
  - 优点：改动最小
  - 缺点：仍然依赖本机 Python 环境，发布时麻烦

- 方式 B：把 `lite_synphonia` 包成 app 内部 sidecar service
  - Electron 启动时拉起一个本地 Python 服务
  - 前端/Electron 调它的本地接口
  - 优点：结构更清晰，后续做状态、取消、重试更稳
  - 这是更合理的产品方案

对你们现在这个项目，我建议走 **A 过渡，B 收口**：
- 现在先保留 Electron 启动 Python 任务
- 但把 provider 配置从“终端命令”改成“设置页保存”
- 后面再把 `lite_synphonia` 包成正式本地服务

**你现在最该做的下一步**
不是继续让用户配命令，而是我直接帮你做：

1. 设置页增加 provider 配置表单
2. Electron 保存/读取 provider 配置
3. `开始转录` 前改成读 app 设置，而不是检查终端环境
4. 缺 key 时在 app 内提示，不再弹 CLI 命令

这样才符合“一个完整 app”的方向。

如果你同意，我下一步就直接做第 1 到第 3 步，把现在这套终端 provider 依赖去掉。

import type {
  LiteSynphoniaProviderSettings,
  SaveLiteSynphoniaProviderSettingsPayload,
} from "../types";

export async function getLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings(): Promise<LiteSynphoniaProviderSettings> {
  if (!window.desktopBridge?.getLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings) {
    throw new Error("当前环境不支持读取 LiteSynphonia 配置。");
  }

  const result = await window.desktopBridge.getLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings();
  if (!result.ok || !result.settings) {
    throw new Error(result.message || "读取 LiteSynphonia 配置失败。");
  }

  return result.settings;
}

export async function saveLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings(
  payload: SaveLiteSynphoniaProviderSettingsPayload,
): Promise<LiteSynphoniaProviderSettings> {
  if (!window.desktopBridge?.saveLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings) {
    throw new Error("当前环境不支持保存 LiteSynphonia 配置。");
  }

  const result = await window.desktopBridge.saveLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings(payload);
  if (!result.ok || !result.settings) {
    throw new Error(result.message || "保存 LiteSynphonia 配置失败。");
  }

  return result.settings;
}

function normalizeProviderEntry(rawEntry) {
  if (!rawEntry || typeof rawEntry !== "object") {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    name: String(rawEntry.name || "").trim(),
    base_url: String(rawEntry.base_url || rawEntry.baseUrl || "").trim(),
    model_id: String(rawEntry.model_id || rawEntry.model || "").trim(),
    api_key: String(rawEntry.api_key || "").trim(),
    services: Array.isArray(rawEntry.services)
      ? rawEntry.services.map((service) => String(service || "").trim()).filter(Boolean)
      : [],
    timeout_seconds: Number(rawEntry.timeout_seconds) || 60,
    max_retries: Number(rawEntry.max_retries) || 3,
    temperature:
      rawEntry.temperature === undefined ? 0.1 : Number(rawEntry.temperature) || 0,
    created_at_utc: String(rawEntry.created_at_utc || "").trim(),
    updated_at_utc: String(rawEntry.updated_at_utc || "").trim(),
  };
}

function createManagedProviderEntry(preset, apiKey, previousEntry) {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    name: preset.name,
    base_url: preset.baseUrl,
    model_id: preset.modelId,
    api_key: apiKey,
    services: [...preset.services],
    timeout_seconds: previousEntry?.timeout_seconds || preset.timeoutSeconds,
    max_retries: previousEntry?.max_retries || preset.maxRetries,
    temperature:
      previousEntry?.temperature === undefined
        ? preset.temperature
        : previousEntry.temperature,
    created_at_utc: previousEntry?.created_at_utc || now,
    updated_at_utc: now,
  };
}

async function getLiteSynphoniaProviderSettingsSnapshot() {
  const { providerPath, entries } = await readProviderEntries();
  const normalizedEntries = entries.map(normalizeProviderEntry).filter(Boolean);
  const deepgramEntry =
    normalizedEntries.find((entry) => entry.name === "deepgram") ||
    normalizedEntries.find(
      (entry) => entry.api_key && entry.services.includes("transcription"),
    );
  const minimaxEntry =
    normalizedEntries.find((entry) => entry.name === "minimax") ||
    normalizedEntries.find((entry) => entry.name === "minimax-embed") ||
    normalizedEntries.find(
      (entry) =>
        entry.api_key &&
        (entry.services.includes("summarization") || entry.services.includes("embedding")),
    );

  return {
    configPath: providerPath,
    deepgramApiKey: deepgramEntry?.api_key || "",
    minimaxApiKey: minimaxEntry?.api_key || "",
    hasTranscriptionProvider: normalizedEntries.some(
      (entry) => entry.api_key && entry.services.includes("transcription"),
    ),
    hasSummarizationProvider: normalizedEntries.some(
      (entry) => entry.api_key && entry.services.includes("summarization"),
    ),
    hasEmbeddingProvider: normalizedEntries.some(
      (entry) => entry.api_key && entry.services.includes("embedding"),
    ),
  };
}

async function saveLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings(payload) {
  const deepgramApiKey = String(payload?.deepgramApiKey || "").trim();
  const minimaxApiKey = String(payload?.minimaxApiKey || "").trim();
  const { entries } = await readProviderEntries();
  const normalizedEntries = entries.map(normalizeProviderEntry).filter(Boolean);
  const existingEntriesByName = new Map(
    normalizedEntries.map((entry) => [entry.name, entry]),
  );
  const preservedEntries = normalizedEntries.filter(
    (entry) => !APP_MANAGED_PROVIDER_NAMES.has(entry.name),
  );
  const nextEntries = [...preservedEntries];

  if (deepgramApiKey) {
    nextEntries.push(
      createManagedProviderEntry(
        APP_MANAGED_PROVIDER_PRESETS.deepgram,
        deepgramApiKey,
        existingEntriesByName.get("deepgram"),
      ),
    );
  }

  if (minimaxApiKey) {
    nextEntries.push(
      createManagedProviderEntry(
        APP_MANAGED_PROVIDER_PRESETS.minimax,
        minimaxApiKey,
        existingEntriesByName.get("minimax"),
      ),
    );
    nextEntries.push(
      createManagedProviderEntry(
        APP_MANAGED_PROVIDER_PRESETS["minimax-embed"],
        minimaxApiKey,
        existingEntriesByName.get("minimax-embed"),
      ),
    );
  }

  const sortedEntries = nextEntries.sort((left, right) =>
    left.name.localeCompare(right.name, "zh-Hans-CN"),
  );
  await ensureDirectory(path.dirname(PROVIDER_CONFIG_PATH));
  await writeJsonFile(PROVIDER_CONFIG_PATH, {
    providers: sortedEntries,
    updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
  });

  return getLiteSynphoniaProviderSettingsSnapshot();
}

  async function loadProviderSettings(): Promise<void> {
    if (!window.desktopBridge?.getLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings) {
      return;
    }

    setIsProviderSettingsLoading(true);
    setProviderSettingsFeedback("");
    setProviderSettingsFeedbackTone("");

    try {
      const nextSettings = await getLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings();
      setProviderSettings(nextSettings);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("读取 LiteSynphonia 配置失败", error);
      setProviderSettingsFeedback(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "读取 LiteSynphonia 配置失败。",
      );
      setProviderSettingsFeedbackTone("error");
    } finally {
      setIsProviderSettingsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function handleOpenSettings(): void {
    setIsSettingsOpen(true);
    void loadProviderSettings();
  }

  async function handleSaveProviderSettings(): Promise<void> {
    setIsProviderSettingsSaving(true);
    setProviderSettingsFeedback("");
    setProviderSettingsFeedbackTone("");

    try {
      const nextSettings = await saveLiteSynphoniaProviderSettings({
        deepgramApiKey: providerSettings.deepgramApiKey,
        minimaxApiKey: providerSettings.minimaxApiKey,
      });
      setProviderSettings(nextSettings);
      setProviderSettingsFeedback("LiteSynphonia 配置已保存。");
      setProviderSettingsFeedbackTone("success");
      setWorkspaceErrorMessage("");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("保存 LiteSynphonia 配置失败", error);
      setProviderSettingsFeedback(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存 LiteSynphonia 配置失败。",
      );
      setProviderSettingsFeedbackTone("error");
    } finally {
      setIsProviderSettingsSaving(false);
    }
  }

你们现在这条链路还是本地 app 直接调用第三方服务：

- `Deepgram` 做转录
- `MiniMax` 做总结和 embedding

所以 app 至少要知道这两把 key。现在只是把“终端配置”改成了“设置页配置”。

保存成功后，`/Users/wangwenbin/.config/lite_synphonia/providers.json` 里应该会有 3 个 provider：
- `deepgram`
- `minimax`
- `minimax-embed`

如果你已经填了还是报这个错，那就不是“没填”，而是“没写进去”。这种情况我下一步直接帮你查保存链路。最直接的检查是：

- 那就要改成：app 调你们自己的后端，由你们后端持有 key

function buildLiteSynphoniaRunLog(workspace, pipelineArgs, outputChunks, exitCode) {
  const renderedCommand = ["python3", ...pipelineArgs].join(" ");
  const sections = [
    `[workspace] ${workspace.workspaceId}`,
    `[source] ${workspace.sourceFileName}`,
    `[command] ${renderedCommand}`,
  ];

  if (typeof exitCode === "number") {
    sections.push(`[exitCode] ${exitCode}`);
  }

  sections.push("", outputChunks.join(""));
  return sections.join("\n");
}

async function writeLiteSynphoniaRunLog(workspace, pipelineArgs, outputChunks, exitCode) {
  const logPath = path.join(workspace.workspacePath, LITESYNPHONIA_RUN_LOG_FILE_NAME);
  const logContent = buildLiteSynphoniaRunLog(
    workspace,
    pipelineArgs,
    outputChunks,
    exitCode,
  );
  await fs.writeFile(logPath, logContent, "utf8");
  return logPath;
}

import ast, os
root='lite_synphonia'
mods={}
for dp,_,files in os.walk(root):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.py'): continue
        p=os.path.join(dp,f)
        try:
            tree=ast.parse(open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8').read(), filename=p)
        except Exception:
            continue
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                for n in node.names:
                    mods.setdefault(n.name.split('.')[0], set()).add(p)
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
                if node.module and node.level==0:
                    mods.setdefault(node.module.split('.')[0], set()).add(p)
for name in sorted(mods):
    print(name)

async function checkLiteSynphoniaPythonDependencies(workspace) {
  const requiredModules = ["numpy", "sounddevice"];
  if (workspace.sourceKind === "pdf") {
    requiredModules.push("pypdf");
  }

  const checkScript = [
    "import importlib.util, json",
    `modules = ${JSON.stringify(requiredModules)}`,
    "missing = [name for name in modules if importlib.util.find_spec(name) is None]",
    "print(json.dumps({'missing': missing}, ensure_ascii=False))",
  ].join("; ");

  return await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const child = spawn("python3", ["-c", checkScript], {
      cwd: projectRoot,
      stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
    });

    const stdoutChunks = [];
    const stderrChunks = [];

    child.stdout?.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stdoutChunks.push(chunk.toString("utf8"));
    });
    child.stderr?.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderrChunks.push(chunk.toString("utf8"));
    });

    child.on("error", (error) => {
      resolve({
        ok: false,
        message: `无法启动 python3 检查 LiteSynphonia 依赖: ${error.message}`,
      });
    });

    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code !== 0) {
        resolve({
          ok: false,
          message:
            stderrChunks.join("").trim() ||
            `Python 依赖检查失败，退出码 ${typeof code === "number" ? code : "unknown"}。`,
        });
        return;
      }

      try {
        const payload = JSON.parse(stdoutChunks.join("").trim() || "{}");
        const missingModules = Array.isArray(payload?.missing)
          ? payload.missing.map((item) => String(item || "").trim()).filter(Boolean)
          : [];

        if (!missingModules.length) {
          resolve({ ok: true });
          return;
        }

        resolve({
          ok: false,
          message: [
            "LiteSynphonia Python 依赖未安装完整。",
            `缺少模块: ${missingModules.join(", ")}`,
            `先执行: python3 -m pip install -r ${LITESYNPHONIA_REQUIREMENTS_PATH}`,
          ].join("\n"),
        });
      } catch (error) {
        resolve({
          ok: false,
          message:
            error instanceof Error
              ? `解析 Python 依赖检查结果失败: ${error.message}`
              : "解析 Python 依赖检查结果失败。",
        });
      }
    });
  });
}

async function getLiteSynphoniaPythonExecutable() {
  const candidates =
    process.platform === "win32"
      ? [path.join(LITESYNPHONIA_VENV_DIR, "Scripts", "python.exe")]
      : [
          path.join(LITESYNPHONIA_VENV_DIR, "bin", "python3"),
          path.join(LITESYNPHONIA_VENV_DIR, "bin", "python"),
        ];

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (await pathExists(candidate)) {
      return candidate;
    }
  }

  return "python3";
}

    };
  }

  return undefined;
}

## User

我带着耳机会有有效的输入吗

## Assistant

不一定。

关键不是“戴不戴耳机”，而是 **LiteSynphonia 实际录到的是哪一个输入设备**。你这次日志里：
- `rms=0.0000`
- `peak=0.0000`

这说明采集到的几乎就是静音。常见原因有三个：

1. 系统把输入源选错了  
比如选成了显示器麦克风、虚拟设备，或者根本没有选到你在说话的那个麦。

2. 你的耳机只有输出，没有麦克风输入  
很多蓝牙耳机或有线耳机在当前模式下只做播放，不一定真的给应用提供可用麦克风。

3. macOS 没把麦克风权限给 Electron  
这种情况下也可能出现录音过程正常开始，但实际采集不到有效音频。

你可以直接这样判断：

- 打开 macOS：
  `系统设置 -> 声音 -> 输入`
- 对着你要用的设备说话
- 看输入电平条会不会明显跳动

如果电平条不动，那 LiteSynphonia 也录不到。

建议你先这样测：
1. 不戴耳机，先用 Mac 自带麦克风试一次  
   这是最稳定的基线。
2. 如果自带麦能正常出总结，再换耳机测  
   这样能确认问题是不是设备切换导致的。
3. 检查 `系统设置 -> 隐私与安全性 -> 麦克风`  
   确认 Electron / 终端相关进程有权限。

如果你要，我下一步可以直接给这个 app 加一个“录音前设备检查”：
- 显示当前输入设备
- 录 1 秒做电平测试
- 电平接近 0 时禁止开始转录

这会比现在盲录更合理。
